dpe skrun gsal bshad/pa dang / gting dpog dka' ba'i las gzhi rlabs po che zhig yin gshis/mdun skyod kyi lam bu kyag kyog kyang kyong dang / tha na tsher ma'i tshang tshing gis yongs su gtums pa'ang 'byung srid pas rang re'i srid gzhung dang / 'brel yod sde tshan/ mnyam sdeb/ spyi dmangs mi sger bcas kyis mnyam las phyar ba gru 'degs dang / blo rtse zong kha gcig sgril/ thabs shes yod dgu rtsal sprug bcas kyis rang ngos nas 'go brtsams pa dang bya ba'i sne mo re re bzhin snying rus chen pos rgyun bskyangs nas bsgrubs tshe/ dka' tshegs mtha' dag las rnam par rgyal te byas rjes drud shul thon pa zhig yong thub snyam/ da phan mi lo bcu grangs nang dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gis rnam par dag pa'i lhag bsam dang ngal ba khur bzod kyi snying stobs la brten nas 'bad 'bungs lhur len gyis bod kyi sa gnas grong khyer dang / rdzong dang shang /tha na mtha' 'khob lung khug gi grong tsho dang 'brog dgon sogs gang sar phebs nas de khul du shin tu nyag phra zhing thar thor du lus pa'i dpe rnying dpe dkon mang dag cig myur skyob 'tshol bsdu dang / legs sgrig dpe skrun mdzad pa kun gyis mig mthong lag zin byung bas snying khams dbus nas dad gus dang rjes su yi rang zhu rgyu yin/ bod mi rigs kyi phul du byung ba'i srol rgyun rig gnas shul bzhag 'tshol bsdu dang / legs sgrig /dpe skrun bcas byas te deng gi spyi tshogs la zhabs 'degs dang / phyi rabs rgyud bcas rnams la skyes su 'bul rgyu'i dmigs yul dang / dgos pa/ phan rlabs bcas la blo kha gcig mthun thog da lam dpal brtsegs di+oḍi yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang dang /

dpe skrun gsal bshad/'di ga bod ljongs mi dmangs dpe skrun khang gnyis zhib 'jug gros mol thengs mang byas mthar/ khong rnam pas 'tshol bsdu legs sgrig mdzad pa'i gsung rab dpe rnying dpe dkon gal chen khag nged dpe skrun khang gis rim bzhin dpe skrun bya gtan khel ba bzhin/ da lan mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang zhes pa'i dpe tshogs khongs kyi 〈bla chen dpyal gyi gdung rabs che ba bcu ldan 〉zhes bya ba 'di deb drug par brtsis nas dpe skrun zhus pa yin zhing / dpe deb 'di'i dpe sgrig dang zhu dag thad zhib tshags nan hur byas khul lags kyang da dung skyon cha mi nyung ba zhig yod srid stabs/ mkhyen dpyod yangs pa'i gzigs pa po rnams kyis nor bcos kyi dgongs 'char lhug stsol yod pa mkhyen/ mkhyen/ mkhyen/bod ljongs mi dmangs dpe skrun khang nas bstan rgyas kyis/

sngon 'gro'i zhu tshigade yang 'gro ba lha dang bcas pa'i ma 'dris pa'i mdza' bshes/ phan bde'i rtsa lag tu gyur pa/ bdag cag gi ston pa mnyam med thub pa'i dbang pos gdul bya'i khams dbang mos pa dang 'tshams shing / thar 'dod skye bo yongs kyi 'jug ngogs dam par gyur pa'i/ chos kyi phung po ji snyed cig gsungs pa yang lta ba rten 'byung dang / spyod pa 'tshe ba med pa'i ring lugs dri ma med pa 'di nyid yin la/ de yang gtad rabs bdun dang / shing rta po gnyis la sogs pa las/ rim par 'dzam gling gi tha gru kun tu khyab pa las/ rang cag gangs can par mtshon na/ mkhyen brtse'i bdag nyid chen po mes po bka' drin can rnams kyi 'phrin las kyi 'od snang / phyi rabs 'gro ba'i lam ston sgron me lta bu'i bstan bcos sa chen po'i rdul ltar/ grangs tsam yang bsgrangs par dka' ba ji snyed cig bzhugs pa las/ deng dus spyi tshogs la dgos gal che ba khag cig mkho btus kyis/ phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang zhes pa'i dpe tshogs 'di nyid/ bod ljongs mi dmangs dpe skrun khang dang / nga tsho'i dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gnyis mnyam las kyis rgya che'i klog pa po rnams kyi spyan lam du rim pa bstar chags su 'bul rgyu yin/de yang da lta'i char phyi dngos po'i 'phel 'gyur dang / nang bsam pa'i shes tshad cha mi snyoms pa'i dus rasdosna kyi skyogs mtshams 'dir / smra shes

sngon 'gro'i zhu tshigashing don go ba 'gro ba mi'i rigs spyi dang / khyad par du spyi tshogs la 'gan khur gyi bsam blo ldan pa'i shes yon can rnams kyis/ bsam blo gu yangs dang /mig rgyang ring po'i sgo nas bsam blo'i langs phyogs ma nor bar legs nyes kyi gnas la bsam gzhig dang / spyi tshogs la rang nus kyis 'gan khur dang zhabs zhu gang 'grub byas nas/ 'cham mthun brtan brling dang shes dpal ldan pa'i 'khor yug cig 'dzugs skrun byed pa ni/ rang cag skye bo kun gyi phrag thog tu bab pa'i 'os 'gan zhig yin snyam/de yang nged zhib 'jug khang gi lo ngo bcu phrag lhag tsam gyi ring / gzan dkar mchog sprul thub bstan nyi ma'i bka' slob dang mdzub ston 'og /mdo dbus khams gsum gyi sa gnas so sor dngos su bskyod cing / dpe rnying dpe dkon rnams srung skyob dang / 'tshol bsdu/ nyams gso sogs kyi las ka'i brgyud rim nang / gal che'i dpe dkon mang po zhig rnyed son byung ba rnams/bka' gdams gsung 'bum phyogs bsgrig dang / bka' gdams gsung 'bum gces btus/ mes po'i shul bzhag /phyag bris gces btus/ shes bya'i gter bum/ mkhan slob chos gsum sogs kyi dpe tshogs rnams so sor bsdu bsgrigs dang par bskrun zhus dang zhu bzhin pa las/ da lam mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang zhes pa'i dpe tshogs 'di yang / ji skad du/ 'jug pa las/ snying rje'i sems dang gnyis su med blo dang / /byang chub sems ni rgyal sras rnams kyi rgyu/ /zhes pa ltar/ bdag cag gi ston pas chos kyi rnam grangs ji snyed cig gsung pa'i snying po/ mkhyen dang brtse ba'i rang bzhin de nyid thos bsam sgom —2—

sngon 'gro'i zhu tshigapa'i shes rab kyis rang rgyud la skye dgos pa yin la/ de lta bu'i thos bsam bya yul gyi gzhung lugs ni/ 'chos skyob yon tan gnyis ldan gyi bka' dang /bstan bcos rnam dag la rag las pas/ 'dir yang brjod bya gtso bo deng dus kyi spyi tshogs la dgos gal che zhing bsam blo'i slob gso la med du mi rung ba byang chub sems kyi bslab bya dang 'brel ba'i zab chos du ma dang / dpe rnying dpe dkon gyi rin thang ldan pa/ yig tshogs nyung zhing blta bde ba/ grub mtha' phyogs su ma lhung ba/ spyi tshogs dza drag dang rnyog 'dzing sogs kyis yid sems nyams nyes su gyur tshe/ blta klog byas na blo rnal du dbab pa sogs dmigs bsal gyi dgos pa dang / rin thang ldan pa'i dpe tshogs zhig lags pas/ rgya che'i mkhyen dpyod dang ldan pa rnams kyis dgyes gzigs gnang ste/ nang bsam blo'i shes yon gyi 'phel phyogs yang phyi dngos po'i 'phel rgyas dang do mnyam pa'i/ shes 'byor gnyis ldan gyi spyi tshogs bzang po zhig phyogs dang tha gru kun tu yong thub pa'i re smon yang yang zhu ba lags/'di yang mkhyen dpyod lhag bsam zla dang bral ba'i mkhas dbang gzan dkar mchog sprul thub bstan nyi ma'i bka' yis bskul ma gnang bar ji mi snyam du 'dor ma phod par cung zad tsam du smras pa'o/ /dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang nas 'gro 'dul rdo rjes/ 2008lo'i zla 8 tshes 5 nyin phul/—3—

bsdu sgrig gsal ngayand/de yang mnyam med shākya'i rgyal po'i gdul bya'i zhing spyir mi mjed 'jig rten gyi khams/ sgos 'dzam bu'i gling khyad par 'phags pa'i yul/ nye lam gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir/ bstan pa 'dzin cing gsal bar mdzad pa'i skyes bu dam pa/ bstan pa'i gtad rab bdun dang rgyan drug dang mchog gnyis dang / grub pa thob pa'i rnal 'byor pa brgyad cu la sogs pa rnams kyis bstan pa'i bya ba mang du mdzad cing khyad par gangs can gyi khrod 'dir/ chos rgyal mi dbon rnam gsum gyis chos kyi srol gtod pa nas paṇ+ḍi ta zhi ba 'tsho dang / gu ru rin po che pad+ma 'byung gnas la sogs pa paṇa grub dang / saṃ bho ṭa la sogs pa nas bzung ste/ sad mi bdun la sogs pa bstan pa snga dar gyi lo tsā dang dbus gtsang gi mi bcu la sogs pa bstan pa phyi dar gyi bstan 'dzin lo paṇa mkhas grub skar tshogs lta bu byon pa'i nang nas/ bla chen dpyal zhes pa mtshan nyi zla ltar yongs su grags pa/ phyi'i mdzad pa dang nang gi rtogs pa la 'gran pa'i zla thams cad dang bral bas/ mkhas grub rnams kyi gtsug gi cod pan du gyur pa'i mdzad spyod rgyun gyi 'jug ngogs 'di la/ sku gsung thugs kyi che ba'i yon tan mtha' dag mnga' ba bsam gyis mi khyab cing / sar gnas kyi skyes bus kyang brjod par dka' na gzhan lta smos ci dgos/ sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa la sems can gyis blos dpag par dka' na'ang 'on kyang che long tsam zhig 'di —1—

bsdu sgrig gsal bshad/ltar rtogs par bya/ dang por lha las babs pa'i rigs rus kyi che ba dang gcig /lha nas babs nas dpyal du grags te/ mtshan don gyi che ba dang gnyis/ri bo rtse lngar byon nas rgya rgyal po dang gnyen du 'brel bas cho 'brang zhang dbon gyi che ba dang gsum/ de ltar lha las babs nas dpyal du grags/ bod rgyal po sprul pa'i chos rgyal gyi chos blon chen po mdzad pas na/ khrims gnyis mi dbon gyi che ba dang bzhi/ sprul pa'i chos rgyal gyis dpyal dkar nag khra gsum du lung bstan pas/ ngo mtshar lung bstan gyi che ba dang lnga/ gcen dge bshes rgyal po'i mchod gnas su bskur bas/rgyu rkyen rten 'brel khyad par 'phags pa'i che ba dang drug /de las kyang gsang sngags zab lam rdo rje theg par yang dag par zhugs pas/ rgyal po'i sku srung ba yin pas grub rtags nus mthu'i che ba dang bdun/ de las rim pa bzhin byon pa rnams kyis gtsang myang ro'i mthil du lha khang mang po bzhengs shing rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul la byon/ dka' ba brgya phrag du ma spyad nas paṇa grub tshad ldan bsten pa la gdams pa khyad par can zhus/ nyams len mthar phyin pa mdzad pas/ sbyangs pa'i yon tan gyis che ba dang brgyad/ paṇa grub tshad ldan bsten pa rnams la mdo rgyud mang du zhus shing /'gyur yang dag par mdzad nas/ chos mkha' 'gro'i kha rlangs ma nyams pa blangs shing dbang 'byor pas/ dam chos rang 'gyur gyi che ba dang dgu /mi mjed zhing du sems can chags pa nas/ mthar 'khor ba ma stongs kyi bar du 'gro ba'i don mdzad pas na/ gdung rabs rgyun mi chad pa'i che ba'am bstan pa phyogs bcur gsal ba phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i che —2—

bsdu sgrig gsal bshad/ba ste bcu'i sgo nas/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa dpyal gyi gdung rabs rim par byon pa rnams kyi rnam par thar pa che ba bcu ldan zhes pa/ gdung rabs mgo sngon chen po 'di nyid sngon khams ston jo sras kyi mgo sngon tsam gyi bsdus pa zhig mdzad/ yang phyis su 'khon nam mkha' yangs pa'i shes rab kyi ral gris rang gi bla ma dpal rin chen pa'i bka' lung bzhin mgo sngon chen po'i rtsom pa mdzad/ de'i rjes su 'jam dbyangs kyi rgyal pos dpyal kun dga' chos rgyal yan gyi rnam thar kha skong mdzad/ de'i rjes su ka pa bkra shis dpal bzang gis dpyal rdo rje rin chen pa yan gyi gdung rabs chen po rtsom pa mdzad pa rnams gzhir bzhag pa'i steng du/ khri thog zhal mnga' nas yab sras bzhugs pa'i dus thams cad glegs bam gcig tu dril ba ste 'grel 'dug /'grel tshul yang dang po tshigs bcad kyi sgo nas mdor bstan/ de nas tshig lhug gi sgo nas rgyas par 'grel 'dug pa ma zad skabs babs kyi don rnams go bde la nges sla ba'i dgos pa khyad par can zhig tu snang /khyad chos de dag dang ldan pa'i gdung rabs 'di nyid kyi rtsom pa po ni bya bral ba pad ma rdo rje yin kyang / khong gi mdzad rnam cung zad tsam yang bdag gi mthong yul du ma gyur pas blo pham che/ phyag dpe'i 'di'i mjug tu u rgyan chos kyi dbang phyug de nyid dang / khyad par du/ gdung rgyud rin po che ngag dbang grags pa lhun grub rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la sogs pa'i mkhas grub du ma'i zhabs rdul spyi bos len cing gsung las skyes pa'i dus mtha'i bya btang ba pad+ma rdo rje zhes bya ba 'khod pa la dpag na/ dpyal ston rin chen rdo rje'i sras —3—

bsdu sgrig gsal bshad/ngag dbang grags pa lhun grub rgyal mtshan dpal bzang yin pa dang / khong gis paṇ+ḍi ta 'bum phrag gsum pa mchog dang / zha lu mkhan chen dkon mchog tshul khrims dang / mkhan chen dkon mchog lhun grub sogs kyi zhabs la gtugs nas/ mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa slob gnyer mthar phyin pa gnang ba dang / ngag dbang grags pa lhun grub kyi dngos slob bya btang ba pad+ma rdo rje yin pa bcas kyis/ spyi lo'i dus rabs bco lnga pa'i nang du byung ba'i mkhas dbang zhig yin/ khong gis grub mtha' ris med kyi bla ma rnams kyi drung du mdo rgyud rgya mtsho lta bu la slob gnyer mthar phyin pa gnang ba dang / khyad par gsang sngags rnying ma la thugs gzhol bar mdzad/ rin po che'i ming can gyi bskul ngor byang chub thar pa gling du me pho rta'i lo la 'go brtsams nas zhes brtsams lo gsal bar 'khod yod/ skyes chen dam pa de rnams kyis/ grub mtha' ris su ma mchis pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams kyi zhabs la gtugs nas/mdo rgyud kyi chos rgya mtsho lta bu la gsan bzhed gnang bas/ dang ba 'gro ba dang /gdung rabs kyang de nyid dang 'brel bas/ lo rgyus kyi khyab khongs che ba sogs kyi dgos pa mang po yod/'on kyang gdung rabs 'di'i ma dpe ni/ bris ma yin pa dang / skung yig mang ba dang / yig 'bru mi gsal ba dang / brda rnying gis brgyan pa bcas kyis zhus dag byed par 'gal rkyen mi nyung ba zhig 'phrad kyang / dang du blangs nas rgya che'i gzigs pa po rnams la gzigs bde yong ba'i ched/ tshad ldan gyi gzhung dang bstun nas/ zhus dag par bgyis khul yin kyang ma dag pa'i cha yong —4—

bsdu sgrig gsal bshad/nges pas/ lo rgyus zhib 'jug gi mkhas dbang rnams dang / gzur gnas blo ldan rnams kyis dgongs 'char gang mang yong ba'i re 'dun dang bcas/nged dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gis/ mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang zhes pa'i dpe tshogs kyi 〈deb bzhi par 〉btang nas par skrun sdo/sa pa lags/dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gi bstan 'dzin blo gros pas/

dkar chagadang po/ klad kyi don bshad pa/ 1gnyis pa/ gzhung gi don bshad pa/ 6ka1 lha nas lhar babs pa'i che ba bshad pa/ 6ka2 mtshan don gyi che ba bshad pa/ 11ka3 cho 'brang zhang dbon gyi che ba bshad pa/ 12ka4 mi dbon gyi che ba bshad pa/ 14ka5 ngo mtshar lung bstan gyi che ba bshad pa/ 15ka6 rten 'brel khyad 'phags kyi che ba bshad pa/ 17ka7 grub rtags nus mthu'i che ba bshad pa/ 18ka8 sbyangs pa'i yon tan dang / dam chos rang 'gyur gyi che ba gnyis bshad pa/ 22ka10 gdung rabs rgyun mi chad pa'i che ba bshad pa/ 68gsum pa/ mjug gi don bshad pa/ 117

༄7/ /bla chen dpyal gyi gdung rabs rin po che'i za ra tshags zhes bya ba dang / gdung rabs gang gā'i chu rgyun gnyis glegs bam gcig tu bros pa las/ kun gsal me long che ba bcu ldan bzhugs sa/ / dang po/ klad kyi don bshad pa/༄7/ /oṃ swā sti sidhe/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /mi 'jigs bzhi yi yid gnyis kyi ni mi brdzi de bzhin ting 'dzin nyid kyis sdig sgrib zhig /sku gsung thugs kun kun thub brtul zhugs phul byung zug ngu dug kun drung phyung kun tu btul/ /dge legs legs spel bsnyel med legs mkhyen ye shes cher brnyes bde chen ster byed brtse chen bde gshegs che//nyon mongs rtog bcom don mchog yongs rtogs chos mchog 'khor lo yongs bskor mgon skyabs gtso bo khyod mchod do/ /dpal ldan ma ma g.yang sa las rgal chags pa bag chags spangs na'ang nyam thag rnams la lhag par chags/ /rtsal ldan ma ma sdang ba spangs na'ang btang na rtsa bar bcas pa bag la nyal spangs la/ /'phags ma bsam rtag spangs na'ang yang dag khams rnams rab 'byams tshad ma yang dag mtha' la mardorda par gnas/ /bdag cag rnams la

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ pad+ma rdo rje'i gsung chos skor/phan pa sha stag rtag par mdzad ma mar gad mdangs ldan lha la nam yang dad/ /dpal rab rab mang mang po'i dogra las rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshon dpal ldan bla ma ma lus lus can dpal/ /gzhan nur rab byung rmad byung yan tan dbang 'byar gzhon nu'i khyu mchog chos 'dod gzhon nu'i gnyen/ /ye shes shes bya bya ba'i gnas kun kun mkhyen ye shes bzhin mkhyen ye shes mchog gis ji lta'ang mkhyen/ /sgo gsum legs sdom sdom brtson brtson 'grus shes rab dad ldan rnams kyi ston pa mchog la gus phyag 'tshal/ /'od gsal lha las babs pa dpyal gyi rigs/ /cho 'brang mchog gyur se rtsa dmar po'i rgyud/ /gangs can che dgus rab tu bsngags pa yi/ / bla ma'i tshogs rnams spyi bo'i gtsug na rgyal/ /snga 'gyur kun la mkhas pa'i se rtsa ba/ /bstan pa'i gsal byed bsod nams rgyal mtshan dang / /ma rig mun sel shes rab 'od zer te/ /snga dar lo chen rnam gsum rgyal gyur cig /mdo rgyud mdzod 'dzin kun dga' rdo rje dang / /dngos grub kun mdzes kun dga' grags pa dang / /skad gnyis smra ba'i skyeg rtsa lo tsā ba/ /bar dar sgra bsgyur rnam gsum rgyal gyur cig /'khor ba'i skyon gyis ma gos pad+ma'i mtshan/ /—2—

bla r+pā dpyal gyi gdung rabs rin po che'i za ra tshags/mkha' spyod go 'phang brnyes pa'i chos bzang dang / /yi dam lung bstan thob pa'i a mo gha/ /phyi dar lo chen rnam gsum rgyal gyur cig /mang thos tsam gyis lus can sdig pa'i tshogs 'joms shing / /yid la dran na dang ba'i dga' ba rgyun mi chad/ /mtshan tsam gyis kyang skye dgu'i dge legs 'phel byed pa'i/ /bla chen dpyal gyi gdung rabs bdag gis 'dir brjod bya/ /gang gis mdzad pa legs spyad me tog mdzes pa rnams/ /bdag yid gus pas legs blangs blo gsal lag pa yis/ /snyan ngag srad bu'i star la legs legs phreng ba 'di/ /shes ldan skye bo kun gyi gtsug rgyan legs par byos/ /tshogs gnyis rab rdzogs 'dren mchog shākya'i tog /de sras mthu bo paṇa chen shākya'i mtshan/ /rgyal ba gnyis pa rgyal sras chos bzang zhabs/ /bka' drin mtshungs med bde gshegs pad+mo can/ /grub rigs kun gyi gtsug rgyan nyi ma dpal/ /byang chub thugs nyid 'byongs pa'i mkhan chen pa/ /thugs dbang rgyal tshab nyi ma rgyal mtshan dpal/ /kun mkhyen gnyis pa rgyal ba rin chen dpal/ /phan bde'i 'byung gnas rje btsun rin po che/ /—3—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ pad+ma rdo rje'i gsung chos skor/mkhas btsun 'gran zla bral ba kun dga'i mtshan/ /shes bya thams cad gzigs pa'i kun mkhyen pa/ /grub pa'i dbang phyug kun dga' rgya mtsho dang / /gdul bya'i re skong chos 'byor dpal bzang zhabs/ /'gro kun dga' mdzad kun dga' rgyal mtshan dang / /bstan pa'i gsal byed thar pa'i rgyal mtshan dang / /rin chen yon tan gter gyur shes rab mtshan/ /ma rig mun sel 'od srung rgyal mtshan dang / /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i spobs ldan ri dbang pa/ /mi mthun phyogs las rgyal ba rdo rje'i mtshan/ /mkhas sdi/ba chen lnga1 mnyam med nam mkha'i mtshan/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i sras mchog ngag dbang grags/ /dul zhing dge la brtson pa'i sangs rgyas pa/ /mkhyen gnyis dkyil 'khor rgyas pa'i ngag dbang dpal/ /rtsa rgyud bla ma sku drin can rnams la/ /sgo gsum gus pa chen pos phyag 'tshal lo /sngon nas tshogs gnyis goms par gyur mod kyang / /'khor 'khyams 'gro ba drangs phyir snang brnyan rgyu/ /zhing 'dir mdzad pa'i phreng ba rgyun mi chad/ /zhi 'tshos gdul bya skyong ba de la 'dud/ /—4—

bla chen dpyal gyi gdung rabs rin po che'i za ra tshags/zab gsal sgra dbyangs khyod gsung 'brug sgra yis/ /rigs drug rang rang dbang po du ma'i skad/ /rgya cher sgrog pa bdud rtsi'i char rgyun can/ /brgyad khri bzhi stong mdzad pa mnga' la 'dud/ /brjod bral chos dbyings 'gyur ba med pa'i mkha'/ /sgrib gnyis chu 'dzin ma lus rab dwangs nas/ /ye shes don gyi nor bu gsal bar bzhugs/ /mkhyen brtse'i dpal 'byor bsam mi khyab la 'dud/ /bstan pa'i gtso bo shākya'i rgyal po yis/ /bstan 'dzin skyes bu skar tshogs lta bu'i dbus/ /mtshan mo'i mgon bzhin kun gyi 'gran bral ba/ /'od gsal lha babs dpyal gyi gdung rabs kyi/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rnam par thar pa mchog /legs tshogs mdzad pa zab yang rgya mtsho las/ /blo dman bdag 'dras gzhal byar ma mchis kyang / /lugs mchog 'di la dad pa skyes pa yis/ /rab gus slob mas gsol ba btab phyir dang / /skal ldan 'ga' la phan pa srid snyam nas/ /chu thigs zegs 'thor lta bu'i cha tsam zhig /bdag gi blo gros bum pas legs blangs te/ /—5—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ pad+ma rdo rje'i gsung chos skor/sgro skur rang bzo'i nyes skyon kun spangs nas/ /skal ldan dang ba'i gdung ba sel bar byed/ /gnyis pa/ gzhus gi don bshad pa/ka1 lha nas lhar babs pa'i che ba bshad pa/de ltar mnyam med shākya'i rgyal po'i gdul bya'i zhing spyir mi mjed 'jig rten gyi khams/ sgos 'dzam bu'i gling khyad par 'phags pa'i yul/ nye lam gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir/ bstan pa 'dzin cing gsal bar mdzad pa'i skyes bu dam pa/ bstan pa'i gtad rab bdun dang rgyan drug dang mchog gnyis dang grub pa thob pa'i rnal 'byor pa brgyad cu la sogs pa rnams kyis bstan pa'i bya ba mang du mdzad cing khyad par gangs can gyi khrod 'dir/ chos rgyal mi dbon rnam gsum gyis chos kyi srol gtod pa nas paṇ+ḍi ta zhi ba 'tsho dang gu ru rin po che pad+ma 'byung gnas la sogs pa paṇa grub dang / saṃ bho ṭa la sogs pa nas bzung ste sad mi bdun la sogs pa bstan pa snga dar gyi lo tsā dang dbus gtsang gi mi bcu la sogs pa bstan pa phyi dar gyi bstan 'dzin lo paṇa mkhas grub skar tshogs lta bu byon pa'i nang nas bla chen dpyal zhes pa mtshan nyi zla ltar yongs su grags pa/ phyi'i mdzad pa dang nang gi rtogs pa la 'gran pa'i zla thams cad dang bral bas mkhas grub rnams kyi gtsug gi cod pan du gyur pa'i mdzad spyod rgyun gyi 'jug ngogs 'di la/ sku gsung thugs kyi che ba'i yon tan mtha' dag mnga' ba bsam gyis mi khyab cing / sar gnas kyi skyes bus brjod —6—

bla chen dpyal gyi gdung rabs rin po che'i za ra tshags/kyi lta ci smos/ sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa la sems can gyis blos dpag par dka' na'ang 'on kyang che long tsam zhig 'di ltar rtogs par bya/ dang por lha las babs pas rigs rus kyi che ba dang gcig /de ltar lha las babs nas dpyal du grags te mtshan don gyi che ba dang gnyis/ ri bo rtse lngar byon nas rgya rgyal po dang gnyen du 'brel bas cho 'brang zhang dbon gyi che ba dang gsum/ de las bod rgyal po sprul pa'i chos rgyal gyi chos blon chen po mdzad pas na khrims gnyis mi dbon gyi che ba dang bzhi/ sprul pa'i chos rgyal gyis dpyal dkar nag khra gsum du lung bstan pas ngo mtshar lung bstan gyi che ba dang lnga/ lung bstan pa las/ gcen dge bshes rgyal po'i mchod gnas su bskur bas rgyu rkyen rten 'brel khyad par 'phags pa'i che ba dang drug /de las kyang gsang sngags zab lam rdo rje theg par yang dag par zhugs pas rgyal po'i sku srung ba yin pas grub rtags nus mthu'i che ba dang bdun/ de las rim pa bzhin byon pa rnams kyis gtsang myang ro'i mthil du lha khang mang po bzhengs shing rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul la byon/ dka' ba brgya phrag du ma spyad nas paṇa grub tshad ldan bsten pa la gdams pa khyad par can zhus/ nyams len mthar phyin pa mdzad pas sbyangs pa'i yon tan gyis che ba dang brgyad/ paṇa grub tshad ldan bsten pa rnams la/mdo rgyud mang du zhus shing 'gyur/ yang dag pa mdzad nas chos mkha' 'gro'i kha rlangs ma nyams pa blangs shing dbang 'byor pas dam chos rang 'gyur gyi che ba dang dgu /mi marjed zhing du sems can chags pa nas mthar 'khor ba ma stongs kyi bar du 'gro ba'i don mdzad pas na gdung rabs rgyun mi chad pa'i che ba'am —7—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ pad+ma rdo rje'i gsung chos skor/bstan pa phyogs bcur gsal ba phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i che ba ste bcu las/de la dang po ni/ 'gro ba lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten thams cad kyi ston pa / bstan pa rin po che'i mnga' bdag /chos kyi rgyal po chen po/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi mkhyen brtse'i yon tan thams cad gcig tu bsdus pa'i ngo bo/ 'jig rten na nyi ma dang zla ba ltar yongs su grags pa'i lha chen zla 'od 'bar ba zhes bya ba 'di nyid/ bskal ba dpag tu med pa'i sngon rol nas/ mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas zin mod na'ang gzhan don du byang chub sems dpa'i tshul bzung ste/ 'gro ba sems can gyi don la 'jug cing de'ang ma 'ongs dus su 'dod khams gzhan don rgya chen po 'byung bar dgongs nas rjes su 'dzin pa'i phyir bsam gtan gnyis pa'i gnas 'od gsal nas/ bsam gtan dang po'i tshangs chen du babs/ de nas gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi pho brang rin po che du ma las grub pa mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba mchog dang ldan par babs te/ khams gong ma'i lha byang chub sems dpa' zla 'od 'bar ba zhes bya bar mtshan bsngags te/ gzugs bzang zhing lta na sdug pa kha dog bzang po rgyas pa/ mchog dang ldan pa bdud kyi rigs las tha dad pa rnam par dkar ba/ bsod nams kyi mthu bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan pa/shes rab dang snying rje'i bdag nyid can de la/ lha'i grogs po rnams dang shugs kyis 'dud par byed cing / ji skad du/bsod nams dkar ba phyogs kyi zla ba gang / /—8—

bla dpyal gyi gdung rabs rin po che'i za ra tshags/dpal 'byor kun tu rgyas byed 'od 'bar zhing / /yongs su grags pa'i rin chen chu shel brlan/ /lha chen zla 'od 'bar ba gang de rgyal/ /zhes grags pa de nyid kyis phya ye le khyab pa'i bu mo phya za nyi khro ma khab tu bzhes shing 'dod yon du ma la longs spyod cing rtse dga' nyams su myong ba na spyan cher gyis gzigs pa las/ 'dod pa'i bde ba nyams su myong ste lha sras nyi 'od ces pa 'khrungs te des 'phrul dga'i gzhal med khang chen por bkod pa mtha' yas pa dang ldan par babs te/ dge ba'i chos la sems ma g.yos par gnas shing bsod nams kyi mthu smin pas rang gi sprul pa'i 'dod yon du ma la longs spyod de/ ji skad du/gzhan 'byor zil gnon nyi mas skar ma bzhin/ /rang 'byor kun stsol nor bus klu dbang bzhin/ /rgyud pa sel byed 'od kyi mun pa bzhin/ /lha chen nyi 'od 'bar ba rgyal gyur cig /ces pa 'di nyid kyis/ lha grags zon g.yag gi bu mo thang thang ma'am bdud bskos rje'i bu mo bdud mo za chu ris ma khab tu bzhes pa las/ 'dzum pa dang bzhad pa'i bde ba nyams su myong ste/ lha sras dkar mdangs zhes pa 'khrungs nas/ de'i dga' ldan gyi pho brang yid du 'ong ba ru babs te/ chos kyi sgo du ma la dbang bsgyur cing bde bar gnas pa na/ ji skad du/dwangs pa'ang mkha' la rgyu skar bkra ba bzhin/ / —9—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ pad+ma rdo rje'i gsung chos skor/mdangs ldan sku la rin chen rgyan bkra bzhin/ /legs sgra'i gsung dang yon tan rgyan bkra'i thugs/ /gzi chen skar mdangs rgyal po rgyal gyur cig /ces pa 'di nyid kyis btsan shu bo lag ring gi bu mo btsan lcam sgron ma khab tu bzhes pa las/ lag 'chang gi bde ba nyams su myong ste lha sras ma 'od srung 'khrungs te/ des mtha' bral gyi gzhal yas khang mdzes par babs pa las zhes pa 'di nyid kyis rmu nyer rgyal gyi bu mo rmu za khri btsun ma khab tu bzhes pa las/ 'khyud pa'i tshul gyis bde ba nyams su myong ba las/ lha sras khri 'od ces pa 'khrungs te/ des sum cu rtsa gsum gyis gzhal yas khang mchog dang ldan par babs te/ ji skad du/mchod sbyin khri phrag khri yi rab bsgrubs pas/ /dge bde khri phrag khri la longs spyod cing / /lha tshogs khri phrag khri yi gtso gyur pa/ /lha dbang khri 'od ces byar rgyal gyur cig /ces pa 'di nyid kyis srin po khrag med kyi bu mo srin za sngon mo khab tu bzhes pa las 'byud cing sbyor rlung yang mi rgyu ba'i tshul gyis 'dod pa'i bde ba nyams su myong ba las/ lha sras 'od 'dus zhes bya ba 'khrungs te/ des rgyal chen rigs bzhi ru babs te/ 'dod pa'i yon tan du ma la longs spyod cing gnas pas na/ji skad du/bsod nams dpal lhor nyi 'od 'dab ma rgyas/ /—10—

bla chen dpyal gyi gdung rabs rin po che'i za ra tshags/dri bsung snyan pa'i 'khor 'dus bung ba la/ /chos nor sbrang rtsi'i dga' ston 'gyed mdzad pa'i/ /'od 'dus pad+ma mchog gi zhabs pad brtan/ /ces grags so/ /'di rnams ngo bo byang chub sems dpa' yin kyang lha'i 'dod yon la rol cing rtse bas na lha'i bu zhes grags so/ /ma rig mun sel mtshan mo'i mgon gyur pa/ /pad+mo'i gnyen gyur zer phrag stong ldan zhing / /phun tshogs grangs med skar tshogs kun gyis bskor/ /sgrib gnyis sreg byed ye shes me yis bdag /blo mun sel ba'i khri 'od dpal 'byor can/ /'phrin las lhun grub lha dbang pad+ma mchog /'dod pa'i lha mchog rigs drug rgyal gyur cig /ces bsdu ba'i tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /lha nas lhar babs pa rigs rus kyi che ba ste dang po'o// //ka2 mtshan don gyi che ba bshad pa/gnyis pa ni 'dod lha rigs drug gi don mdzad tshar zin du nye ba ni/ rgyal chen rigs bzhi pa'i gtso bo lha sras byang chub sems pa 'od 'dus de nyid kyis/snyigs ma'i dus kyi sems can gdul dka' ba rnams la/ dmigs pa med pa'i thugs rje chen pos nye bar gzigs pa dang / khyad par rje btsun 'jam dbyangs —11—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ pad+ma rdo rje'i gsung chos skor/mchod pa'i phyir rgya'i ri bo rtse lngar babs te/ de'ang me tog mang du babs pas dpyal bkram pa lta bu 'dug pa dang lha de babs pa'i mthus byung bar rtogs nas dpyal zhes brjod do/ /mtshan don gyi che ba ste gnyis pa'o// //ka3 cho 'brang zhang dbon gyi che ba bshad pa/gsum pa ni/ 'dod pa'i sred pa mi mnga' yang / lha las babs pa'i gdung rgyud khyad par can 'di bskyed par bya ba'i phyir/ rgya'i rgyal po hwa shang bha ri'i bu mo rgya mo za ha ri ma khab tu bzhes pa la sras gnyis 'khrungs te/gcen g.yur rtse dang gcung phor rtse'o/ /ji skad du/dad pas rab rtses sangs rgyas bstan la bzhugs/ /shes rab rab rtses gsang sngags kun la mkhas/ /rtse lnga'i rir bsgrubs dngos grub rtse mo brnyes/ /mkhas grub rtser phyin g.yur rtse phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa des glang ston shes rab grags pa'i drung du phyi bya spyod rnal 'byor gyi rgyud gsum bslabs pas mkhas shing nang bla med kyi rgyud la nges pa thob nas ri bo rtse lngar rim pa lnga'i ting nge 'dzin bsgoms pas ye shes lnga grub pa'i mtshan ma brnye+os te/ 'byung ba lnga'i gnod pas mi brdzi ba'i grub chen kun gyi phyi mor gyur pa'/ /ya rabs rtser phyin mi yis chos lugs mkhas/ /rang phyogs rgyal mtho ljon shing rtse mo bzhin/ /—12—

bla dpyal gyi gdung rabs rin po che'i za ra tshags/gzhan phyogs 'joms byed khyu mchog rwa rtse bzhin/ /gcung po phor rtse kun nas rgyal gyur cig /ces pa gcung po phor rtse ni lugs kyi bstan bcos la mkhas shing ya rabs kyi tshul legs par spyod pa des zha rta rgyal gyi bu mo klu 'dul ma khab tu bzhes pa las sras gnyis 'brungs te/ ji skad du/ sku mdzes stobs chen yang rtsal rgyas shing brtsen/ /gsung snyan bka' bsgo gzhan gyis bcom mi nus/ /thugs sgam blo gros gzhan pas ches lhag pa'i/ /dpa' bo stag gi ha las rgyal gyur cig /de yang gcen po stag gi ha las ni rgya bod kyi mtshams su bzhugs shing rgya mo bod la mi gtong / bod mo rgya la mi gtong / nor la bca' sdud pa dang /'jigs sar rgya 'dzugs pa dang / dmag gi ngo bzlog pa la sogs pa kha drag btsan par byed do/ /ji skad du/gsang sngags grub pa brnyes pa'i g.yur rtse dang / /dpal 'byor mnga' thang rgyas pa'i phor rtse dang / /mkhas grags che btsan 'dzoms pa'i ha las te/ /lha sras mi chen rnam gsum rgyal gyur cig /ces bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /rgya rgyal po dang gnyen du 'brel tshul zhang dbon cho 'brang gi che ba ste gsum pa'o// //—13—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ pad+ma rdo rje'i gsung chos skor/ka4 mi dbon gyi che ba bshad pa/bzhi pa ni/ blo gros bkra ba stag gi ri mo bzhin/ /'bangs rnams skyong ba'i gdangs snyan glu dbyangs bzhin/ /blon po stag gi khri gdangs rgyal gyur cig /ces pa mi'i dbang po 'di nyid ni/ bod rgyal po khri lde srong btsan gyi sras ljang tsha lha dbon la rgya'i rgyal po'i bu mo gyim shing kong jo btsun mor blang ba skyel ba la byon pas bod rgyal pos bya dga' dang gnang sbyin cher gnang ste rgya yul du 'gror ma gnang ba bod rgyal po'i blon por bskos shing / rgyal po de'i sras sam gcung pos bsam yas lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang bzhengs pa'i chos blon chen po mdzad de/ de yang chos blon gyi nang nas phyi blon bzang po drug gi nang nas mchog dang gtso bo lta bur gyur cing / bsam yas kyi rab gnas mdzad pa'i dus su glu len pa na/ stag gi khri gdangs kyi zla ba khyab gang bya ba blangs zhes grags so/ /de la sras gcig 'khrungs pa ni/ ji skad du/'jam la sngo ba'i g.yu skra mdzes pa dpal/ /rang gzhan bde la sbyor ba yul gyi dpal/ /legs par lam bzhugs dge la legs par spyod/ /mes chen g.yu skra dpal legs rgyal gyur cig /ces pa/ rje g.yu skra dpal legs de nyid kyis/ btsan po sad na legs kyi nang blon yun ring du mdzad cing pha ma la srid zhu cher byed pas bde legs su gyur —14—

bla chen dpyal gyi gdung rabs rin po che'i za ra tshags/to/ /btsan po la stod 'gro'i phyogs su 'byon pa'i phyag phyi la gtsang la byon nas gcen po la stod la thegs nas blon pos kyang chu'i sman chu khar sku mkhar btab/phu rwa tsa gra skor du dben tsha btab/ tshong 'dus mgur mo'i ne'u sing chen mo nas/dpal rnams kyi zhu rgya gling lha khang man chad chad ris su bcad nas bzhugs so/ /ji skad du/chos rgyal bka' brda bsgyur ba blon po'i mchog /khri bzhi'i gtso bo stag gi khri gdangs dang / /'phrul gyi blon chen g.yu skra dpal legs te/ /sprul pa'i blon chen yab sras rgyal gyur cig /ces pa bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /de ltar khrims gnyis kyi byang ba mang du byas pas khrims gnyis mi dbon gyi che ba ste bzhi pa'o// //ka5 ngo mtshar lung bstan gyi che ba bshad pa/lnga pa ni/ skya chu'i sman chu mkhar du sras gsum 'brungs cing skyid cing 'byor pa'i tshe btsan la stod/ 'gro phyogs nas phyag phebs pa la sku mkhar du spyan drangs nas brnyes pa dang bkur stis sna len bzang pos mnyes par mdzad pas btsan po'i gsung nas khyod la bu tsha du yod gsung / blon po bdag la bu gsum dang bu mo gcig bdog /zhus pas bu gsum 'dir bos shig gsungs/der kho bo cung zad dpal gyis gos dkar po gyon/ bar pa dpal legs mkhan gyis gos nag po gyon/ tha chung mkhan legs brtsegs kyis gos khra bo —15—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ pad+ma rdo rje'i gsung chosaskor/gyon nas lha'i drung du phyin pa na lha'i gsung nas khyod kyi bu thu bo gos dkar po la nye chos la dkar zhing blo rno la yid gzhungs pas dge bshes kyi rigs rgyud rgyas par 'gyur ro/ khyod kyi bu bar pa gos nag po la nye yi lus stobs che zhing gtum la rgod pas/ dpa' bo'i rigs rgyud rgyas par 'gyur ro/ /tha chung ni gos khra bo la nye yi yul gyi chos tshig la mkhas shing srid cing 'byor la longs spyod che bas/ yul dpon gyi rigs rgyud rgyas par 'gyur ro zhes ngo mtshar gyi lung bstan thob bo/ /de ltar rab tu rgyas pas myang rong pa'i mthil mnga' rigs su bcad nas yul dpon byed pa na/phu na dben rtsa 'brog dang bcas/ /mda' na zhing sa chu dang bcas/ /bar na khang sa nar dang bcas/ /dpyal gyi yul shing sa dpyad yin/ /zhes grags so/ /ji skad du/dge la gcig tu dgyes pa'i cung bzang dpal/ /dgra 'dul gcig tu dpa' ba'i dpal legs 'phan/ /gnyen skyong gcig tu nges pa'i mkhan legs brtsegs/ /mtshan gsum dpyal mes mched gsum rgyal gyur cig /ces bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /de yang pho bo dkar po'i rgyud kyi rnam thar 'og tu zhib tu bstan la bar pa dpal legs mkhan gyi rgyud ni smad kyi skom drug pa ni shangs pa la sogs pa yin/ tha chung khra bo mkhan legs brtsegs —16—

bla chen dpyal gyi gdung rabs rin po che'i za ra tshags/kyi rgyud pa ni skyer sna gdong gi lcang ra gru bzhi pa dang ra ja g.yu lung pa dang shab ban skye ba la sogs pa'o/ /ngo mtshar lung bstan gyi che ba ste lnga pa'o// //ka6 rten 'brel khyad 'phags kyi che ba bshad pa/drug pa ni/ ji skad du/pad+ma dbang chen rgyud 'grel sgrub thabs sogs/ /thos pa bzhin bsam bsam bzhin sgom pa ni/ /mkhas pa'i mchog gyur rta mchog rol ba drug /sngags 'chang cung bzang rog rog phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa dpyal dkar po'i rgyud kyi mes po cung bzang dpal te/ rang gi bsod nams phun sum tshogs pa des rgyu byas/ btsan po'i drung du gos dkar po gyon pas rkyen byas te/ rgyal po'i chos bslabs shing bla'i mchod gnas su bskur gsung nas dbus su byon/ rta mchog rol pa dang pad+ma dbang chen la sogs pa'i gsang sngags la mkhas shing / grub pa'i dbang phyug rtags dang mtshan ma brnyes shing / lha gcig rgyal po'i bla'i mchod gnas su mdzad nas cung bzang rog rog ces grags so/ /ji skad du/rgyan pa med par mdog dmar lus bzang mdzes/ /sgrub pa med par ngag nus byin rlabs che/ /rtsol ba med pa'i 'phrin las bzhi grub pa'i/ /mkhan po dam bzang byin chen phyag 'tshal lo/ /—17—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ pad+ma rdo rje'i gsung chos skor/de yang cung bzang dpal la sras gnyis 'khrungs pa'i che ba dmar bzang dang chung ba byin chen no/ /gcen pos yab chos gsang sngags la mthar phyin nas las kha tshar brgyad cu tshegs med du 'grub bo/ /ri bo chung gi rgyab tu dgon pa dmar phub btab nas bzhugs so/ /mkhan po byin chen gyi gdan sa ni/ chos pa gling ste lcam spe'i shar na yod do/ /ji skad du/rta mgrin dbang chen 'grub pa'i dmar bzang dang / /bsod nams dpal gyis mtho ba'i byin chen dang / /grub rtags nus pa thob pa lha'i dpal/ /rigs 'dzin gtso bo rnam par rgyal gyur cig /bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /rgyu rkyen rten 'brel khyad par 'phags pa'i che ba ste drug pa'o// //ka7 grub rtags nus mthu'i che ba bshad pa/bdun pa ni/ ji skad du/lha yi byin rlabs mthu dpal bsam mi khyab/ /nyid kyi byin rlabs lha gcig btsan po'i dpal/ /lha yi grub rtags ngo mtshar 'gro ba'i dpal/ / mkhan po lha yi dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de yang byin chen gyi sras/ mkhan po lha'i dpal te/ gsang sngags snga 'gyur —18—

bla chen dpyal gyi gdung rabs rin po che'i za ra tshags/ la mkhas shing dngos grub rgya chen po brnyes pa'i rtags su chos gos nyi ma'i zer la khel ba dang / sha rkyang dngos su spyod cing rol ba dang / gzhan yang rdzu'aphrul thogs med mnga' bas de dus rgyal po glang dar ma dang bon po 'gras te/ zhang zhung nas mthu gtong ba na/ sku srung la mkhan po lha'i dpal la res mos gsod pa'i nyin mo/ /rgyal po'i dbu thog tu ben pos btso dang gnam lcags phab pa'i tshe/ gnam lcags la phyag gi rdo rje 'phangs pas gnam lcags phye mar brlag nas song ste lo gsum nas rdo rje rnyed pas rdo rje thog 'thab ces grags te phyis thar pa na bzhugs so/ / de lta bu'i grub rtags dang nus mthu la rgyal po mnyes te phu gnod sbyin gang ba bzang po nas mda' cung po yu ba gdong yan chad kyi myang ro chu rgyud kyi sa'i bdag po dang mo dgu'i mda' bying gro lha khang bzhengs te/ rgya phibs nyis brtsegs la gser gser tog la g.yu'i khyung mgo can bzhengs su bcug ste/myang ro'i lha khang dang 'bangs kyis bzhengs pa'i lha khang lha snga shos 'di kho na zhes so/ /rgyan gong las kyang lo brgya'am bdun cu tsam gyi snga zhes so/ /de yang lang gro ba 'khon khus stag ring zhes pa/ nag mo ri gseb pa'i mnga' bdag des yon bdag byas pas lang gro lha khang zhes sam yang na yab mkhan po byin chen gyi nyams gro ba'am zhal gro bas bying gro lha khang zhes grags so/ /ji skad du/spyi rgyud kun las btus dang bya ba'i rgyud/ /nang gi ma mo las tig kun la mkhas/ /lha khang 'dzin cing sgrub khang sgrub mdzad pa'i/ /—19—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ pad+ma rdo rje'i gsung chos skor/dpyal ban chen po dpal brtsegs phyag 'tshal lo/ /de yang mkhan po lha'i dpal la sras dpal brtsegs 'khrungs pa ni yab chos la mkhas shing sgrub pa la brtson pas/ yab kyi gdan sa zin pa/ lha gcig dpal 'khor btsan gyi mchod gnas kyang mdzad do/ /ji skad du/bde gshegs rin chen rin chen chos kyi mdzod/ /dge 'dun rin chen rin chen 'dod dgu stsol/ /mkhyen rab chos dpal dpal ldan thugs rje can/ /dpyal ban rat+na shrī la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa dpal brtsegs la sras rat+na shrī 'khrungs pa ni yab chos ma lus pa la mkhas shing gnubs sangs rgyas rin chen la thabs kyi bzhag pa/ karma ma le'i rgyud gnas bsgrubs pas rtags dang mtshan ma brnyes shing byin rlabs che ba'i grags pas phyogs thams cad du khyab par gyur/ nad pa shin tu nyan pa'ang byin rlabs dang bden bdar tsam gyi 'tsho ba/ dgra bgegs shin tu dar ba'ang sdang mig dang sdigasamadzub tsam gyis rlag par byed par 'gyur ba la sogs pa/sku'i mthu can du grags pa'i tshe blon po skyid zher sman zho chu mkhar mo che na bzhugs pa'i dus su lta ngan sna bdun dus gcig la byung ste/ 'jigs nas mkhan po la thugs dam zhus shing dgongs pa zhag bdun zhus pas myang ror 'bangs kyi kheng log bdun du log ste/ jo bo rat+na byon pas 'tshal phyag rgya dril bu bkrol bas 'tshal/ raka'i 'phreng ba btab pas 'tshal/ swā hwa hūṃ phaṭa bgrangs pas 'tshal ces pa'i grags pa dang ldan te/ de nas thugs dam zhu rgya —20—

bla chen dpyal gyi gdung rabs rin po che'i za ra tshags/gling lha khang phug nyis brtsegs bya skyibs gong ma 'char bas 'og ma non pa/ drwa ba dang tog dang bcas pa bzhengs so/ /jo jo bza' grub dpal ldan zhes pa bud med bzang sdug ngo mtshar can/chos la yid gzhung pa bud med kyi skyon brgyad spangs pa zhig yod pa de nad kyis zin nas/ jo bo gdan drangs te zhag bdun du byin rlabs zhus pas sna phug nas sma gdon gyi gzugs gcong thon nas nad cig car du sos pas/ gus par gyur nas btsun mo phul bas khab tu bzhes nas sras mched lnga 'khrungs te ji skad du/bsod nams mthu ldan dge slong yon tan gsal/ /yon tan shes rab sdom brtson yon tan phyug /yon tan legs pa yon tan 'phags dbang phyug /yon tan mnga' bdag mched lnga phyag 'tshal lo/ /de yang mthu bo yon tan gsal la sras mo gnyis byung ba'i bu rgyud ni skyo ba dang mtha' gnyis so/ /de 'og yon tan shes rab la sras mo gnyis byung ba'i bu rgyud ni mong dang ra gshags pa rnams so/ /lnga tshigs bar pa yon tan grub ni tshangs spyod la gnas pa ste de gsum gdung rabs chad do/ /mtha' dag yon tan legs kyi rgyud pa ni/ dpyal thugs rje dang don grub la sogs pa'o/ /mtha' chung yon tan 'phags ni mkhan po 'phags pa dbang phyug go /thams cad kyang yab mes kyi chos gsang sngags snga 'gyur la mkhas shing / nus mthu dang ldan pa lha khang dang sgrub khang ma nyams par 'dzin pa sha stag go /dpal ldan rgyal po'i bla ma dpal brtsegs dang / /—21—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ pad+ma rdo rje'i gsung chos skor/rtul zhugs nus mthu'i mnga' bdag rat+na dpal/ /'gro ba'i dbang phyug yon tan 'phags dbang phyug /mthu chen sngags pa rnam gsum rgyal gyur cig /b.ro skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /grub rtags nus mthu che ba ste bdun pa' ka8 sbyangs pa'i yon tan dang / dam chos rang 'gyur gyi che ba gnyis bshad pa/brgyad pa ni/phan bde'i 'byung gnas rin chen rgyan mtshan gang / /dngos grub 'byung gnas sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan bsgrengs/ /sangs rgyas 'byung gnas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin/ /ser rtsa 'byung gnas rgyal mtshan phyag 'tshal lo/ /gsang ba snying po dgongs 'dus kun byed sogs/ /snga 'gyur rgyud 'grel mchims phu'i phyag bzhes bcas/ /sgyu 'phrul drwa ba la sogs gsar gyur pa'i/ /gsang sngags mkhas shing grub pa la phyag 'tshal/ /tshogs gnyis gser gyi phung po brjed pa'i sku/ /skad gnyis smra ba'i nyi zlas mgul la rgyan/ /mdzad pa rgya che'i lha tshogs mang bsten pa'i/ /—22—

bla chen dpyal gyi gdung rabs rin po che'i za ra tshags/gser ri ser rtsa dmar por phyag 'tshal lo/ /yab mes chos mkhas yab kyi gdan sa 'dzin/ /mi chos rab mkhas 'bangs skyong yul dpon byed/ /gcen po bla ma mchog tu skur skyed pa'i/ /dpyal ban bsod nams 'dol po phyag 'tshal lo/ /de yang 'di skad thos te mkhan po 'phags pa dbang phyug gi sras ser rtsa dang 'dol po'o/ /gcen pos sman lung na zhang cog gru byang chub 'byung gnas bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar slob gnyer la byon pa na/ zhang gi mtshan 'byung gnas rgyal mtshan zhes mtshan gsol/ thog mar yi ge dang / rtsis dang gsang ba snying po/ dgongs 'dus/ mchims bu'i phyag bzhes/ skyes pa'i rabs la sogs pa bslabs pa na/ shes rab che ba'i tshad du byung ste/ zhang gi zhal nas/slob gnyer 'grus shing blo gros phun tshogs pas/ /mes chen rat+na'i gdung 'tshob nges par 'gyur/ /des tshe se ba'i rtsar gos dmar gyon nas/ /zhugs pas ser rtsa dmar ru zhes grags so/ /lang gro dkon mchog 'byung gnas dang lhan cig shad gi spyan sngar slob gnyer la byon/ gsang sngags snga 'gyur gyi rgyud 'grel dang sgrub thabs las byang bcas pa du ma dang khyad par du/ yang dag pa'i thugs kyi sgrub pa gtsor bor byed pa / mchims bu'i phyag bzhes dang bcas pa dgu la sogs pa lung tsam zhig thob cing bslab pa mthar ma phyin pa na/ bla ma sku gshegs pa'i ltas byung te de'i —23—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ pad+ma rdo rje'i gsung chos skor/tshe slob dpon za ri dang / lang gro dkon mchog 'byung gnas la sogs pas zhal bskos zhus pas na/ zhang gi zhal nas/dpyal bano 'byung gnas rgyal mtshan 'di/ /nga dang dgangs pa mnyam pa la/ /grub thab brgyud pa ma 'byung bas/ /nga yis gdan sa khong la gtod/ /zhes lung bstan nas gshegs pa'i rjes su/ de'i slob ma tshogs nas za rigs 'phags pa ye shes kyi drung du/ rgyud drug la lhag bcu gnyis phra mo nyi shu rtsa gnyis/ mchims bu'i phyag bzhes dgu la sogs pa mkhas par bslab pa'o/ /de nas sgrub pa mdzad par dgongs nas/ dang por khron che lu ma'i phug tu/mchims bu'i phyag bzhes dgu sgrub pa lo mang po mdzad do/ /de nas pa dro stag seng ge'i rdzong du bskyed rim sgom la lo gcig mdzad nas tshur byon te/ dbyar thang se ba'i gseb tu tshogs kyi mchod pa brgya rtsa brgyad phul nas/ se phug gi 'brum nag shug gseb tu rdzogs rim mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin la dus drug tu mnyam par 'jog pa rang gi rtogs pa mchog tu gyur nas/ gzhan la dge ba spel ba'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa dang / stong phrag nyi shu rtsa lnga pa dang / stong phrag bco brgyad pa dang / khri pa dang / brgyad stong pa dang / sdud pa tshigs su bcad pa dang / rdo rje gcod pa dang / rnam par mi rtog par 'jug pa dang / ko shi kas zhus pa dang / zla ba snying pos zhus pa dang / rab kyi rtsal gyi rnam par gnon pas zhus pa dang / sgo nyi shu rtsa lnga pa dang / mtshan brgya —24—

bla chen dpyal gyi gdung rabs rin po che'i za ra tshags/rtsa brgyad pa dang / tshul brgya lnga bcu pa dang / lnga brgya pa dang / bzhi stong pa ste/yum sras bcu bdun du grags pa po ti sum cu bzhengs pa na/mthing shog rab sngo dmar ba'i mdangs can la/ /btso ma'i gser gyi 'phul yig mtshar ba ni/ /ston ka'i nam mkha' chu 'dzin bral ba la/ /nyi ma 'char kha'i stod 'phreng mdzes pa bzhin/ /yang na/ char sprin kun nas mthug po'i dbyings/ /'od zer 'bar ba'i glog 'phreng 'byug pa bzhin/ /dbyibs legs brkos pa dngul gyi spar bkab ni/ /gangs ri'i brtsegs ma mnyam du dngar ba bzhin/ /za 'og dar dang be'u phrug phying ba dang / /sha lpags mnyen la bzo rigs khyad 'phags pa'i/ /na bza' sna lnga'i glegs bam kun nas mdzes/ /yid bzhin rin chen gab rtser bstsal pa bzhin/ /zhes pa de lta bu'i bzhengs pa la rab gnas rgya cher mdzad cing / 'khor gsum yongs dag gi mchod sbyin yang mdzad la/ lan grangs brgya rtsa brgyad du gsung yang bsgrags so/ /de nas rā dza gad thog gi mchod rten dkar po bzhengs pa ni/mchu zheng 'tsham la dkar zhing lhun chags pa/ /ri bo gangs can bzhin du lham mer gda'/ /rdza thog 'khor lo dmar pos brgyan pa ni/ /—25—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ pad+ma rdo rje'i gsung chos skor/dus mtshams sprin gyi ri rtse g.yogs pa bzhin/ /zhes pa de lta bu'i mchod rten bzhengs pa la rab gnas mnga' gsol nas/'khor gsum yongs dag gi mchod sbyin rgya chen po mdzad do/ /de nas re zhig cig nas/ rig pa'i gnas lnga la mkhas pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po smṛ ti dzñā na kirti zhes pa rgya gar nas lo tsā ba phra la ring ba bya na gdan drangs pa lo tsā ba lam du grongs nas paṇ+ḍi ta 'khyams pa dang / sngon las chung ngu zhig gi rgyus/ shangs sam rta nag gang rung gi yul dpon phyug po zhig gis gral du bzung nas/ gshegs su mi gnang ba la dpyal ban chen pos/sprin nag bsdus pas nam mkha'i snang ba nyams/ /glog 'phreng drag pos 'brug sgras mi rnams rgyal/ /rdo yi ser bas gnam lcags snying po can/ /kha bas yud tsam zhig la yul kun bcom/ /zhes pa de lta bu'i dpyal gyi mthu che bas dgra'i grags pa bcom ste/ yul dpon srog dang bral ba la thug par gyur cing / dngangs pas shin tu ring bar dpyal ban chen po la bzod par gsol zhing paṇ+ḍi ta phul te de gdan drangs nas/sman lung du byon pa la sgra dang / tshad ma bslabs pa mthar phyin nas sgyu 'phrul drwa ba khri drug stong pa de'i snying po/ de'i snying po mtshan brjod de'i 'grel pa/ bar pa 'jam dpal gsang ldan kun rig bsdus pa'i 'grel pa/ smra sgo mtshon cha la sogs pa mang du zhus shing bsgyur nas gtan la phab pa/ paṇa chen mya ngan 'das nas gdung yang sman lung na yod par grags so/ /phal cher mdo khams su —26—

bla chen dpyal gyi gdung rabs rin po che'i za ra tshags/gshegs par 'dod/ de nas lo tsā ba dgung lo bdun cu lon pa na sku bgres shing spyan mi gsal yang / thugs stobs che bas btsan po'i sku yon zhu ba dang gdung rgyud gyi dpal bskyed pa dang / 'gro ba'i don tshogs bsags pa'i zhing bya ba'i phyir sman lung 'phrul gyi lha khang bzhengs pa ni/ shing bzo ba zhus yon ston pa / lha bzo ba dar rgyal dbang po dang / gser bzo ba mgon ban lhun pos byas nas rgya yi gtsug lag khang gnam gyi the'u la dpe byas te/ bya skyibs nyis rim rgya phibs rtse lnga ni rgya nag lhun po rtse mo lnga pa bzhin re re'ang rtse mo lnga la gser tog can rje btsun 'jam dbyangs re re rtser gsal ba bzhin/ gru bzhi nyis brtsegs sgo bzhi dod pa ni/'dod lha'i pho brang yid chags mdzes pa bzhin/ /de nang rnam par snang mdzad bzhugs pa ni/ /rnam snang gangs chen mtsho dang gnyis su med/ /gzhal yas khang chen 'phrul gyi gtsug lag khang / /rnam par rgyal byed dbus na lha dbang bzhin/ /bstan srung mahā kā la lcam dral ni/ /mthu nus gzi 'od gzhan las khyad par 'phags/ /'khrul gyi bzo bo mkhas pa rnam gsum ni/ /bi sho kame'i rnam 'phrul yin par nges/ /zhus pa de lta bu'i lha khang ni dpyal ban chen po des bka' bstsal cing sras mched gnyis kyi lag len dang dka' ba spyad nas bsgrubs so/ /de nas yang —27—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ pad+ma rdo rje'i gsung chos skor/dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi dus mchod pra sti ha ra zhes pa rdo rje gdan na ji ltar byed pa bzhin btsugs so/ /de'i gcung po bsod nams 'dol po ni/ yab chos la mkhas shing yab mes gdan sa chos pa gling bzung nas rgyas par mdzad de/ gcen pos bzhedas pa'i rin po che'i gsung rab rnams la gsung sgrog brgya tshar mdzad cing / rang gis kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa khri brgyad stong pa dang / 'phags pa brgyad stong pa gser la bzhengs te/ de'i rgyud pa spyan mnga' ba ston pa brtson 'grus pa sku mched dang jo sras stag dar ba la sogs pa gsal ba'i blo gros dge ba'i dal las/rab tu 'bar ba'i legs bshad phyogs bcur 'phro/ /lus can snying gi pad+ma rgyas mdzad pa'i/ /nam mkha'i snying po 'dra la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchog tu dkar chos yar ngo bzhin du rgyas/ /rab tu bsil zer lus can gdung ba 'joms/ /gsung rab snying po kun da rgyas mdzad pa'i/ /gcung po zla ba 'dra la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de yang / bla ma chen po dpyal ban ser rtsa mkha' dbyings lta bu la/sras gnyis nyi zla lta bur sku 'khrungs te/ gcen gsal rab snying po ni/ yab chos yang dag dang / phur pa dang / mchims bu'i phyag bzhes dbang byang dang /sgrub byang la sogs pa dgu la mkhas shing sgom sgrub dang / bzlas brjod la —28—

bla dpyal gyi gdung rabs rin po che'i za ra tshags/brtson pas yab kyi gdan sa non cing / sku brjid la gsung brtan cing thugs sgam pas kun gyi mchod pa'i gnas su bskur bar gyur to/ /bla ma des kyang sku gsung thugs kyi rten rnying pa gso zhing gsar ba bzhengs pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi dus mchod la sogs pa bsgrubs so/ /gcung mchog rab snying po'i rnam thar 'og tu 'chad/ ji skad du/bka' drin mtshungs med ser rtsa lo tsā dang / /bsod nams grangs med bsags pa'i 'dol po dang / /rab dkar blo ldan gsal rab snying po ste/ /yab mes bstan 'dzin rnam gsum rgyal gyur cig /ces bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /sngags 'chang dgra las rgyal ba'i blo gros dang / /dad brtson dran ldan mkhas pa shes rab rgyal/ /chos brtson dge ba'i bslab chos grags pa gsum/ /yab mched shes rab blo gros phyag 'tshal lo/ /de yang gcen gsal rab la sras mched gsum las/ gcen rgyal po'i blo gros ni lung gnyis kyi bstan bcos la mkhas shing yab chos gsang sngags snga 'gyur la mkhas pas gzhung bshad dang / sgrub pa'i phyag bzhes mchims bu'i chos dgu la nyams len dang khyung po lo tsā ba chos kyi brtson 'grus la tshad ma bslabs nas chos gtam dang / mo la slob pa la mkhas pa/ gzhan nang zil gyi non pas gang du phebs kyang tshogs dpon mdzad de/ bsod nams che bas yum —29—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ pad+ma rdo rje'i gsung chos skor/bar pa dang / gzungs 'dus dang / lang kar gshegs pa la sogs pa bzhengs shing lha khang dang gsung rab rnying pa gso ba dang / mchod pa la brtson pa'o/ /bar ba shes rab rgyal ni/ dge ba'i blo gros can du yul gyi srid che zhing / yab chos la thos sgrub kyang ci rigs su mdzad do/ /de'i brgyud pa dge bshes 'phags pa la sogs pa'o/ /gcung po chos kyi grags pa ni lo brgyad la 'bri klog la mkhas shing / bcu bzhi la rab tu byung nas yab chos bslabs te/ nyer gnyis la gsang 'dus gsungs shing 'chad rtsom/ sgrub pa la brtson pas 'phrin las che bas thog mar sman lung lha khang gi khyams dang sgo khang brtsigs shing / de nas yum bar pa stong phrag nyi shu lnga pa dang / mdo mya ngan las 'das pa dang /dkon mchog sprin dang / lang kar gshegs pa la sogs pa rin po che la bzhengs la/ de nas sa phugs kyi kun dga' rwa ba bzhengs shing byams chos btsugs so/ /de nas sman lung gi gtsug lag khang ngo mtshar ba'i rten dang mchod cha mang po'i bzhugs sa bzhengs ste/sku gzugs bzhugs pa de bzhin gshegs sku'i tshul/ /dam chos 'byung gnas gsung rab gtsug lag khang / /ye shes thugs bzhugs gtsang khang par bur mtho/ /ngo mtshar rten mchod bkra ba'i gnas de bzhengs/ /zhes so/ /de ni sdom brtson can yin pas rgyud chad ces zer ro/ kha cig ni de'i rgyud pa shes rin pa yin zer ro/ /bsod nams rgyan mtshan ye shes rin chen tog /—30—

bla chen dpyal gyi gdung rabs rin po che'i za ra tshags/rmad byung yon tan mu tig phreng bas brgyan/ /bslab gsum lhab lhub chos kyi sil snyan sgrog / bstan pa'i srog shing can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bsod nams rgya mtsho'i dbus nas legs byon zhing / /mi dbang rgyal mtshan rtse na nyer mdzes pa/ /'gro la phan bde yid bzhin stsol mdzad pa'i/ /rin chen dbang po'i tog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bsod nams dpal che lha dbang skad la mkhas/ /sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin/ /gtan tshigs la sogs sna lnga la mkhas pa'i/ /skad gnyis smra ba'i mchog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub mchog la dga' bas thugs bskyed nas/ /chos dkar dkar phyogs bstan pa'i rgyan mtshan bsgrengs/ /thun mong sgrub pa'i stobs nus cher brnyes pa'i/ /mthu chen byang chub rgyan mtshan phyag 'tshal lo/ /de yang dpyal rgyal ba'i blo gros kyi sras mched gnyis las/ gcen po bla ma bsod nams rgyan mtshan/ ni/ byang chub sems dpa' skye ba bdun pa ste/ sku 'khrungs dus yang ltas khyad par can byung zhing / 'bri klog slob mi dgos par mkhyen cing / yab chos gsang sngags rnying ma'i chos la mkhas par gyur/ dgung lo bcu drug la yab sku gshegs nas dgongs rdzogs rten bzhengs rnams grub —31—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ pad+ma rdo rje'i gsung chos skor/nas rnying ma'i sgro 'dogs chod kyang / thos pas mi ngoms par chos kyi don du srog kyang gtong phod pas chos btsal ba'i phyir/ 'gos lo tsā ba la 'phags skor zhu bar dgongs nas/ ra tsa se phug na khu bo jo btsun chos kyi grags pa bzhugs pa'i drung du byon nas bdag gi rnying ma'i skor la rgyud drug /le lag bcu gsum/ phran nyi shu rtsa bzhi rnams lobs la/ da gsar ma zhig nyan du 'gro bar zhu zhus pas/ khyod gsar ma nyan na yang dag dang ming dang lha grangs kyang 'dra bar 'dug pas 'di yang slob par 'dun na slob shog gsungs nas kyi rdo rje'i rgyud phyed gtub ma zhig kyang gnang / de nas gnya' nams rong du phebs/'gos khug pa la rta de phul/ chos gsung tsa na/ nyan pas chog snyam nas bzhugs pas/ nyin gcig bla ma la bsnyen bkur zhu mi zhig byung nas de'i phyag phyir phyin nas log pa'i sa bar yang cig tu slebs pa dang / jo sras khyod ci la 'ongs pa yin gsungs/ bdag 'phags skor zhig zhu ba legs zhus pas khyod la 'bul ba ci yod gsung / sngar yang rta 'di phul ba yin lags/ da rung yul na ban bun 'dra bdog pas zhabs tog bgyid par zhu byas pas khams pa dge skyabs kyi 'phags skor chos thun re la gser srang dgu pa'i 'bul ba byas yod/de min tshos de bas kyang 'bul ba mang ba phul/ khyod la 'bul rgyu med pa'i 'phags skor nyen rgyu mi 'ongs gsungs nas/ rta mthur 'phrog chibs bskyod nas gshegs song / 'phags skor thar thor min pa tshang ma byung bas/ bsam mno zhig btang bas/ rang la yod pa'i rta ni shor/ dgos pa'i chos ni ma gnang / 'on kyang byas pas lo tsā ba 'gos la'ang chos rnams rang byung du byung ba —32—

bla chen dpyal gyi gdung rabs rin po che'i za ra tshags/ma yin/ lho bal du byon pas byung ba yin/ nga rang yang lho bal du phyin chog snyam/thugs kyi go cha cher 'khrungs shing thugs rtogs che la mi ldog pa'i spobs pa mnga' bas/ lho bal du 'gro ba'i grogs sgug pa la sna nam tshong 'dus su a tsa ra la zas skad chu skad slob kyin bsdad pas/ nyin gcig khams pa'i grwa pa 'ga' byung / khyed gar 'gro dris pas/ dang por bal yul du 'gro /de nas rgya gar du 'gro /bla ma dang rten khyad can la byin rlabs zhu zer/ 'o na nga yang 'gro bla ma la khams bde byas la/ yong gi byas nas bla ma can phyin/ phyag 'tshal nas/bdag bal por 'gro bar zhus nas/ bla ma'i zhal nas/ bal por 'gro ba la srog phar phyed tshur phyed yin/ 'gro dang mi 'gro khyod rang ltos gsungs/ jo mo'i zhal nas/ de tsam gshegs tsa na/ chos ston cig gsol la byon zer/ der chos ston zos phyin tsa na/ grogs rnams song gda'/ 'grogs par phyin phyin kyang rjes ma zin par sa bar yang zhig tu shing sdong po zhig la po ti bkal nas gzims/ sang snga mor bzhengs byon pas/ tsha lam gcig tsam du slebs tsa na po ti lus pa dran sos/ der nga bal por 'gro ba la/ bod kyi dpes phan mi thogs snyam tsa na/ 'on kyang chos spangs pa'i las gsog snyam nas/ len du byon pas rngon pas ri dwags bshor ba'i phyir nags la me bcug nas 'dug pas/ po ti yang tshig yod snyam tsa na/ po ti shing sdong dang bcas pa ma tshig pa 'dug pas nga la chos 'dis phan thogs pa zhig yong bar 'dug dgongs nas cung dga' ba zhig byung gsungs/ de nas byon pas grogs kyi rjes yang zin bal yul mthil du slebs/ 'di na chos su mkhas dris pas/ dpal 'jigs med grags pa bya —33—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ pad+ma rdo rje'i gsung chos skor/ba nā ro'i dngos slob chos rnams bum pa gang byo'i tshul du thob pa'i grub thob cig pi pi ha ra na bzhugs kyi yod zer/ der phyin pas bla ma dang mjal/dpyal gyi 'go mdzad nas/ cha rkyen bsdus nas tshogs 'khor bshams/ mched grogs rnams chang gi myos nas bla ma bzhin mi sdug cing dmangs rigs yin pa dang bod skad ma shes pas rkyen can byas nas glu blangs/bla ma bal po pham 'thing zer/ /ma mthong tsa na sgra re che/ /mthong nas gam du gtugs tsa na/ /glang rgan dar gyis g.yogs gda'o/ /zhes pas dam tshig la sel bzhugs nas/ gtor ma nam mkhar 'phar byung bas snod mi ldan par dgongs nas song zhig pa'i brda dang / bka' skyon mang po gsungs pas/ glu len mkhan rnams rang gnong ges sgo mi thob pa tsam du bros song / jo sras glu len pa la ma the bas/ bla ma'i drung du bsdad pas bla ma bzhin mi sdug kyang ma dad pa ma byung cing / dam tshig la sel kyang ma zhugs pas rjes su 'dzin par zhus pas gnang ste/ dang por bcom ldan 'das ma bdag med dkyil 'bor tu dbang bskur bar zhus/ de nas dgyes pa rdo rje'i dkyil 'bor du dbang bskur/ rgyud gsum man ngag dang bcas pa gnang / kyai rdo rje la 'grel pa mi 'dra ba bcu gnyis dang bcas pa gsan cing / bha wa bha dras mdzad pa'i 'grel pa yang bsgyur bya'o/ /gzhan 'grel pa phal cher thugs su tshud/ gzhan rgyud dang man ngag mang du gsan/ sgom pa gtum mo sbar ba la semasabazung de —34—

bla chen dpyal gyi gdung rabs rin po che'i za ra tshags/nas bslab tshigs ring mo la sogs pa la sems bzung cing / khrid bka' thams cad tshar bar zhus/ chos thun re la gser gyi maṇ+ḍal re phul/ bal por bzhugs/ de nas bal po'i rten rnams la mchod pa re phul/ byin rlabs zhus/khyad par du 'phags pa shing kun gyi drung du maṇ+ḍal phul/ gsol ba btab/bdag gi bslab pa'i chos 'di rnams/ zang zing lta phyir lta ci smos/ lus srog la yang mi lta bar don du gnyer ba rnams la sbyin par bya'o/ /sems can la phan pa rgya chen po 'byung bar shog snyam du thugs bskyed pa'i tshe/ dpal dgyes pa rdo rje'i rten dang brten par bcas pa zhal gzigs shing nam mkha' la rtsa ba'i sngags kyi sgra sgrog par gsan te byin rlabs cher zhugs/ de nas bod du byon/sku tshe'i stod la sngags rnying ma'i grwa pa btsugs/ bar du gsar rnying gnyis ka dar/ sku tshe'i smad la rnying ma nub/ gsar ma dar byung bas/ nga'i pha chos nub tu phang gsung nas/ gsang ba snying po tshar re'i gdal po zhig long gsung gda'/de'i dus mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje bdud 'dul ma zer ba'i ma jo rgan mo zhig yod pa des/ bla ma lo tsā bas lho bal du byon pa'i chos kyi skyos ma zhig zhu zer bas/thog mar dbang gi rgyud smin par byed dgos pas dgyes pa rdo rje'i dbang bskur/rgyud la 'grel drug gi rjes su 'brang ba'i bshad pa btsugs so/ /de nas 'byor pa don yod par bya ba'i phyir/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' rgyu dngul dkar bre chen bzhi cu zhe bzhi la/ dngul dkar bur lugs dang kha che'i bzo bo mkhas pas kha che'i bzo dang mthun par gar bu ma'i tshad du bzhengs te/ thugs ka na bcom ldan 'das thub pa chen po'i chos 'khor bskor ba'i dus kyi bzhugs khri'i dum bu —35—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ pad+ma rdo rje'i gsung chos skor/dpyal se rtsa dmar ru'i dbu skra ring bsrel/ thugs dam phreng ba rnams bzhugs so/ /de la ji skad du/lhun po'i shar phyogs dkar ba lha sku bzhin/ /gang ba'i zla ba dkar ba khyod zhal bzhin/ /rgyud dkar dkar khra khyod zhal 'dzum pas mdzes/ /gangs ri dkar po khyod sku'i 'od 'phro ba/ /de nas rā dza se phug tu rgya'i mthing shog la/ btso ma'i gser gyis bris pa'i gser 'bum stag sgro ma bzhengs pa ni/mo man mdog 'dra'i 'od chags mthing shog la/ /dang ga'i mdog 'dra btso ma'i gser yig ni/ /ut+pal kun nas rgyas 'dra pad+ma'i dbus/ /ze'u 'bru gser po snum la brjid chags pa/ /de nas rgyud 'grel dang / chos phran bsgyur ba la sogs pa rgyas par rnam thar las shes par bya'o/ /rten gsum bzhengs pa rnams la/ mchod pa dang rab gnas dang dga' ston yang rgya cher mdzad nas dgung lo drug cu rtsa brgyad la sa g.yo ba dang / gnam grum pa la sogs pa'i ltas dang bcas nas dag pa'i zhing du gshegs so/ /gcung po byang chub rgyal mtshan ni sngags kyi nus pa dang mthu dang byin rlabs che bas gzhan gyi mi brdzi zhing pha rol zil gyis gnon pa'i stobs kyi rgya gar dang / rgya nag gi bar du 'gro po la sus kyang mi 'tshe ba'i rgya gtsugs so/ /—36—

bla chen dpyal gyi gdung rabs rin po che'i za ra tshags/tshong dpon mdzad pas 'byor pa mi zad pa la longs spyod cing / chos la mchod pa dang phong ba la sbyin gtong mdzad de/ dpyal mthu chen zhes par grags so/ /bstan pa'i srog shing bsod nams rgyal mtshan dang / /byang chub rgyal mtshan mi mthun phyogs las rgyal/ /nag po zhang lha 'gro ba'i skyabs gcig pu/ /'dren mchog bla ma rnam gsum rgyal gyur cig /ji skad du/'gro kun dga' 'byung dam chos bdud rtsi'i ros/ /ye shes lus rgyas dri med rdo rje'i sku/ /kun dga'i gsung dang rdo rje'i rnal 'byor thugs/ /skyes mchog rnams kyi gtsug rgyan phyag 'tshal lo/ /dngos grub kun brnyes lhan cig skyes dga'i bdag /rdo rje slob dpon go 'phang mchog la gnas/ /'phrin las stobs ldan de de'i yab mched po/ /dpyal ban nag po zhang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de yang / bla ma bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyi sras/ kun dga' rdo rje de/yab chos gsang sngags gsar rnying ma lus pa la mkhas shing yo ga gnubs lugs kyang mkhyen la/ myang stod khyung rin chen grags la tshad ma rnam nges kyang gsan te shin tu mkhas par gyur kyang / yon tan gyis chog ma shes pas bal por byon te/ gnas lnga paṇ+ḍi ta/ a ma ra tsaṇ+ḍadang / pu ka shrī bha dra la sgra tshad ma —37—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ pad+ma rdo rje'i gsung chos skor/slob pa mthar phyin nas/ dgyes rdor dang / bde mchog dus 'khor la sogs pa'i rgyud 'grel mang po gsan zhing / khyad par du/ bla ma haṃ ngu dkar po'i drung du/rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i byin rlabs dang / gzhung drug sbyin sreg dang bcas pa'i zhal gdams zhus nas bsgrubs pas yi dam mang po'i zhal gzigs shing dngos grub gnang la/ bla ma de yang thugs mnyes nas phag mo'i thod sku dang mai dhī pa'i phyi rol mchod pa'i maṇ+ḍal/ kha ṭaṃ kha dang / rus rgyan/ ting ting shags la sogs pa byin rlabs kyi gnang sbyin dang / lung bstan dang bcas pa gnang nas bod du phebs/ zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos 'khor bskor bas/ bu slob nam mkha'i skar ma lta bur 'dus pa'i nang nas mchog tu gyur pa drug la cho 'phreng dang / mkhyen rab mchog tu gyur pa sa skya pa 'khon bsod nams rtse mo/ mkhas pa'i mchog tu gyur pa 'u yug pa/ dbyar dbu ma pa dang / nus pa che ba'i mchog tu gyur pa rang lhas sdeng pa yang dag rdo rje'o/ /mthar phyin gyi slob ma gsum la/ drag sngags kyi nus pa mthar phyin nas/ gdon bgegs dang log 'dren tshar gcod nus pa dran ston mtha' gral/ yi dam gyi bsnyen sgrub mthar phyin nas/ slob ma la dngos grub gter nus pa hri'u chung ba lce mdo sde seng ge /sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan btsugs nas rim gnyis mthar phyin nas rtogs pa mngon du gyur pa gnyubs rgyal tsha rin po che 'bar ba'i mtha' can gnyis ni/ sgrub pa bka' brgyad kyi man ngag dang las sbyor la mkhas pa sgyi mkhar la ra jo btsun kha la me 'bar/ phag mo gzhud drug gi bskyed rdzogs gdams pa la mkhas pa za ston kha la me 'bar/ tshe gcig lus gcig la mchog gi dngos grub brnyes pa dpyal lo tsā ba kun dga' grags —38—

bla chen dpyal gyi gdung rabs rin po che'i za ra tshags/so/ /de la sogs pa'i 'gro ba'i don dpag tu med pa mdzad pas/ mchod rten dkar po nas/ rdo bug pa can man la/ lha dmar mo mi sgom pa dang / chang skyar bskyur mi 'thung ba'i mi med pa byung ngo / /bla ma des/ khri gsum gyi gtsug lag khang dang cung pa ban mtsho'i lha khang dang / sman lung mchod khang la sogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa bzhengs/ gsung rab ni rgya'i btsun mo gan shog srab 'jam la/ gser zhun mas bris pa'i mdo mang shin tu mtshar ba bzhengs pa ni/rgya shog sngon po tshos kyi byugs pa la/ /btso ma'i gser yig gser po 'od 'phro ba/ /kun nas dwangs pa yid bzhin mtsho yi steng / /ngur ba khyu lding phreng du dngar ba bzhin/ /zhes so/ /de nas shangs brag dmar dpal gyi gzhal yas su sgrub pa mthar phyin pas/ yi dam gyi lha dpag tu med pa'i zhal gzigs/ bskyed rdzogs la brtan pa thob/ khyad par rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dang dus nam yang mi 'bral bar gsung gleng dang gdam pa thob/ mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi snyan pa'i grags pas khyab pas/ dbus gtsang gi dge ba'i bshes gnyen mang po la gdam pa'i gnas bstan nas/ gdul bya rtag 'dzin can gdul ba'i don du/ gzugs/ sku'i bkod pa chos dbyings su bsdus nas/ dgung lo bzhi bcu rtsa drug la bde ba can du thegarbasdo rngosko+o/ /'gro mgon lce sgom pa'i gsung nas/ dpyal lo tsā ba kun dga' rdo rje khong deng sang bde ba can na grwa pa bcu lhag tsam la chos gsung gin 'dug /kho bo —39—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ pad+ma rdo rje'i gsung chos skor/rang yang lan 'ga' re mjal/ khong la mos pa gtso der gsol ba thob gsungs/ sku gdung zhu ba'i khrag gi ngos la chos 'byung gi nang du bcom ldan 'das ma zhal gnyis mar byon pa dang / sku gdung la bde mchog dang / rnal 'byor ma dang / ring bsrel bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'brungs so/ /nang rten du 'jam dbyangs kyi sku 'di nyid/ bal por khri yol dang bcas pa bzhengs shing thugs ka na grub thob mang po'i gdung ring bsrel/ paṇa chen haṃ ngu dkar po'i dbu skra thugs dam phreng ba/ bla ma rang nyid kyi ring bsrel bzhugs shing / rab gnas kyi dus 'jam dbyangs dngos su thim pa dang / me tog gi char bab cing /mi ma yin dang / chos skyong gis bsus pa la sogs pa byung bar gda'o/ /bskyed rdzogs kun la nyams len mthar phyin pas/ /zag med dga' bzhi'i bde bas rgyud gang nas/ /zung 'jug rdo rje 'dzin mchog brnyes pa yis /mtshungs med kun dga' rdo rje rgyal gyur cig /ces so/ /gcung po byang chub rgyal mtshan gyi sras/ nag po zhang lha steng/ 'dod lha dang chos skyong grub shing las mgon dran du bkol bas dgra bgegs thams cad skrag par byed pa des/ yab kyi mdzad srol tshong dpon mdzad cing / de dag gi khri gsum gyi mdun du/ las sgo gsum gyi tshong zong la/ sho gam bsdus shing /khams pa dang rgya'i ja dar la sum cu sig len pa dang / zho chu nas gnas sngon gyi bar la me tog shar ma bsdus pa la sogs pa kha srol bzang po len pa'o/ /de la nag po zhang lha'i brgyud pa sra pe ba'o/ /—40—

bla r+sā dpyal gyi gdung rabs rin po che'i za ra tshags/kun mkhyen mkhyen rab mnga' zhing lus can kun/ /dga' mdzad thugs rjes gzhan phan grub na dga'/ /grags pa'i snyan pas sa gsum yongs grags pa/ /gcen po lo sgom mchog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bsod nams stobs ldan dge ba'i dpal gyi gzhi/ /mngon mtho'i nges legs rgyur gyur legs spyod can/ /chos dang zang zing dpal gyi rab 'byor pa'i/ /khri gsum jo sras dpal legs rgyal gyur cig /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i go 'phangs kun brnyes shing / /mthu stobs drag po'i rtsal gyis 'gro ba sgrol/ /rig pa'i gnas lnga sbyangs pa mthar phyin pa'i/ /gcung po skyeg tsha sgra sgyur phyag 'tshal lo/ /de yang bla ma kun dga' rdo rje'i sras gsum las/ gcen po bla ma kun dga' grags ni/ yab chos ma lus pa la slob dpon gyi go 'phang thob nas/myang stod brang thang du jo btsun khyung la tshad ma bslabs pas mkhas par gyur kyang / chos 'tshol mi ngoms pa dang / yab mes kyi bka' srol bkag pa'i phyir/rgya gar yul dbus su byon nas/ mkhas grub rnams kyi zhabs la btud nas/sgra tshad la mkhas par gyur nas/ rgyud 'grel dang / gdams pa zab mo du ma khong du tshud cing lo bcu gsum bzhugs nas/ da ni bod du mkhas rnams gdan drangs la 'gro don bya snyam nas/ ri bo bya rkang can du bla ma dang mkha' 'gro la —41—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ pad+ma rdo rje'i gsung chos skor/chosags mchod phul/ gsol ba btab pas/bzhin bzang dal la yid 'ong ma/ /sngo sangs rus pa'i rgyan gyis spras/ /sku bzang gzugs dang lang tshos brgyan/ /ma ye shes mkha' 'gro dngos dang mjal/ /dus skad cig nyid la byin rlabs zhugs/ /bde 'bar dgag sgrub zhig 'dzin pa grol/ /nyams rtogs rgyas so/ /de'i tshe mkha' 'gro mas lung bstan pa/ spros med kyi sgrub pa la brtson par gyis dang / tshe 'di nyid la mchog gi dngos grub thob par 'gyur zhing bu tsha bo la sogs pa'i rgyud pa chu bo'i rgyun bzhin du 'byung zhing /dben pa'i gnas lha ri sgang po'i yar khud la sogs pa yang lung bstan pas 'jig rten gyi grags pa snying po med pa ched du ma bzung bar bal yul la sogs pa'i gnas rnams su sgom kho na mdzad pas lo sgom zhes grags la/ bod du byon nas kyang spros pa dor te lha ri glang po'i yar khud du sgrub pa mdzad pas/phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub thob nas dgung lo bzhi bcu rtsa bzhi la mkha' spyod du bde bar gshegs so/ /bla ma de'i nang rten du gdung rten bkra shis 'od 'bar bya ru ma chen mo 'di nyid bzhengs te/ 'di nyid kyi nang na bla ma de nyid rang gi spur las zhabrungs pa'i 'jam dbyangs smra ba'i seng ge'i sku gcig gis thog drangs pa'i gdung ring bsrel bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / mtshan 'bum bzhugs so/ /bla ma de'i slob 42—

bla chen dbyal gyi gdung rabs rin po che'i za ra tshags/ma'i gtso bo smos na ni/ mtshungs pa med pa gsum dang / 'gran zla bral ba gnyis te/ gsang sngags gsar rnying gi rgyud sde mtha' dag la mkhas pa lo ro bsod nams seng ge dang / rnal 'byor bla med kyi rgyud sde mtha' dag la mkhas pa rtag ston rdo rje bzang po/ man ngag dang byin rlabs kyi chu rgyun 'bebs pa la mkhas pa/ rtag pa phyag na rdo rje'o/ /'gran zla med pa gnyis ni mthu dang nus pa mthar phyin pa'i sgo nas tshar gcod dang rjes su 'dzin pa la thogs pa med pa dpyal pa rtag /mdo sngags kyi rgya tsho'i pha rol tu phyin cing mngon mkhyen dang rdzu 'phrul la dbang sgyur ba dpyal lo tsā ba dpal chos kyi bzang po'o bar pa jo dpal gyi gtsug lag khang chen po khri gsum dge 'khor dang bcas pa bskyangs pas mnga' thang yang rtser 'phel lo/ /gcung po skyeg tsha rdo rje drag po rtsal ni/yab chos rnams la gzhung bshad rnams lag len dang bcas pa mkhyen yang /chos kyi rgyud phyug gar bya— brunyi phyir/ rgya gar yul dbus su byon nas/ gnas lnga rig pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen —skre+o bram ze dpal 'dzin zhabs dang nag po zhabs chung la sogs pa rnams la sgra tshad rgyud 'grel dang bcas pa gdams pa mang po gsan te/ lo bcu gnyis bzhugs nas bod du byon nas 'gro don mdzad cing / dgyes po rdo rje la 'gyur yang mdzad/ gzhan yang rgyud 'grel du ma 'gyur bar grags sa/ /drag sngags stag gi nga ro bsgrags pa'i mthus/ /dgra bgegs spre'u stugs byed pa stag dang / /bdud dpung glang po'i klad pa 'gem byed pa'i/ /43—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ pad+ma rdo rje'i gsung chos skor/'jigs med seng las skyes de rgyal gyur cig /sangs rgyas bstan pa'i dpal nyid sangs rgyas dpal/ /chos kyi dbang phyug chos kyi sbyin bdag ste/ /'phrin las bzang pos 'gro ba bzang po 'dul/ /skad gnyis smra ba'i dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal/ /tshul khrims phun tshogs gtsang rigs rnams kyi dpal/ /shes rab phun tshogs chos kyi sgo rnams 'byed/ /ting 'dzin phun tshogs lhag pa'i sems bzang po/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa'i bdag la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mi mthun phyogs las rgyal ba'i rgyal chen dang / /'gro ba lnga yi rtse mo'i dpal 'byor can/ /mched lnga'i tha chung lnga rtse mdzangs pa dang / /yab mched blo yangs nam mkha' rgyal gyur cig /tshogs gnyis chus brlan dge ba'i rtsa ba dkar/ /mkhyen rtse'i 'dab rgyas snyan pa'i dri bsung can/ /dam chos sgra rtse'i 'byung gnas legs bshad gter/ /gcung po pad+ma lo tsā phyag 'tshal lo/ /de yang gcen po bla ma kun dga' grags kyi jo mo ma cig bkra shis ldem la sras lnga 'khrungs/ bar pa 'jam dpal la sras gnyis so/ /de yang bla ma kun dga' grags kyi che ba stag ste/ yab chos rnying ma'i skor la shin tu mkhas shing spro /—

bla chen dpyal gyi gdung rabs rin po che'i za ra tshags/gsar ma'ang ci rigs par mkhyen la/ khyad par du dge ba'i bshes gnyen bka' gdams pa tshul khrims dbang phyug la/ kha 'bar ma'i man ngag zhus pas mkha' 'gro ma dri ma med pa'i gzi brdzid dang mjal/ gzhan yang 'dod lha chos skyong gi zhal gzigs pas/ las mgon bran du bkol ba'i mthus/ kha 'bar ma'i gtor ma dngos su gom pa bdun tsam 'gro ba/ gsang sngags grub pa'i rnal 'byor pa chen po sman lung bla ma'i gdan sa non pa'o/ /de 'og seng las skyes ni/ sgrub pa'i mthu stobs dang yang rtsal rgyas shing sngags kyi nga ros 'byung po'i rigs skrag bar byed la/ zhi rgyas dbang drag gi ras pas mdzes shing / drag po'i las kyi sder mos/ ma rung khyu mchog gi mgo bo gshog par byed pa ste ban mtsho'i lha khang la sogs par 'dzin pa'o/ /bar pa lnga tshigs pa bla ma chos bzang gi rnam thar 'og nas 'byung ba ltar ro/ /mched lnga'i mtha' dag gi slob dpon rgyal chen ste/ yab chos kyi sgrub pa la brtson pas ngag nus che zhing mi chos la mkhas shing bsod nams che bas/ tshong 'dus kyi bcud sdud cing kha lo sgyur ba ra mtshams kyi bdag po'o/ /tha chung lnga rtse ni/gcen po bla ma lo ts+tsha ba dang thugs gcugs pa/ rgan rabs la bsnyen bkur byed pa/ pha ma la byas pa gzo ba/ rang bzhin gyi rgyud drang shing mdzangs pa ngag 'jam zhing rdzun med pa/ dad brtson dang ldan pa blo gsal ba yid gzhung ba chos phyir dka' ba spyod nus pa zhig yod pa/ rang nyid kyang slob gnyer dang gcen po rgyo gar na bzhud pa'i mthun rkyen gser skyel du byon pas/ gang gā'i 'gram du cham rkun pas dkrang pa'/ /—45—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ pad+ma rdo rje'i gsung chos skor/yang dpyal jo dpal gyi sras che ba dge bshes nam mkha' khri gsum gyi bdag byas so/ /gcung po slob dpon pad+mas ni/ yab mes kyi chos mang po mkhyen kyang chos 'tshol ba dang dge ba la spro ba/ rnam pa gcig tu ni bdag gi yab sku mched gsum las khu bo gnyis kas rgya gar la byon 'dug pa la/ yab kyi ma byon pas bdag gis dad dgos pa'i phyir 'gro snyam ste/ rgya gar dbus 'gyur tshal du byon nas paṇ+ḍi ta badz+ra kirta brten nas/ gdams pa zhus te slob gnyer mdzad pas mkhas grub tu gyur nas rgya gar nyid du bzhugs so/ /sa gsum kun tu khyab pa'i lo sgom dang / /'phrin las lhun gyis grub pa'i jo dpal dang / /skad gnyis smra ba'i gtsug rgyan skyeg tsha dang / /nyon mongs chu 'dzin bral ba'i nam mkha' dang / /'khor ba'i skyon gyis ma gos pad+ma'i mtshan/ /sgra sgyur mkhas pa rnam lnga rgyal gyur cig /ces bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /snga ma kun dga' grags kyi sras lnga tshigs pa bla ma mkhas spyod lo tsā ba ni/ gang sngon he ru ka dpal mkha' 'gro lngas/ /pham 'thing dang ni u rgyan yi rangs su/ /dngos su dbang bskur lung bstan byin rlabs rgyud/ /dpal ldan chos kyi bzang po'i zhabs la 'dud/ /ces pa 'di nyid ni sku gzhon nu nas sngags 'chang rgyal po la/ sman lung brag rdo —46—

bla chen dpyal gyi gdung rabs rin po che'i za ra tshags/rje bzang po'i drung du dgyes pa rdo rje dang / phag mo dang / gsang ba 'dus pa 'phags bskor dang / gzhan yang man ngag mang po thugs rjes bzung zhing bla ma'i gsung nas/ bla ma gong ma rnams kyi bka' srol brnyes pa'i phyir/ blo gros chen pos don yod pa bya dgos pas rgya gar la 'grim gsungs/ lung yang bstan byung / gser sdings su sku rtsed mdzad gyin bzhugs pas/ ma jo rgan mo zhig yod pa na re/ khyed bla ma'i sras yin pas rgya gar la 'byon dgos/ khyed za ma la dga'/ rtsed mo la dga'/ nyal ba la dga' bas/ ming jo sras dga' gsum 'bar zer ba gyis zhes zhus pas/ des sad byed kyi rkyen byas nas bla ma'i lung bstan dang / lo tsā ba'i rigs kyang yin/ ma yang de bzhin kha gtong gin 'dug snyam nas/ thugs la go cha cher bzhes nas cis kyang rgya gar du 'gro dgos dgongs nas/ 'bring mtshams zhang lo tsā ba la 'phral skad dang / klog yig bslab/ bar chad bsrung ba'i phyir bla ma lha lung pa la gsang bdag me lce'i phreng ba zhus shing bsnyen sgrub mthar son pa'i rtags su/ phyag gi rdo rje la me dngos su 'bar ba byung / zha lu'i thugs rje chen po la gsol ba btab lung bstan zhus pas spyan ras gzigs zhal 'dzum bag dang bcasapas lung bstan/ de nas 'phags yul du 'byon par chas pa dang / chag lo tsā ba dgra bcom chen po rgya gar du 'byon pa dang rten 'brel 'grig nas/ 'grogs te byon pas grong khyer tir hu ti rgal/ gang gā'i 'gram du ma slebs pa'i sa steng zhig tu 'jigs pa lan gsum byung / de nas gang gā'i 'gram du jag pa byung nas brdung bshus rgyob gsod zer bas 'ga' zhig ni 'gyel/ la la ngu / la la smre ngag 'don/ grogs —47—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ pad+ma rdo rje'i gsung chos skor/dam pa gnyal gyi chag lo tsā ba dang kho bo gnyis gcer bu bshus pas/ 'di lta bu'i 'jigs pa yong ba a tsa ma snyam pa byung / 'on kyang thugs la dpa' skyed/grogs rnams dbugs phyung yang mdzad de gsung mgur las kyang /gang gā'i 'gram du shi skyid jag pa byung / /'ga' zhig sa la 'gre zhing smre ngag 'don/ /'ga' zhig cho nges 'debs shing brang la rdung / /brtsam pa'i don med dus mtha' yin no snyam/ /de tshe de rnams kho bos dbugs phyung nas/ /'gro ba'i mgon po byang chub chen po dang / /dkon mchog gsum la gsol ba 'debs su bcug /grogs dam pa gnyal gyi 'char sgo la/ /kho bo gcig pu de'i tshe gcer bur bshus/ /longs spyod med pas gtum po'i don ma grub/ /ces gsung zhing byang chub chen po dang dkon mchog gsum la gsol ba thob gsung / dkon mchog gsum gyi bka' drin gyi ma ga ta ru phebs pas/ mahā brnyi dang mjal bas 'di las dga' ba mi yong / 'di rang gcig pu rang la dka' ba spyad rin chog /yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che rnyed pa las lhag snyam pa byung gsung / bla mas dka' ba spyad pa'i kun spyod khyad par can bcu yod pa'i dang po'o/ /de nas yon tan gyi gzhi ma sgra tshad 'di yin pas slob dgos dgongs nas/ paṇ+ḍi ta man+ta ni ti dang ga ya si ta dang ya gi su ma tam/ kri ta ghar+bha bzhi'i —48—

bla chen dpyal gyi gdung rabs rin po che'i za ra tshags/drung du/ sgra ka la pa dang / tsan+t+ra pa dang gzhon nu smin drug gi bstan bcos dang a ma ko sha 'chi med mdzod/ ming gi mngon brjod/ mdo sde skye rabs la sogs pa gsan nas/ thugs su chud par mdzad cing khyad par 'byung ba'i sgra tshad/ rgya mtsho mtha'i skad la sogs pa sgra la sbyangs pa mchog tu gyur to/ /kun spyod gnyis par grags so/ /de nas paṇa chen a nan+ta ka ra'i drung du/ mdo sde skye rabs dang /yum stong phrag brgya pa dang / stong phrag nyer lnga pa dang / slob dpon seng ge bzang pos mdzad pa'i brgyad stong 'grel chen dang / nyi khri le brgyad/ 'grel pa don gsal/ slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad pa'i nyi khri'i 'grel pa rnams gsan pa las/ kun spyod gsum pa'o/ /mkhas pa'i khyu mchog paṇa chen shākya'i mtshan can la/ bzang po spyod pa/ nyi khri gzhung 'grel spyod 'jug /nor bzang gi rtogs brjod/ bde mchog rtsa rgyud 'grel pa dang bcas pa lū hi pa'i sgrub thabs rnams gsan/ paṇ+ḍi ta mu ni shrī thub pa dpal gyi dung du gsang 'dus 'phags skor ma lus pa gsan/ rim lnga'i 'grel pa khong rang gi mdzad pa'i shes rab 'grel chung rnams gsan kun spyod bzhi pa'o/ /rdo rje gdan na thub dbang gi tshems mche ba bzhi las/ zhus ma bzhes pa'i drung du lan gnyis kyi bar du gser mo mang po phul nas byin rlabs zhus/dus de nyid nas gnas de nyid du/ paṇa chen shākya'i mtshan can drung dge tshul gyi sdom pa blangs so/ /kun spyod lnga pa'o/ /de nas bla ma rdo rje gdan pa niṣ+ka laṅka'i drung du/ kyi rdo rje'i rgyud 'grel pa dang bcas pa rin po che'i phreng ba/ mnga' bdag mi tri pa'i sgrub thabs rnam par dag pa'i gter/ sgrub thabs mdor —49—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ pad+ma rdo rje'i gsung chos skor/bsdus gshin rje gshed dmar po'i dbang rgyud sgrub thabs che chung / shin tu spros med kyi man ngag gsan cing / byang chub shing yal ga lo 'bras dang bcas pa'i drung du paṇa chen rdo rje gdan pa la/ byang chub mchog gi smon 'jug gnyis ka'i sgo nas thugs bskyed/ thugs nyams su bzhes/ kun spyod drug pa'o/ /paṇ+ḍi ta a nan+ta ka ra'i drung du/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma dang bde mchog 'byung ba/ mkha' 'gro kun spyod/ nyi khri gzhung la sogs pa gsan/ kun spyod bdun pa'o/ /de nas dpal na len+d+ra ru byon nas/ sde pa bzhi char tshang ba'i dge 'dun la gaṇ+ḍi brdung ba'i ston mo bsnyen bskur ba lan lnga mdzad/ kun spyod brgyad pa'o/ /slob dpon klu sgrub gyi thugs dam 'jig rten dbang phyug dang / slob dpon tsan+d+ra go mis lung bstan pa'i sgrol ma rang byon/ rdo rje gdan gyi chu khung na bzhugs pa'i sgrol ma rang byon rnams kyi drung du mchod pa re phul cing byin rlabs zhus/ gzhan yang /na len+d+ra na mi yi dbang po'i mdzad pa lnga brgya bzhugs shing / 'bar ba'i phug dang rgyal po'i khab la sogs pa na'ang mdzad pa khyad par can re re bzhugs pa lags/ byin rlabs zhus shing mchod pa re phul/ kun spyod dgu pa'o/ /maṅga dha ru rgyal pos spyan drangs/ zhabs spyi bor blang / lcags ri'i nang na go sa la dang a tan pu ri dang / phu la ha ri la sogs pa'i gnas chen lnga yod pa'ang bla ma la phul zhing rdo rje gdan gyi byang sgo'i sgo skyong chen po la bskos shing / lo yang 'ga' mdzad/ de nas dbus 'gyur 'tshal gyi dud khrod du byon pas/ dpal mgon phyag bzhi pa'i zhal gzigs/ nyams myong ngo mtshar can byung gsung / de nas rgya gar shar phyogs kha sarla ṇi bzhugs pa'i gnas rgya mtsho'i khrag can du byon/—50—
