bla chen dpyal gyi gdung rabs rin po che'i za ra tshags/rgyal po ha ri tsan+d+ra 'khor dang bcas pa nam mkha' la gshegs pa gzigs nas rdzu 'phrul la mnga' brnyes pas phyi'i rgya mtsho chen po na/ rnam par snang mdzad gangs chen mtsho bzhugs pa'i drung du mchod pa phul/ byin rlabs zhus/ smon lam btab/ gzhan yang slob dpon klu sgrub dang / grub chen nag po spyod pa'i sgrub gnas khyad par can la sogs par sgrub pa'i srol 'dzin khyad par can mang po'i drung du mchod pa phul/ byin rlabs zhus/ gsung mgur las kyang /gnas dang sgrub khang la sogs mkhas pa yis/ /srol 'dzin 'jags shing des pa rnams kyang mthong / /thos bsam 'bras bu brtsam phyir dbus 'gyur du/ /phyin pa'i khyad par kun spyod bcu pa rnams/ /zhes gsungs la/ dpyal kun mkhyen pa dang / 'khon nam mkha' yangs pa'i shes rab ni bla mas lo bcu gnyis bzhugs par bzhed la/ khro phu lo tsā bas ni chos phyir lo bcu bzhugs par bzhed de/ khro bu bas thos bsam sgrub pa kho na la dgongs pa dang gzhan rnams kyi yongs dril la dgongs pa yin snyam/ de nas bla mas byang phyogs kyi gdul bya smin cing grol ba'i phyir/ dri med rdo rje'i zhabs la gsol ba btab nas/ bod la spyan drangs te gser sdings du phebs/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor zhing / khyad par du bla mas thog drangs bu slob mang pos gsol ba btab nas gshed dmar gyi dbang zhus nas/dri za'i rgyal pos glu dbyangs dad pas 'bul/ /gnod sbyin grub pa la sogs bskor zhing 'dud/ /—51—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ pad+ma rdo rje'i gsung chos skor/'byung po thams cad phyag 'tshal skyabs su 'gro /sku gzugs khyad 'phags byang chub chen po la/ /rin chen bzang la phul legs zlos pa yis/ /sku yon sna tshogs rgyan bkras brten pa ni/ /thub dbang byang chub shing la bskur brten bzhin/ /zhes pa de lta bu'i gser sku'i nang rdzongs la thub pa chen po'i 'phel gdung maṅga bhā'i rgyal pos phul ba'i phul nang gnas chen brgyad kyi sa la tshems mche ba ma sku khrus gsol ba'i chus lde gu byas pa/ byang chub kyi shing yal ga lo 'bras dang bcas pa/ mahā bho dhi zhal rtsi thub pa chen po'i bzhugs khri'i dum bu nam bza'i dum bu/ shā ri'i bu'i sku gdung ring bsrel/ kha che paṇa chen gyi dbu skra/phyag sen/ na gza'i tshal pa/ paṇa chen mu ne shrī /k+ṣarti sarba rdo rje gdan pa rnams kyi dbu skra/ phyag sen na bza'i tshal pa thugs dam phreng ba/ rdo rje gdan pa niṣ+ka laṅka de ba'i dbang gos/ rus rgyan/ gzhan yang na len+d+ra 'bri ka ma la shrī la sogs pa'i gnas rnams kyi rten la byin rlabs zhus pa'i bla ma nyid kyi thugs dam phreng ba rnams/ rgyu dngul gyi myang 'das mchod rten 'khru gang pa zhig gis nang na bzhugs pa thugs ka na yod cing / khyad par dpyal lo rim par byon pa rnams kyi sku gdung ring bsrel/ bla ma nyid rang gi rnams sbyar/ chos gos gsum/ sku gdung ring bsrel/ dar tshon gyis dril nas bzhugs/ pad gdan la mgon po sngon 'byung gi rgyud dang / rgyud nas gsungs pa'i srog snying dang bcas pa/ g.yin yang 'bru lnga/ rin po che lnga/ dri lnga la sogs pa'i 'khas —52—

bla chen dpyal gyi gdung rabs rin po che'i za ra tshags/rdzongs kyi rim pa las byung ba ji bzhin par bzhugs yod/ chos sku'i rten gdung khang bkra shis 'od 'bar ke tshang gsum pa/ dbus na dgyes rdor bde mchog bcom ldan 'das ma la sogs pa nang gi lha tshogs rnams dang / g.yas na shākya'i rgyal po seng ge sgra /mi g.yo mgon/ sgrol ma spyan ras gzigs la sogs pa'i phyi'i lha tshogs ke tshang g.yon na mchod rten brgyad pa/ bkra shis sgo mang lha las babs pa la sogs pa'i mchod rten rnams bzhugs/ nas 'bras la sogs 'bru bol nub tsam bzang drug la sogs sman gyi rigs/ tsan dan la sogs dri bzang gyi byugs pa'i steng na bzhugs so/ /gdung khang phyed bla mas rdo rje dril bu la sogs pa'i dbang rdzas rnams nam mkha' bzhag cing / yi dam gyi tshogs gsal por mkha' la bkod pa la sogs pa'i byin rlabs kyi che ba dang ngo mtshar ba'i mdzad pa mang du mdzad cing / de dus kyi dbang chas/rdo rje dril bu/bla ma rang gi rus rgyan/ nā ro'i rus rgyan/ dbang bum/ maṇ+ḍal/ bir wa pa'i rus rgyan/ ka pā la rnams/ da lta yang bzhugs par grags so/ /bla ma de nyid la gser gyi thog drangs pa'i zang zing gi 'bul ba yang bsam gyis mi khyab ste/zhabs tog gi sgo nas gnyes par mdzad nas/ 'gro ba'i don rgya chen po la dgongs nas slar yang rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul la gshegs so/ /de'i phyis su khro phu lo tsā ba chen pos kha che paṇa chen rgya gar phyogs la mdzad nas gdan drangs te/ byon pa'i dus su bla ma'i thugs la nga'i bla ma sku nas bgres pas byon pa mi srid dam/ 'on kyang phebs pa'ang srid cing deng dus bod na khrims yod pa'i stobs kyis/ paṇ+ḍi ta su phebs kyang gser gyi 'bul ba byed —53—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ pad+ma rdo rje'i gsung chos skor/pa'i srol yod pas/ bla mas kyang gser gyi 'bul ba byed pa bsu ba gang dang spyi la byon pas/ paṇa chen la slob ma paṇa chung dgu dang bcas pa zlo li la gdan drangs nas 'dul chung du phyag phebs pa'i tshe/ dpon slob gnyis ma gcig bu gcig ma 'phrad pa bzhin du gcig la gcig dgyes par gyur to/ /'a zha rgyal pos paṇa chen la zhabs tog bzang po mdzad/ khro che nyams su dga'i chos sde phyag tu phul/ de'i tshe paṇa chen gyi bla ma lo tsā ba la gnang cing /de nas gser sdings su phyag phebs/ dpal ldan sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta dpon slob dpyal lo tsā ba dpon slob/ khro phu lo tsā ba dpon slob kyi thog drangs/ bu slob nam mkha'i skar tshogs lta bu la zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos kyi 'khor lo bsam gyis mi khyab pa bskor cing skal ldan gyi 'gro ba rnams smin grol la bkod/khyad par bla ma lo tsā ba nyid kyi sngar rgya gar du paṇa chen gyi drung du dus kyi 'bor lo'i rgyud 'grel chen dri med 'od/ sems 'grel skor gsum a bha ya'i man ngag snye ma/ rdo rje 'phreng ba/ mkha' spyod dkar dmar/ bde mchog dkar po/phag mo rus sbal zhal/ kye rdo rje'i sbyor ba yan lag drug pa/ de'i rtsa ba rdo rje'i tshig rkang / paṇa chen rang gis mdzad pa dang nā ro'i 'grel chen rnams gsan cing nā ro'i 'grel chen la 'gyur yang mdzad pa'i mjug tu nyung chung gi dgon par bsgyur zhes pa'o/ /sngar gser sdings kyi ming la nyung chung dgon pa zhes grags la phyis paṇa chen gyi chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i dus su/ bu slob rnams kyi paṇa chen la gser zho non du long pa gtor bas phyis mi rnams kyi rnyed pas gser gyi sdings su sdings la song 'dug zer nas gser sdings zhes mngags —54—

bla chen dpyal gyi gdung rabs rin po che'i za ra tshags/so/ /phyis nā ro 'grel chen la 'gyur mdzad pa na/ skad gnyis smra ba dpyal lo tsā ba dpal chos kyi bzang pos dpal bkra shis gser sdings kyi gtsug lag khang du sgyur cing gtan la phab pa'o/ /zhes dang / 'gyur gzhan yang gshed dmar lha lnga'i rgya gzhung bir wa pas mdzad pa/ rdo rje gdan pas mdzad pa/ bde mchog lū hi pa'i rgya gzhung / sgrol ma nyi shu rtsa gcig gi bstod pa la sogs pa mang po bsgyur ro/ /bka' dang bstan bcos rgyud dang / 'grel pa mang po bsgyur ba'i mkhyen pa dang stobs nus mnga' yang gsung mgur las 'di skad du/sgra dang skad la legs par sbyangs pa yin/ /bstan bcos du ma bsgyur ba'i nus yod mod/ /mngon zhen dug gi sdong pos ngan 'gror skyur/ /'odod pa'i nyon mongs zhing pas 'khor bar 'chings/ /spras pas bsam gtan bar chad gyur pas na/ /de rnams mthar thug 'dod pas spang bar rigs/ /kho bos de phyir grong chog bzhin du spangs/ /gtsang zhing nyams dga' g.yang sa kun dang bral/ /mthar thug dge sbyor rang gi ngang gis 'phel/ /thar pa gling zhes grags pa'i dgon pa bzung / /zhes gsung zhing / rnam thar gsol 'debs las kyang 'di skad du/bstan bcos du ma bsgyur ba'i nus yod mod/ /chos phyir skyes pa'i chags sdang me 'bar nas/ /—55—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ pad+ma rdo rje'i gsung chos skor/thar bde'i bud shing khregs gzigs rab skyo bas/ /spros spangs ri khrod brten la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes 'byung ba ltar/ spros pa dor bar mdzad nas thar pa gling 'di dben dgon mdzad par dgongs nas/ ri'i ngo bo'i mtshan nyid ni/ rgyab ri brag ri longs sku'i sangs rgyas kyis dbu rgyan gsol ba lta bu/ de'i mdun du gnas kyi ri lhun du chags pa/ kha shar du lta ba/ rtsa ba ni ne'u le'i kha nas nor bu thon pa lta bu/ri 'bur snum bag can gyis gang ba/ mdun mar rtsi shing dang / nags tshal rnams mchod 'bul bkram pa ltar bskos pa/ g.yas ri dpang po dar skyor gyi yol ba btags pa lta bu la/ sman dang spos dang me tog gi tshogs du mas gang ba / bya dang / ri dwags kyi tshogs thams cad rang bzhin gyi bag phebs te/ rtse zhing snyan pa'i gsung dbyangs 'gyur skad sgrog pa/ g.yon ri 'jam zhing spos ngad dang ldan pa mchod dar ltar lding ba/ dbus kyi ri ni/ rgyal chen rnams thos sras kyi phyag na ne+e'u le 'dzin pa lta bu la phyogs bcu'i ri ni/ 'khor rtab bdag gi tshul du yod pa/ de rnams kyi bar bar grong dang grong khyor la sogs pa ni 'dod yon dpal 'byor du mas gang ba'i mchod rdzas/ gling bzhi ri rab dang bcas pa'i maṇ+ḍal gyi bkod pa dang ldan pa ni mchod pa 'bul ba'i tshul du yod pa/sgrub chu dang / rang bzhin gyi lu ma dang / chu mig thal thol yang be+eḍūr+ya'i phreng ba ltar zam ma chad pa/ dus rtag tu pad+ma'i gnyen gyi zer mnga' ba/ bltas pa tsam gyis nyams dga' ba thos bsam sgom gsum gyi bya ba la blo 'jug pa/ gnas de'i sa dbyibs dang / kha dog gi bye brag phun sum tshogs shing tha dad pas —56—

bla dpyal gyi gdung rabs rin po che'i za ra tshags/'phrin las rnam pa bzhi rtsol med du 'grub cing / khyad par skal ldan du ma mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thob cing / mdor na bshad sgrub zung du 'brel ba'i chos grwa skad gnyis smra ba'i 'byung gnas/ dpal byang chub thar pa gling 'di ri khrod tshul du btab pa'o/ /de la ji skad du/g.ya' bzang dgung la sprin 'khrigs byed pa'i 'dabs/ /sna tshogs rtsa rtsi spang nags nyams dga'i steng / /brag ri dpal ldan lcags dkar sbungs pa'i mdun/ /kun gyi yid 'phrog nges par 'byung ba'i gnas/ /chos spyod ngang gis 'phel ba'i ri khrod 'di/ /sgom sgrub ngang gis 'phel ba'i dben tsha ste/ /grub chen ngang gis 'byon pa'i gdan sa legs/ /mkhas btsun ngang gis 'du ba'i sde chen yin/ /zhes gzim spyil bstan nas bzhugs pas/ paṇa chen gyi zhal nas lo tsā ba'i sgrub gnas 'di la byang chub thar pa gling zhes bya ba yin no gsungs/ de nas paṇa chen dpon slob rnams me mo yos lo dbus phyogs la phebs/ bla mas sgrub pa rtse gcig mdzad/ lcags mo lug la gtsang la phebs/ thar pa gling du paṇa chen spyan drangs/ rnyed pa dang bkur sti phun sum tshogs pa dang khyad par du sku 'dra chos ra ma sku tshad dang mnyam pa de'i nang na paṇa chen rang gi dbu skra/ tshems sku chos thugs dam 'phreng ba/ gser sku mtho gang pa zhig /bzhugs khri la bzhugs lding bcug pa'i sku 'dra ngo mtshar can bzhengs pa la rab gnas kyang —57—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ pad+ma rdo rje'i gsung chos skor/paṇa chen rang gis mdzad nas paṇa chen dngos su bzhugs pa dang khyad par med pa'i dbu zhwa/ sku chos bzhugs gdan/ gsol lhung rnams dang bcas da lta yang gtsang khang na bzhugs pa ltar/ paṇa chen la 'bul ba zhabs tog gis mnyes par byas nas zha lu rgyan gong du skyel ma mdzad pa la phebs/ paṇa chen gyis gtsang chu mig snar gyi lhas mo che/ khro phu/ sa skya rnams su chos 'khor bsam gyis khyab pa bskor nas 'gro ba'i don rgya chen po la dgongs te/ slar yang rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du gshegs so/ /bla ma lo tsā bas yum rgyas pa rgya'i mthing shog la 'dzam bu chu bo'i gser gyi bris pa bcu drug dum bzhengs pa'i dum bu re re la na bza' lnga lngas brgyan/ glegs shing a ka ru la zangs kyi spen bkab can la tsha gser gyi byugs pa/ dbu dum dang po la gser srang sum cu so lngas bris pa/ glegs shing rnams la yum chen mo la rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas kyi bskor ba / sangs rgyas sum cu rtsa lngas 'phul du bskor ba/ ya mtshan can bzhengs pa 'dzam gling rgyan chen du grags pa bzhengs pa ni/ut+pal mdog 'dra'i rgya shog dwangs pa la/ /gser sbyangs yi ge sgros legs dod pa ni/ /lho phyogs rol mtsho'i yan lag brgyad ldan nags/ /lhun chags gser gyi ri bdun dngar ba bzhin/ /legs brkos glegs shing zangs kyi spar bkab la/ /gser gyis byugs pa'i glegs shing kun nas brgyan/ /sku chings na bza' sna tshogs mdzes pas g.yogs/ /—58—

bla chen dpyal gyi gdung rabs rin po che'i za ra tshags/nor bu rin chen sna tshogs gos kyis dkris/ /de na yang de yang shog bu rnams tshogs 'dus pas 'bul ba ste/ dpyal pa chos bzhengs pa na/ tshong 'dus pas shog bu 'bul ba'i kha srol yod pa'o/ /chos bzhengs pa'i rab gnas kyi dus kyang 'khor gsum yongs dag gi mchod sbyin yang bsam gyis mi khyab bo/ /de nas gser 'bum stag ri lo tsā bas phul ba'i bcu gnyis dum zhig dang / mdo mang zhig phyag tu byung ba zhig rong ngur mig tu gdan drangs/ 'dzam gling rgyan chung ni 'dir bzhugs pa las phyis dga' ba gdong du phebs pa'o/ /gsung rab skya yod 'bul ba ni grangs med do/ /de nas sngon gyi smon lam dbang gis rong ngur mig tu phyag phebs/ dge 'dun rnams kyis gsol ba drag tu btab pa la brten nas bla mas zang zing gi sbyin pa chos kyi sbyin pa mi 'jigs pa skyabs kyi sbyin pa gsum gyi sgo nas mtha' 'dul ba dang dbus tshad la phebs pa'i thabs mkhas pa'i thugs rjes sems can mang po'i don mdzad pas dge 'dun sde dgon thams cad skal pa dang po'i mi bzhin du bde skyid byams sems dang ldan pas de'i dus bla mas mgur 'di bzhes so//rang don med na thams cad blo ltos 'cha'/ /drang por smras na tshig la bden par 'dzin/ /phan sems yod na kun gyi pha bzhin bkur/ /chos bzhin byas na 'tshe ba ngang gis bzlog /dpyal ban ser rtsa'i rigs gyur pa/ /dge slong chos kyi bzang po yis /—59—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ pad+ma rdo rje'i gsung chos skor/bya ba cung zad brjod pa yin/ /ma 'ongs dus na ser rtsa'i rigs gyur pa/ /skye bo dam par 'dod na de ltar gyis/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gzhan yang / chu mig pa dang zha lu pa rtsod gzhi'i me chen po 'bar/ khrag gi char pa phab/ sems can mang po gnod cing bstan pa 'grib pa la thug pas bla ma'i thugs rjes char sprin bsdus nas rtsod pa'i me bsad/thabs mkhas pa'i nyi mas khrag gi char pa bcad/ stobs ldan dpung ni tshogs kyis ma rungs pa kun btul/ blo gros shes bya'i 'od kyi bstan pa gsal bar mdzad do/ /de nas thun mtshams su chos kyi 'khor lo re re tsam ma gtogs sku tshe hril po sgrub pa la bzhugs pas yi dam gyi lha mang po zhal gzigs/ khyad par du gsang 'dus/ bde mchog /kyai rdo rje/ rdo rje phag mo/ seng ge sgra/ mkha' spyod dkar dmar/ gshin rje gshed la sogs pa'i lha mang po'i zhal gzigs shing snang ba dang gsung gleng mang du byung / rdzogs rim bslab tshigs ring mo/dril bu rim lnga/ phag mo rdo sgom drug khren tu spros med kyi rdo rje'i sbyor ba yan lag drug pa/ rnams thugs nyams su bzhes pas phyag rgya chen po'i de kho na nyid grub cing / thugs dam mthil dril bu rim lnga la mdzad/ yon tan dang bsngags pa kyi rdo rje sbyor drug la mdzad cing / 'di nyid kyi rtsa ba rdo rje'i tshig rkang rin po che'i sgrom gyi lde mig mdzad/ de'i 'grel pa gnyal pa hrul pos shin tu legs pa zhig mdzad nas deng sang gi bar du khrid bka' yang yod par grags so/ /de nas rtag 'dzin can mngon zhen las bzlog pas dang / le lo can chos la —60—

bla chen dpyal gyi gdung rabs rin po che'i za ra tshags/brtson pa skyed pa'i phyir dang / zhing gzhan du 'gro don rgya che ba la dgongs nas sa mo glang lo'i rgyal gyi zla ba la sku cung zad snyung tshul bstan/ bla ma nyid don la gshegs pa mi mnga' yang / khro phu lo tsā ba dang nye gnas gsol gzim la sogs pas gsol ba btab pa la brten nas sku rim dang sman dpyad la sogs pa mdzad pa'i tshul bstan/ de nas skar ma gres nya ba'i yar tshes brgyad la rje btsun seng ge sgra la gsol ba btab pas/ dpal 'khor lo bde mchog lhan skyes rgyan gyis spras pa mdun gyi nam mkha' la byon pas lung bstan pa ni/rje btsun khyod ni khrum zla yar ngo yi/ /tshes drug snga dro'i dus su mkha' spyod kyi/ /gnas su spyan 'dren de tshe sgra dang 'od/ /'byung chen sa yang cung zad g.yo bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas sgron gyi zla ba'i mar ngo'i tshes brgyad dang bcu bzhi'i dus su/ gsang ba 'dus pa gshed dmar la sogs pa'i rten dang brten/ pa'i dkyil 'khor gsal por gzigs shing mar ngo'i tshes bcu bzhi'i nub mo'i sum cha tha ma'i dus maṅga dha'i ma ṇi ka der skyes bus lag pa bskum brkyang gi yun tsam la phebs te/ rin po che'i snod du lha'i bdud rtsi gsol bar mdzad/ dus gsum po'i gnam stong la dkon mchog gsum la mchod pa bsam mi khyab pa dang longs spyod la ltos pa med pa sbyin pa rgya chen po yang mdzad/ 'khor dang snyung g.yog pa rnams la smon lam sems bskyed dang bla ma nyid kyis 'jug pa byang chub tu sems bskyed pa'i tshe bde bar gshegs pa rnams byon nas/ sgra dang 'od —61—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ pad+ma rdo rje'i gsung chos skor/dang me tog gi char la sogs pa skye bo phal po ches mthun snang du gyur pa byung bas/ bla mas 'di skad gsung /sgrub pa tshul bzhin nyams len cing / /ltos bral skyo ba med pa yis/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi dus kun tu/ /sems can don kun byed par shog /ces gsungs so/ /de nas khrum zla ba'i yar ngo'i tshes drug gi snga dro skya rengs shar ba'i dus su/ dpa' bo dang dpa' mo la sogs pa mdun gyi nam mkha' la lhags nas mchod pa'i sprin bsam gyis mi khyab dang bcas pas bsu ba gzigs/ lha'i spos kyi dri yang phyogs bcur khyab par gyur/ bla ma dang yi dam dpa' bo mkha' 'gro la mchod pa'i phyir/ 'khor rnams la sgrub pa'i maṇ+ḍal shoms gsungs pa'i zhal bkod mdzad pa na drung na yod pa'i dpyal a mo gha dang khro phu lo tsā ba chen po pho rog pa mdo sde mgon po rnams la mi rtag pa'i chos gsungs nas bla ma nyid zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung / phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag la bsam gtan gyi chos drug dang ldano pas/ bde ba chen po'i 'okhor lo'i gtsug nas chas lnga dang ldan pas mkha' spyad du dpa' ba mkha' 'gra sangs rgyas byang sems mang pos bskor nas dgung lo drug cu rtsa brgyad la bde bar gshegs shing / de'i tshe sgra dang 'od dang me tog gi char dang 'ja' gur la sogs pa'i ngo mtshar ba'i ltas mang po byung legs/ dgong rdzogs dang nang rten la sogs pa rnams ni dpyal a mo gha'i rnam thar las 'byung ba ltar ro/ /—62—

bla dpyal gyi gdung rabs rin po che'i za ra tshags/bla ma de la mkha' spyod kyi chos lnga dang ldan pa ni rang bzhin gyi yid kyi yid yod pa dang / 'bad rtsol med par ting nge 'dzin skye ba dang / mngon shes lnga dang ldan pa dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi zhing khams gzhan du gshegs nus pa dang /'dod yon la chags pa med par longs spyod pa dang / tshe bskal ba dpag tu med par thub pa dang lnga'o/ /rgyas par 'dod na rnam thar sna mang na gzigs/bla ma de nyid la slob ma mang na'ang / rag pa spyi'i rnam bzhag la/ dge slong chen po bzhi/ dge brnyen chen po bzhi/ man ngag gi rgyud 'dzin dam pa gnyis thugs yid gcig tu 'dres pa gnyis/ sprul pa gang zag chen po gnyis te/ de yang shes bya thams cad mkhyen pa'i dge slong rkyang dur ba 'jam dpal shes rab 'od zer/ phyag rgya chen po'i rtogs pa nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i bsam gling pa dge slong rdog dar ma rdo rje dang / rgyud sde mtha' dag la mkhas pa'i dge slong dga' ldan pa tshul khrims bzang po/ mdo sde sngags kyi gsung rab ma lus pa la mkhas shing bla ma la sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes dang ldan pa khro phu ba dge slong byang chub dpal dang bzhi'o/ /dge brnyen bzhi ni/ mdo rgyud thams cad la mkhas pa'i phul du phyin nas mthu stobs kyi nus pa mthar phyin pa dpyal ban nag po chos blo/ drag po mngon spyod kyi 'phrin las mthar phyin pas dgra bgegs thul ba'i dge bsnyen pha jo rong ston rnams gtsug phur gsum la grub pa brnyes pas grub rtags grangs med ston nus pa pho rog mdo sde mgon po/ dam pa nas dam par skye ba rgyud cing dam pa'i ring lugs 'dzin pa'i dge bsnyen rong pa rga lo dang bzhi'o/ /man ngag gi —63—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ pad+ma rdo rje'i gsung chosaskor/rgyud 'dzin dam pa gnyis ni bla ma'i thugs zin pa'i sgo nas man ngag gi gnad phyung ste gzhan la ston nus pa shangs zhal ngo ba bsod nams bzang po dang /gnyal hrul po thugs yid gcig tu 'dres pa'i slob ma gnyis ni bla ma la sangs rgyas dngos kyi mos gus dang ldan pa'i sgo nas/ zhabs tog tshul bzhin sgrub cing / spyan sngar rgyun mi chad par bzhugs pa nye gnas yon tan dpal dang /bgres po dpal bzang po'o /sprul pa'i gang zag chen po gnyis ni/ rgyal ba byams pa'i sprul pa khro phu lo tsā ba byams pa'i dpal dang / rje btsun seng ge sgra'i sprul pa dpyal lo tsā ba a mo gha don yod dpal bzang pa'o/ /gzhan yang stag ri lo tsā ba skyo ston ri ba dpal chen/ skyi 'khar nyi phug pa/ rgyan gang po a mes spun la sogs pa byung pa'o/ khyims bdag ral pa can zhes kyang grags so/ /'phags pa'i sprul pa 'phags pa'i dge slong mchog /'phags pa'i yul nas 'phags pa'i gsung rab blangs/ /'phags pa'i bstan pa 'phags pa'i skad kyis spel/ /'phags pa'i sgra bsgyur 'phags pa'i spyi bos 'dud/ /ces bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /dben pa yin yang bshad sgom gnyis kyi 'go tshugs pas gdan sa dang por grags so/ /rang gzhan lus kun kun tu don yod mdzad/ /ngan 'gro kun la bde 'gro'i dpal ster zhing / /srid mtshor byings rnams 'dren pa bzang po gang / /—64—

bla chen dbyal gyi gdung rabs rin po che'i za ra tshags/pad+mo can du bde gshegs phyag 'tshal lo /rang don mthar phyin gzhan don yod pa la/ /mnyel med rtse mdzad gdul bya dpal chen po/ /bshes gnyen bzang po mnyam med bla ma dang / /slob dpon byang chub sgrub pa'i mchog la 'dud/ /chos kyi dpal bskyed sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrungs/ /chos min 'joms byed blo gros thogs pa med/ /chos kyi blo gros gcig tu dge zhing gsal/ /sngags sdi/ba dpyal ban nag po phyag 'tshal lo/ /de yang dpyal pa stag gi sras mched gsum las/ gcen po bla ma pad+mo can pa ni bla ma lo tsā ba'i thugs kyi sras te/ de yang yum gyi lhums su zhugs pa nas yum sku lus bde zhing thugs dgyes pa dang / zhabrungs dus kyang ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dang bcas 'khrungs te/ mtshan yang kun dga' snying po zhes btags la / kun mthun kun kyang dga' bar byas/ /mi dga' gcig kyang byed ma myong/ /zhes mtshan don yang de ltar du ldan la/ dgung lo bdun pa la 'bri klog gnyis ka rdzogs shing / dgung lo dgu pa la paṇa chen rdo rje gdan pa la dgyes mdzad kyi rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang bskur ba'i dus/ bla ma de nyid rdo rje 'chang dngos su gzigs/ gzhan yang lo paṇa gnyis la chos mang du gsan/ khyad par du mkha' —65—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ pad+ma rdo rje'i gsung chos skor/spyod pa la dgyes rdor gyi skor na ro'i 'grel chen/ phag mo'i skor bde mchog /gshin rje'i skor rnams dang / dgung lo bcu gnyis pa'i dus su dgyes pa rdo rje la bshad pa yang mkhas pa'i tshad du phyin/ 'khor lo sdom pa rdo rje dril bu pa'i dbang bskur zhus pas dbang don brda 'phrod pa byung gsungs/ de nas dgung lo bcu bdun la rab tu byung nas mtshan yang (mtshams 'dir ma dpe phran bu ma tshang / slar rnyed tshe 'dir 'jug rgyu/)la gzhal yas khang gi bskor pa bla ma'i sku 'bag la zhing khams mtha' yas pa'i bskor ba'i bkod pa dang ldan no/ /de yan chod tsam gyis lo tsā ba rnams sman lung dang khri gsum ban tsho ra dza rnams 'dzin pa las/dpyal a mo gha 'dis gtsug lag khang 'di lta bu bzhengs nas 'phrin las kyang dar zhing rgyas pas myang la stod g.yas ru rong gtsang dbus lha sogs 'phrin las kyis khyab bo/ khyad par spa gror phebs/ lam du jo mo lha ris lus dngos su bstan nas mchod pa dang chos nyan pa dang / tshogs khang bkra shis ring mor nyams myong khyad par can dpon slob kun la byung ba dang / gzhi bdag dngos su 'dus nas bka' nyan pa dang / mar me cung zad tsam la yun ring thub pa dang /lhog pa btul nas deng sang gi bar du lhog nad mi 'ongs pa dang sgom chen pas bde mchog tu mthong ba dang / mkha' 'gro dbang du 'dus pa la sogs pa mang po byung shing khyad par du yi dam lha'i zhal gzigs pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das la dgyes rdor phyag gnyis pa dang / kyai rdo rje gshin rje la sogs pa'i yi dam dang bcas pa zhal gzigs/ dzam bha lha nag po nor rgyun ma mgon po beng la sogs pa mang du gzigs so/ / —66—

bla chen dpyal gyi gdung rabs rin po che'i za ra tshags/mchod pa dang maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba'i dus/ rje btsun seng ge sgra seng ge'i steng na 'dug pa zhal gzigs shing / rigs kyi bu khyod skye ba 'di'i pha rol tu pad+mo can zhes bya ba'i 'jig rten du bde bar gshegs pa'i sras nyid du gdon mi za bar 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan to/ /mtshan yang zhing khams pad+mo can pa zhes grags so/ /de ltar ngo mtshar ba'i mdzad pa mang mod kyang yi ges 'jigs nas cha tsam du zad do/ /de ltar chu bo rgyun gyi rnal 'byor la mnyam par 'jog cing 'gro don rgyun ma chad par dbang byin rlabs/ mdo rgyud man ngag gi chos 'khor rgya chen po'i char chen pos skye 'gro'i zhing la grol/ lo tog rgyas par mdzad nas dgung lo drug cu rtsa brgyad pa sbrul gyi lo gres nya ba'i yar tshes gcig la dpa' bo dang dpa' mos bsus ste pad+mo can du bde bar gshegs so/ /bla ma de nyid la slob ma'i gtso bo bstan pa'i srog shing chen po lnga las skad gnyis smra ba'i dbang po/ thar pa lo tsā ba nyi ma rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po shes bya ji lta ba dang / ji snyed pa mkhyen pa dge sdings pa kun mkhyen chos sku 'od zer/ mdo rgyud kyi dgongs don thugs su chud cing / byang chub kyi sems 'byongs pa mkhan chen gang pa ye shes/ bla ma'i gsung rgyun dang rnam thar phyin ci ma log par skyong ba shags pa lde ston/ zag med kyi mngon shes mnga' zhing bla ma'i gdan sa non pa dpyal nyi ma dpal bzang po/spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul pa a mo gha/ /snyan rgyud gdams pa 'dzin pa'i dpal ldan bzang / /gzhan don rlabs chen 'grub pa'i stobs po che/ /—67—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ pad+ma rdo rje'i gsung cho~X skor/pad+mo can du bde gshegs gang 'di rgyal/ /zhes de ltar du lo tsā ba 'di yan gyi ring la/ dka' spyad sbyangs pa mchog tu gyur pas rtsa ba'i sa bcad brgyad pa dang paṇ+ḍi ta dang / gzhan lo tsā bar du ma rgyud par chos mkha' 'gro'i kha rlangs ma nyams par dbang 'byor pas na/ dam chos rang 'gyur gyi che ba dgu pa'ang rtogs so/ /'gyur gyi zhib gsal ni stong mthun dang gsan yig las rtogs par bya'o// //ka10 gdung rabs rgyun mi chad pa'i che ba bshad pa/rtsa ba'i sa bcad bcu pa ni/ bar pa dpyal byang chub rgyal mtshan ni/ yab chos lugs kyi bstan bcos la mkhas shing / byang chub kyi sgrub pa la brtson pa las/ rong du yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa'o/ /gcung po slob dpon chos kyi blo gros ni/ yab chos gsang sngags gsar rnying mtha' dag la sbyangs pa mthar phyin nas/ slob dpon gyi go 'phang thob nas kyang / rnam snang rig pa'i rwa bar/dmar rdo rje rtse mo'i drung du tshad ma rnam nges kyi bslab pa mthar phyin nas/ chu mi+og rgya sgor gsungs te smon lung yab kyi gdan so non pa/ 'dod lha dang chos skyang 'grub pas/ 'byung pa thams cad bran du bkal bas/ dgra gzan thams cad brlag par byed pa'i rnal 'byor pa chen po/mdo sngags bstan pa'i gru la bshad sgrub bzhugs/ /dad brtson spobs pa'i nus mthus pha rol phyin/ /phyir rgol chu srin rba klong zil gyis mnon/ /—68—

bla chen dpyal gyi gdung rabs rin po che'i za ra tshags/sngags chang nag po chos blo rgyal gyur cig /ces bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug bla chen sku yi sras/ /chos kyi dbang phyug bshes gnyen gsung gi sras/ /dngos grub dbang phyug pho rog thugs kyi sras/ /slob dpon rnal 'byor dbang phyug dge gyur cig /ces pa pad+mo can pa la sras gsum 'khrungs pa las/ slob dpon dbang phyug 'di gdung rabs ltar na bar pa yin lags kyang 'dir mtshan bstod 'di sngon la byung ba bzhin/ 'di nyid shin tu mdzes shing lta na sdug pa yid du 'ong ba gcig la / shes rab dang dad brtson 'dzoms pa/ yid gzhung pa yod pas 'gro mgon pho rog pa'i gsung nas/ nga'i bla ma mkha' spyod lo tsā ba dang dbyer mi mi 'dug gsungs nas/ thugs yid gcig tu 'dres nas bla ma la nan gyis zhus nas bya khyung gi mnga' bdag tu dbang bskur ro/ /mkhyen rab dbang phyug shes bya'i dngos kun gsal/ /thugs rje'i nyi mas skal ldan chu shel brlan/ /dpal ldan gsung zer bzang po'i lam ston pa'i/ /sku yi dkyil 'khor brjid chags la phyag 'tshal/ /ma sgoms mnyam bzhag nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gsal/ /ma bcos rjes gcod chos 'dod gdul bya'i dpal/ /ma 'bad theg mchog bzang po'i rtser phyin pa'i/ /—69—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ pad+ma rdo rje'i gsung chos skor/dpal ldan nyi ma me shel pad+ma dang / /gang ba'i zla me chu shel kun da dang / /ljon shing bzang po ri khrod skye ba dang / /bla ma mchog khyod 'jig rten kun gyi mgon/ /zhes pa nyi ma dpal 'di nyid thog mar rgya bod gnyis kyi 'bri klog dang thugs dam lha bzhi khyad par lha bzhi'i chos bskor rnams kyi dbang bskur dang byin rlabs dang / rjes gnang dang / bcas pa pad+mo can pa la thob nas rgyud 'grel man ngag dang bcas pa la mkhas par gyur kyang chu mig gi tshad grwa rnam snang rig pa'i chos sder/ slob dpon smra ba'i seng ge dar ma mdzes dang / yangs pa'i blo gros chos kyi rgya mtsho 'jam pa'i dbyangs la tshad ma rnam nges bslabs pa mthar phyin nas grwa pa la gsungs shing mtshan nyid kyi bstan bcos la'ang mkhas par gyur nas bla ma'i gdan sa thar pa gling dge 'khor dang bcas pa'i mnga' bdag mdzad kyang khengs skyung dang / thos pas mi ngom par chos 'tshol bas bla ma dga' ldan pa tshul khrims bzang po la gsang ba 'dus pa rtsa ba'i rgyud dang / rgyud phyi ma dang / bshad rgyud sde bzhi dang / gnyis med rnam rgyal la dgos pa'i rgyud 'grel man ngag /lung cha lag phyag len dang bcas pa gsan cing mkhas par mdzad la/bla ma rong pa rga lo la dpal dus kyi 'khor lo bsdus rgyud 'grel pa cha lag dang bcas pa gsan cing thugs su tshud par mdzad nas/ lung rtogs yon tan gyi rgyud phyug par gyur te 'gro ba'i don mdzad cing / yi dam lha'i zhal gzigs pa dang / mngon par shes pa'ang ci rigs su mnga' ba/ thugs kyang shin tu grol —70—

bla chen dpyal gyi gdung rabs rin po che'i za ra tshags/bas/ bu slob rnams la kho bo na yin tsha min mi sdod par 'gro bas khyed rnams dge ba'i bya ba la 'bad par mdzod gsungs nas bsnyung ba med par ltas bzang po dang bcas nas zhing khams rnam par dag par gshegs so/ /gcung po bla ma chos bzang gi rnam thar 'og nas 'byung ba ltar ro/ /bla ma nyi ma'i mtshan can gyis/ yab kyi nang rten du/ jo bo shākya mu ne'i sku tshad dang mnyam pa gtsang tshong 'dus mgur mor bzhengs cing rten gyi nang na bla ma'i mtshan 'bul/ rgyud sde bzhi'i gzungs snying po nye snying rnams mthing shog la spur rus kyis gris/ byang chub shing la 'bras dang bcas pa gnas chen brgyad kyi sa/ nā ro'i rus rgyan gyi tshal ba bi pu ta tsaspro'i dbu zhwa/ dbu skra na bza'i tshal pa dpyal gong ma rnams kyi ring bsrel/ bla ma rang gi sku gdung ring bsrel rdo rje dril bu/thugs dam phreng ba la sogs pa dang / rin po che dang 'bru sman gso dar chos skyong dang / nor lha'i gzungs ni rab tu gnas pa'i yi ge bzhin du yod lags/phyi rten 'bum khang khang bu ltar yod pa'i nang na/ gser gyi mchod rten de'i nang na gdung ring bsrel dang rten mang po bzhugs/ le tshe nub ma na thugs dam lha bzhi dang / ston pa'i sku bla ma nyid kyi phyag tsha rnams bzhugs pa'i phyi rten bzhengs so/ /bla ma de nyid kyi slob ma mchog tu gyur pa 'khon gdus ba gzhon nu ye shes ni gdung rgyud rin po che dbyer med cing / sku drin shin tu che bas rnam thar zur gcig smos na/ sku'i 'khrungs yul ni gang gi dbye ba yin lags/ sku gzhon nu nas thar pa gling du byon nas rab tu byung ba mdzad phar tshad gnyis/'dul ba mngon pa/ rnam 'grel la sogs pa la legs par sbyangs nas mkhas —71—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ pad+ma rdo rje'i gsung chos skor/par gyur cing / dpyal pad+mo can pa la/ dpyal lugs kyi thugs dam bzhi'i thog drangs pa'i chos skor rnams tshig gcig kyang ma lus par gsan nas thugs su chud/ bla ma nyi ma dpal sku bgres shing bla ma rin chen dpal sku gzhon pa'i bar la / gdan sa lo drug mdzad nas 'chad nyan dang dbang bskur rjes gnang lung byin rlabs mang po gnang / rgyud brtag pa gnyis pa la 'grel pa yang mdzad/khyad par byang chub kyi sems 'byongs pa'i rtags su/ drung na yod pa'i gdul bya rnams la byang sems ngang ngam shugs kyis skye ba la sogs pa'i yon tan dang ldan zhing bde bar gshegs nas kyang mkhan chen pa'i gsung 'dzin pa la byin rlabs 'jug go /de'i nang rten du thub sku shin tu mtshar ba bzhengs shing / rten gyi nang na bla ma brgyud pa'i mtshan 'bum bka' 'gyur gyi gzungs snying po sangs rgyas kyi ring bsrel/ mkhan chen gang ba rang gyi gdung ring bsrel/ gnam rgyan/sku chos lhung bzed/ thugs dam 'phreng ba la sogs pa byin rlabs kyi rten dang /gzungs bzhugs kyi rten 'brel tshang bar bzhugs so/ /phyi rten bzang 'bum pa'i nang na gser gyi mchod rten ngo mtshar dang ldan pa'i nang na yang / gang dang 'dra ba las bla ma rang gi rdo rje dril bu dbu rgyan thod pa rnam sbyar rin po che sna lnga/sku gsung thugs kyi rten mang po bzhugs/ logs briba'ibla ma brgyud pa/ rgyud sde bzhi'i lha tshogs mang po bzhugs so/ /ngo mtshar mtshan dang ldan pa'i dbang phyug dang / /ma rig mun pa sel ba'i nyi ma dpal/ /byang chub sems gnyis 'byongs pa'i mkhan chen pa/ /—72—

bla dpyal gyi gdung rabs rin po che'i za ra tshags/mtshungs med bla ma rnam gsum rgyal gyur cig /ces bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /mkhyen rab 'jam pa'i dbyangs dang gnyis su med/ /thugs rje'i mnga' bdag rje btsun spyan ras gzigs/ /mthu stobs dbang phyug kun mkhyen lo tsā ba/ /nyi ma rgyal mtshan zhabs la gus pas 'dud/ /'phags pa'i yul na thub dbang gnyis pa zhes/ /kha ba can na kun mkhyen sgra tshad pa/ /bshad sgrub bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan legs 'dzin pa'i/ /mkhas grub khyod la spyi bos phyag 'tshal lo/ /ka la pa sogs phyi nang kun rig pa'i/ /kha ba can na sna lnga'i paṇ+ḍi ta/ /gangs can mkhas mang dbus na lham me ba/ /ngur smrig 'dzin pa'i gtsug rgyan de la 'dud/ /ces pa lo tsā ba 'di nyid gdung rgyud rin po che dbyer med cing dpyal gyi thugs sras slob ma dang / slob dpon gnyis ka yin legs shing khri thog tu ma phebs kyang / mkhan chen gang ba'i rjes su 'dul khang mkhan po mdzad nas bshad grwa dang / zur 'chad mdzad nas/ spyir bstan pa dang sgos gdan sa 'di nyid la bka' drin che ba'i mchog tu gyur pas/ rnam thar zur tsam zhig smos na rig pa'i 'byung gnas rgya gar la phebs/ rgya gar shar nub na mkhas pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta mang po —73—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ pad+ma rdo rje'i gsung chos skor/bsten nas mkhas pa'i yang mkhas pa chen po gyur nas maṅga dha rdo rje'i gdan du bcom ldan 'das thub pa chen po'i gdan sa lo gsum mdzad cing / mu stegs kyi rtsod pa bzlog pas bod kyi btsun gcig mar grags pa byung ngo / /rgya gar du lo bcu bzhi bzhugs nas slar bod du phebs nas kyang sems can mang po smin grol la bkod/ 'du khang mkhan po dang sngags kyi slob dpon mdzad pas bshad sgrub zung du 'brel bas mkhas grub gnyis ka'i snyan grags kyis sa gsum kun tu grags pas slob ma bu chen bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'dus/ khyad par mchog tu gyur pa bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa la sgra rig pa dang sbyor drug gi gnad kyis nang don rig pa gtan la phebs/ gzhan yang dpyal lo tsā ba rin chen dpal bzang dang dpyal ston ar+ya shrī /sa skya pa bla ma mnyam/ med chen po bde rgyas pa don yod dpal ba/ la stod shes rab bzang po/ dbus pa blo gsal/ 'dul 'dzin tshul khrims gzhon nu/ bla chen kun rdor ba kun mkhyen shes rab ral gri /mkhan chen shes rab 'od zer la sogs pa mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa mang du 'dus shing gdul bya phal mo che'i don mdzad cing sku bde bar gshegs nas kyang / rgya'i hūṃ paṃ hūṃ zhes bya bar sku zhabrungs la de nas rgya gar shar phyogs chos kyi rgyal por sku 'khrungs shing / de nas gdul bya ma gtogs sku skye ba mi len gsungs par gda'/ mdor na lo chen de'i rnam thar la gzhal tshad med pas 'bri bar mi nus/ skabs don gnas skabs su lo tsā ba de'i nang rten sku 'dra gnyis las chung ba dgung lo bcu gnyis pa'i tshad dang / che ba sku 'dra sku tshad dang mnyam pa'i gzungs zhugs snying po la/ gtsug tor na bla ma'i mtshan 'bum —74—

bla chen dpyal gyi gdung rabs rin po che'i za ra tshags/spur rus kyis bris pa/ thugs ka na bka' 'gyur ro cog gi gzungs snying po/yang snying / sangs rgyas kyi ring bsrel/ klu sgrub la sogs pa mkhas grub du ma'i ring bsrel/ byang chub kyi shing yal ga lo 'bras dang bcas pa mahā bho dhi zhal rtsi thub pa chen po'i bzhugs khri'i dum bu/ gnas chen brgyad kyi sa/ paṇ+ḍi ta tram ki pa kar+ṇa shrī thugs dam phreng ba/ paṇ+ḍita a mo gha'i phyag dpe/ dbu skra/ phyag sen/mkhan chen pa rang gi sku gdung ring bsrel/ dbu skra/ dbu zhwa/ na bza'/ chos gos gsum/ thugs dam phreng ba/ gzhan yang khyad ras la rgya bal gyi rten la byin rlabs zhus pa'i phyag dpe'i na bza' dri spos kyi byugs pa dang / sman spos 'bru dar rin po che rnams kyang tshang bar bzhugs so/ /bla ma nyi ma dpal gyi sras lcam sring gsum las/ che ba rin chen dpal bzang ni ji skad du/pho dpal che sku brjid pa bdag gis dpal/ /gsung rab dpal gyur gsung snyan gnang ba'i dpal/ /'gro ba'i dpal gyur thugs rje yid kyi dpal/ /dpal gyi sku gsung thugs rgyan phyag 'tshal lo/ /tshogs gnyis rin chen spungs pa lhun po'i sku/ /dam chos rin chen sgrog pa nor bu'i gsung / / mkhyen chen rin chen 'bar ba nyi zla'i thugs/ /dkon mchog rin chen gcig bsdus phyag 'tshal lo/ /bstan pa'i brdzid khur glang chen mdog bzang po/ /srid mtsho sgrol ba'i ded dpon gru bzang po /—75—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ pad+ma rdo rje'i gsung chos skor/bzang po'i mtha' can bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa 'di nyid kho bo cag gi bla ma dam pa ste/ skye bo yongs kyi dpal mgon/dngos grub 'dod dgu stsol ba'i rin po che/ legs lam bzang po ston pa'i bshes gnyen yang dag pa ste/ dgung lo bdun pa la 'bri klog rdzogs shing /dgyes rdor/ bde chog /phag mo/ gshed dmar te/ thugs dam lha bzhi dang bde mchog dkar po/ phag mo ser mo/ mkha' spyod ma dmar mo/ rje btsun seng ge sgra dang bzhi ste/ khyad par lha bzhi la sogs dpyal pa'i pha chos kyi dbang byin rlabs/ lung rjes gnang dang bcas pa nyi ma dpal dang mkhan chen gang pa la thob cing mkhan chen pa la dgyes pa rdo rje'i rgyud brtag pa gnyis pa/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i gzhung drug sbyin sreg phyag len dang bcas pa la gsan sbyangs mdzad nas/ dgung lo bcu gcig pa la tshogs pa mang po la gsungs te/ dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga dang sgrub thabs dang / las tshogs dang bcas pa'i phyag len la mkhas par mkhyen cing yon tan gyi rgyud phyug par bya ba'i phyir/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs blo gros rgya mtsho la sher phyin gyi bstan bcos mngon rtogs rgyan 'grel pa dang bcas pa gsan nas sbyangs pa dang / mkhan chen lo tsā ba'i drung du/ saṃ skṛ ta'i skad kyi klog yig dang / sgra mdo dang / khams dang / rkyen dang / ting ba dang / su ban dang / nyer bsgyur la sogs pa sgra rig pa'i mkhas par mkhyen cing / spyir mtshan nyid kyi bstan bcos mngon pa kun las btus pa la mkhas par gyur nas dge 'dun tshogs su gsungs so/ /nang sngags kyi rgyud la byang bar mdzad pa yang / dpal dus kyi 'khor lo —76—

bla chen dpyal gyi gdung rabs rin po che'i za ra sa/bsdus pa stong phrag bcu gnyis pa dang / 'grel pa dri ma med pa'i 'od dang lnga bsdus la sogs cha lag dang bcas pa dgyes pa rdo rje'i bshad rgyud mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur dang / de'i 'grel pa cha lag dang samyu tri/ de'i 'grel pa man ngag snye ma la sogs pa cha lag dang / dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rdo rje phreng ba skor gsum la sogs pa nang gi chos mang du gsan cing mkhyen la/ dgung lo bco lnga pa la gdan sa chen po 'di bzung nas dbang lung byin rlabs la sogs pa tshogs chos gsungs pa la sogs gdul bya'i don rgya cher mdzad cing / bla ma gser sdings pa'i drung nas/ bde mchog la sogs pa'i dbang bka' nod cing rgyud dang sgrub thabs la sogs pa'i lung mtha' yas pa nod la/ yang bla ma sre'u chung pa dang /bla ma 'gyed kha ba gnyis la dbang byin rlabs dang chos lung mang du thob bla ma grub chen u rgyan pa'i drung du'ang zab lam rdo rje gsum gyi bsnyen sgrub la sogs pa man ngag zab mo rgya mtsho lta bu brnyes/ kun mkhyen chos sku 'od zer ba'i drung du'ang bde mchog la sogs pa'i dbang rjes gsum gyi byin rlabs dang man ngag rgya mtsho lta bu gsan nas thugs nyams bzhes/ bsnyen sgrub dang mtshan med kyi rnal 'byor la rgyun du gnas pa'i ngang nas/ sems can gyi 'gro don rgya chen mdzad pa ni 'brug gi lo 'go la chos dang zang zing zung du sbrel nas mchod spyin ni sgrol dang rā dza dang / lcags dang / sbug yul dang / klung shod dang bsam gling dang / man ngag dang / ser ra la sogs pa stong skor gyi dge 'dun dang / sngags pa stong phrag bzhi dang skye bos tshogs stong phrag gcig ste stong phrag lnga la tshang ba gral 'gyed 'gyed dang bcas pas 'khor gsum yongs su dag pas rgyas btab —77—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ pad+ma rdo rje'i gsung chos skor/bo/ /de ltar bla ma de'i dpal 'byor dang sku'i yon tan gyi 'phrin las nus mthu che bas hor gyi rgyal po sidhi pha la go dan rgyal po dang / de'i btsun mo dam pa byang chub sems ma chu khus lung dang 'ja' sa bcas pa dang / 'phags pa ti shri kun dga' blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i lung gis dge bshes rin chen dpal bzang 'di dpyal pa'i gdung rgyud rnam par dag pa yin cing /sku'i yon tan dang stobs mnga' thang yang / gzhan las che bar 'dug pas lha sde stong skor thams cad kyi mchog dang gtso bor bkos pa yin no gsung nas gnang sbyin dang / lung 'ja' sa dam kha dang bcas nas gnang / bla mas kyang dpal ldan sa skyar la slob ma'i tshogs dang bcas phebs/ gsung rab kyi 'grel gtam dang tshogs su bshad pa mdzad pas mkhas pa'i grags pas sa steng khyab pa byung / de nas bzung gdan sa'i dbyar chos dgun chos kyi rgyun thams cad dpal ldan sa skya la legs pa'i srol tshugs/ bla ma 'dis sku gsung thugs kyi rten rnying pa gso zhing gsar pa bzhengs pa yang yab kyi nang rten thub pa'i sku mi tshad dang mnyam pa bzhugs khri rgyab yol 'phul ma dang bcas pa mtshar ma bzhengs pa'i zhabs rdzongs dkar chag na gsal zhing / byang chub chen po'i dbu la dbu rgyan shin tu legs pa kyi rdo rje'i gzhal yas khang mtshar ba byang chub chen po'i gdan khri bkod legs gser kyi byugs shing / gzhan yang yab kyi phyi rten khang zang gañdzi ra dang bcas pa'i nang na gser 'bum gsum bzhugs pa'i nang na'ang gdung ring bsrel mang po dang / sku gsung thugs kyi rten mang po bzhugs so/ /ldebs kyi dbus la bla ma nyi ma'i sku 'bag la rgyud pa'i bla mas bskor ba —78—

bla chen dpyal gyi gdung rabs rin po che'i za ra tshags/dang rgyud sde bzhi'i lha tshogs mang po bzhugs so/ /sgo gong la grub chen brgyad cu'i brgyud bris/ sgo gdong la mgon po stag bzhon lcam dral gyi bris sku la sogs pa ngo mtshar ba bzhengs so/ /de ltar na bla ma dam pa de'i sku'i yon tan dang dpal 'byor mnga' thang 'phrin las nus mthu bsam gyis mi khyab pas/gdan sa chen po dang / mnga' 'og gi bu slob dge dang bcas pa skyong dar thugs brtse zhing snyoms pa'i tshad dang ldan pas yar ngo zla ba'am/ dbyar gyi chu bo'am dpag bsam ljon shing ltar rgyas par mdzad nas bde bar gshegs pa'i tshul bstan no/ /de ltar bla ma de mkhas btsun bzang gsum 'dzoms pas slob ma mang du byung mod kyang mchog tu gyur pa ni/ mkhyen rab kyi dbang phyug 'khon nam mkha' yangs pa'i shes rab/ lung rigs gi dbang phyug 'dul 'dzin tshul khrims gzhon nu dpal/ mthu stobs dbang phyug dpyal ar+ya shrī/ mdo rgyud man ngag gi dbang phyug rong pa shes rab seng ge'o/ /'phags pa'i rigs 'khrungs 'phags pa'i bstan la bzhugs//'phags pa'i gsung rab 'phags pa'i skad la sbyangs/ /'phags pa'i yon tan khyad par 'phags pas rgyan/ /dpal ldan mdo rgyud pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa bla ma ar+ya shrī ni/ yab chos thugs dam lha bzhi'i thog drangs rnams kyi dbang byin rlabs dang / rgyud 'grel nyer mkho dang bcas pa dang / phag mo'i gzhung bdun gyi gtso byas pa'i dus chos gsungs shing / bla ma dang yi dam gyi byin rlabs kyi snyung nad rtsol med du sbrags cing / 'bri klog lha bris lhar bzo la —79

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ pad+ma rdo rje'i gsung chosaskor/sogs pa bzo rig gnas rnams rtsol med rang byung du phul du phyin par mkhyen pas/ bris sku mang po dang / gshed dmar gyi blos bslangs la sogs pa phyag len kyang mang du mdzad nas bzhengs/ yab nyi ma dang mkhan chen gang pa gcen po bla ma dpal dang gsum la dbang lung rjes gnang byin rlabs dang bcas pa thob cing / khyad par kyi rdo rje'i rgyud dang / de'i 'grel pa nā ro pas mdzad pa phag mo bzhung drug gi sbyin sreg rab gnas man ngag dang bcas pa gsan/gzhan yang kun mkhyen rong pa dus 'khor ba shes rab seng ge la dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang dang rgyud 'grel bshad pa'i lung mang po gsan/ thams cad mkhyen pa chos kyi 'od zer la sogs pa'i rtsa ba'i bla ma dgu tsam bsten nas nag 'jag gi skor gsum gyi dbang bka'/ lung rgyud kyi 'grel pa/ lag len dang bcas pa gsan nas mkhas par mkhyen/ dpal ldan sa skya ru phebs nas rgyud 'grel gyi bshad pa dang / man ngag mang po gsan sbyong mdzad pas thugs dam dar che zhing brtul zhugs kyi spyod pas gdon bgegs kyi mi tshugs pa/ shugs 'byung gi spyod pas dgag sgrub gi 'dzin pa dang bral ba/ thugs dam smin pas byin rlabs mthu stobs kyi mnga' bdag des/ gcen po lo chen rin chen dpal bzang gi nang rten thub pa'i sku mi tshad la bzhugs khri rgyab yol dang bcas pa/ rten gyi gtsug gtor na rgya gar gyi gnas chen brgyad kyi sa la thub pa'i tshems mche ba la khrus gsol ba'i chus sbyar ba'i thub pa'i sku dpyal lo'i thugs dam lha mdzad pa zhig bzhugs shing / gzhan yang bla ma rgyud pa'i mtshan 'bum thugs ka na sangs rgyas kyi 'phel gdung / bka' 'gyur ro cog gi gzungs snying rnams spur —80—

bla chen dpyal gyi gdung rabs rin po che'i za ra tshags/rus kyi bris pa/ mkhan chen gang pa'i gdung ring bsrel/ rnam sbyar/ sku chos/lhung bzed/ thugs dam phreng ba la dgos pa'i byin rlabs kyi rten/ rin po che sna tshogs la sogs pa'i gzungs bzhugs kyi rigs ma tshang ba med par yod legs/ phyi rten 'bum khang nang na gser gyi byugs pa'i mchod rten gsum gyi nang du'ang sku gsung thugs kyi rten dang / bla ma rang gi sku 'dra dang / gdung ring bsrel mang po bzhugs legs/ ldebs la dbus su bla ma'i sku 'bag la rgyud sde bzhi'i lha tshogs kyis skor ba ngo mtshar dang ldan pa bzhengs pa la sogs pa 'gro ba'i don dpag tu med pa mdzad nas dag pa'i zhing du thegs so/ /shes rab gzungs su bkod nas sprul pa'i sku/ /dus gsum rgyal ba bskyed pa'i zhing du gyur/ /'phags ma sna tshogs tshul gyi 'gro ba 'dren/ /dpyal gyi lcam mo ma gcig ston ma mchod/ /ces bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /de la lcam mo slob dpon ma ston ma ni dpyal gyi chos skor ci rigs pa mkhyen nas rgya nag la byon nas rgyal po'i btsun mo'i bla ma mdzad/ gdan sar byang chub chen po'i dbu thog tu bla bre thub pa bdud 'dul ma'i bkod pa yod pa dang / gsung rab rnams la gdong dar gsum rim/ chos skyong gyi phywa dar sku mdog dang mthun pa la 'byed legs par byas pa bla ma ar+ya shrī'i drung du skyong dar bkra shis khra ring la sogs pa'i 'bul skyel phul nas rgya nag tu bzhugs so/ /rgyal ba'i rnam 'phrul rin chen dpal bzang dang / /—81— ci

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ pad+ma rdo rje'i gsung chos skor/rtogs pa nu mthu'i mnga' bdag 'phags pa dpal/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro'i tshul bzung ston ma'i mtshan/ /ngo mtshar lcam sring rnam gsum rgyal gyur gcig /ces bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /ji skad du/shes bya kun la rang dbang 'byor pa'i thugs/ /chos kyi sgo la kun nas dbang bsgyur gsung / /mtshan dpe bzang pos kun nas brgyan pa'i sku/ /dpal ldan ha ri pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes dpyal pad+mo can pa'i sras tha chung / dha ri ba chos bzang ni dgung lo gzhon nu la yab chos ma lus pa mkhyen nas kyang / bla ma mi nyag rga lo tsā ba la dus kyi 'khor lo'i bsdus rgyud dang / de'i 'grel pa dri ma med pa'i 'od dang 'grel chung pad+ma can dang / dbang mdor bstan 'grel pa mchan dang bcas pa dang / don dam snye ma la sogs pa ma lus par mkhas par bslabs te/ gzhan yang bla ma gser sdings pa chos kyi 'od zer dang / zhal mnga' bsod nams rin chen/ ri shong pa nyi 'bum la sogs pa la sngags mang po zhus/ 'dul grwa chen po skyor mo lung du byon nas bsnyen par rdzogs shing 'dul ba mdo dang / so sor thar pa dang / karma sha tam la sogs pa legs par mkhyen/ zhi byed dang / yo ga phur la sogs pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs du mas 'gro ba'i don mtha' yas pa dang khyad par la rgyab dang / bya khyung la sogs pa'i bu slob rnams kyi don mdzad nas lug gi lo bde ba can du gshegs so/ /de'i sras/—82—

bla r+sā dpyal gyi gdung rabs rin po che'i za ra tshags/sangs rgyas bstan la byang chub kun 'byung gnas/ /rin chen chos kyi 'dod dgu stsol ba'i dpal/ /dge 'dun bzang pos skye dgu'i yid 'phrog pa'i/ /mkhyen rab bzang po de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa sangs rgyas 'byung gnas rin chen dpal bzang po dang / 'phags pa rgyal mtshan pa gnyis las gcen po slob dpon 'phags pa rin chen pa zhes bya'am/ sangs rgyas 'byung gnas dpal bzang po ni/ gzhon nu la yab chos ma lus pa mkhyen te/ dgung lo brgyad pa la dgyes pa gsungs shing slob dpon gyi go 'phang thob kyang / rig pa'i gnas lnga la mkhas pa'i mkhan chen thar pa lo tsā ba'i drung du/ mngon pa dang tshad ma rnam nges/ rigs thigs la sogs pa la slob pa mthar phyin nas mkhas pa'i mdun sar gsungs so/ /dpal ldan sa skyar yang bla ma chen po 'jam dbyangs pa'i drung nas sa skya pa'i chos srol ji snyed pa dang / dus 'khor la sogs pa'i rgyud 'grel mang po bslabs shing / byang chub sems dpa' kun seng la/ phar phyin gsan cing gsungs te/ yon tan gyi rgyud phyug par mdzad nas 'gro don ni nyang phyogs la mdzad do/ /gcung po slob dpon 'phags rgyal ba ni yab chos thugs dam lha bzhi'i thog drangs pa'i gsang sngags kyi chos la mkhas shing dbang byin rlabs dang rgyud 'grel la sogs pa thugs su chud cing mkhyen legs/ sa skyar yang bla ma sku mched drung du/ sa skya pa'i chos srol du ma bslab la/ rang chos thugs dam lha bzhi dang yo ga phur zhi byed la sogs pa'i phyag len la shin tu mkhas shing thugs dam la brtson pa —83—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ pad+ma rdo rje'i gsung chos skor/dang / bslab gsum la gces spras su byed cing dul ba yon tan gyi rgyud phyug cing mngon par shes pa thogs med du mnga' bas ma 'ongs lung du ston la khyad par shar dga' ba'i rgyal brgyud kyang lung bstan nas 'gro don phal cher myang phyogs la mdzad do/ /snyan pa'i grags pa mchog gi kun tu khyab/ /phan bde'i 'byung gnas 'gro ba'i bla ma mkhyen/ /srid zhi'i dpal la kun du spyod pa la/ /kun la mkha' ltar dag pa'i thugs mnga' ba/ /dga' ldan skyong mdzad mi pham mgon po bzhin/ /legs pa'i lam la 'gro ba 'dren mdzad pa/ /mkhas btsun bzang sum ldan pa gang de rgyal/ /yang dpyal 'phags pa ba'i sras gnyis kyi gcen po gu ru grags pa 'byung gnas pa ni thugs dgongs dge zhing dpyal pa'i chos skor rnams dang / lung rtogs kyi chos du mas rgyud phyug cing byin rlabs mchog dang ldan pa'o/ /gcung po mkhas btsun kun legs pa ni rang chos dpyal lugs kyi chos skor ma lus pa dang / bu lugs kyi chos skor mang po/ dwags po bka' brgyud dang / shangasapa bka' rgyud pa'i chos skor dang / spyod yul pa'i gdams ngag dang / bka' gdams kyi chos pa'i lung rtogs kyis rgyud phyug pa'i byin rlabs dang ldan pa'o/ /gdul bya phal cher myang stod phyogs su mdzad pa'o/ /'gro ba kun la dga' bde'i dpal stsol zhing / /—84—

bla wo dpyal gyi gdung rabs rin po che'i za ra tshags/rgya chen tshogs gnyis bzang po mthar phyin pas/ /mtsho ltar zab pa'i dgongs pas 'gro ba 'dren/ /dpyal ston 'khrul zhig zhabs pad spyi bor len/ /ces pa gu ru grags pa 'byung gnas pa'i sras kun dga' rgya mtsho ba ni gzhon nu la rab tu byung zhing / kun mkhyen rin po che la thugs dam lha bzhi'i dbang lung /khyad par lha bzhi kyi rdo rje'i rgyud gsum/ nā ro'i 'grel chen/ sgrom lde rtsa 'grel/bslab tshigs ring mo/ zhal gdams bcu gcig /dril bu rim lnga/ gshed phur gnyis kyi rgyud/ shin tu spros med/ gsang 'dus 'phags lugs la sogs rang chos ma lus pa'i dbang lung rje gnang phyag len dang bcas pa dpyal kun mkhyen rin po che la thob/ gzhan chos ni/ paṇa chen don yod dpal ba/ 'jam dbyangs nyi ma bsod nams/ kun mkhyen chos kyi dpal ba/ man lung rin po che/ti ti grags 'od pa/ bla ma 'phogs pa rnams kyi drung du gtugs naso rang chos dang / sa skya pa dang / dwags pa dang / shangs pa/ bu lugs dang / rngag lugs la sogs pa mkhas par mkhyen cing 'dir gdan sa yang mdzad cing / tshogs chos kyang mang por gsung la/ gnyis 'dzin kyi 'brul pa zhig pas phyogs mtha' dag la phebs dgos dang / khyad par bya khyung thar pa/ ro gang la sogs pa'i dgon gzhis rnams su/ dbang lung rjes gnang khrid byin rlabs mang du gsung te/ 'gro ba'i don dpag tu med pa mdzad nas bzhugs gnas mthil bya khyung la mdzad/ dben dgon mdza' brag dmar la mdzad myang stod phyogs su bzhugs so/ /rgyas par rnam thar las shes par bya'o/ /—85—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ pad+ma rdo rje'i gsung chos skor/rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i dbus nas legs 'ongs te/ /kun tu dga' bzhi'i dpal la longs spyod cing / /rnam grol sku bzhi'i lo tog rgyas mdzad pa'i/ /dpyal ston 'khrul zhig chen po rgyal gyur cig /ces bar skams kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /bla ma de nyid kyi sras dpyal ston chos rgyal kun dga' ba ni/ thugs dam lha bzhis thog drangs pa'i ma lus pa gsan nas rgya nag la phebs/ rgyal po'i gu shri thob/ dngul gi dam kha dang lung bzang po gnang bas dpal phun sum tshogs pa las/ dbus su bde bar gshegs so/ /de la sras chos rgyal rin po che ba dang / phyogs kyi glang po gnyis las/ chos rgyal rin chen pa ni/ grub chen kun dga' blo gros pa'i drung du dbang lung mang po gsan cing / thugs sbyong mdzad pa'i 'phro la 'brum pa'i rkyen gyis lhun grub bde chen du bde bar gshegs so/ /gcung po phyogs glang pa ni/ dpyal lugs kyi thugs dam lha bzhi'i thog drangs rang chos ma lus pa dang / sa dge ldan gnyis kyi gzhan chos la sogs pa'i lung rtogs kyi mnga' bdag /gsang sngags rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po de nyid ro khengs su phal cher bzhugs pa las/ 'gro don la 'brong rtser phebs nas bde bar btagags so/ /nus pa mthar phyin ha ri chos bzang nas/ /sangs rgyas 'byung gnas rin chen dpal bzang dang / /mngon mkhyen mnga' bdag dpyal ston 'phags rgyal ba/ /—86—

bla chen dpyal gyi gdung rabs rin po che'i za ra tshags/rab snyan grags pa'i 'byung gnas gu ru'i mtshan/ /mkhas btsun bzang gsum ldan pa'i kun legs pa/ /dngos grub mchog brnyes zhabrul zhig chos rje dang / /dga' bde'i dpa' rtsal kun dga'i mtshan can dang / /choso kyi rgyalo po rin cheno bdun gyis spras/ /mad rgyud stabs ldan yan tan lus stabs rgyas/ /phyir rgol 'jam dbyangs lung rigs mche ba can/ /rnam spyod spobs pa'i gzi 'od phyogs bcur 'phro/ /bstan pa'i ljid kyi khur khyer glang po che/ /sras rabs gcen rgyud spyi bos yang yang mchod/ /zhes pa 'di yan gyi gcen rgyud rdzogs la/dpyal gyi gdung rabs mu tig phreng ba'i rin chen 'di/ /bkra shis dpal bzang dad pa'i sras bus legs brgyus nas/ /blo gsal don gnyer mdzad pa'i mgul rgyan mdzes pa 'di/ /dad brtson dbon po tshe brtan dbang phyug thugs dges mdzod/ /lha yis rnal 'byor bzlas brjod lta stangs kyi/ /sgo gsum kun nas sngags 'chang rgyal mtshan dang / /'phags pa'i gdung 'tshob 'dod lha rin chen grub / /thugs zab ar+ya rin chen rgyal gyur cig /ces pa slob dpon chos kyi blo gros kyi mched gnyis las/ slob dpon rgyal —87—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ pad+ma rdo rje'i gsung chos skor/mtshan ni/ dang po nas thos bsam la gtso bor mdzad cing / bsnyen sgrub la gtso bor mdzad pas/ slob dpon gtad gser gsum la thogs pa med pa'i mthu chen sman lung nag tshangs byang dang / gser sdings ban mtsho lha khang gi bdag po ste/ gser sdings bla ma nyi ma dpal la phul lo/ /slob dpon ar+ya rin chen ni thugs dam lha bzhi'i dbang byin rlabs rgyud 'grel man ngag phyag len dang bcas pa thob cing mkhyen la khyad par yab kyi gdams pa zab mo la sgrub par mdzad pas drag po'i 'phrin las 'grub pas/sma lung nag tshang lho dang ra mtshams dang / gdams ngag ser ra la sogs pa'i bdag po'o/ /de dag thams cad ni gang pa byang sems mkhan chen pa la bka' drin thob pa sha stag go /dpyal ar+ya shrī la slob ma mang po yod pa'i nang nas mchog tu gyur pa kun dga' nyi ma zhes grags pa de nyid la/ ji skad du/kun mkhyen kun la brtse ba'i thugs mnga' zhing / /dga' chen nyams bzhi'i nyams myong mthar phyin nas/ /nyi ma sngon med nyi ma ltar mnyam pa'i/ /dpal ldan 'gro ba'i spyi dpal mchog khyod 'dud/ /chos tshul kun la thogs med mkhyen pa rgyas/ /sku gsung thugs kyi nyes spyod legs bsdams nas/ /chos kun snying po sku gsum mngon gyur pa'i/ /chos skyong legs grub sku de bdud las rgyal/ /kun nas dge ba'i lhag bsam rnam dag cing / /—88—

bla chen dpyal gyi gdung rabs rin po che'i za ra tshags/lhan cig skye dga'i nyams rtogs mthar phyin pas/ /mchog gi dngos grub bar dor rab grub pa'i/ /dpyal ston kun dga'i mchog tu gyur la 'dud/ /ces pa dpyal kun dga' nyi ma dpal bzang po ni yab chos gsang sngags gsar rnying ma lus pa mkhyen pa dang grub pa brnyes la/ gdan sa chen po sa skya ru phebs/ shar pa 'jam dbyangs rin chen rgyal mtshan/ kun mkhyen rong pa shesarab seng ge /skyo ston ri pa dpal chen bla chen kun dga' rdo rje la sogs pa'i mkhas grub du ma bsten cing / rgyas pa'i bstan bcos tshad ma rnam 'grel la sogs pa'i phyi nang gi bshad pa dang / man ngag lag len dang bcas pa gsan cing tshad ma'i gzhung bshad pa sgra snyan ngag me long gzhung dus 'khor la sogasapa'i rig pa'i gnas thams cad phal cher slob mi dgos par rtsol med du mkhyen cing / 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum la thogs pa med pa'i blo gros can smra ba'i zla ba zhes grags pas/ snyan pa'i sgras gangs can gyi ljongs yongs su gang zhid /kyi rdo rje phag mo chos skyong gi skor rnam rgyal la sogs pa la bstod pa rtsom par mdzad/ 'jam dpal mtshan brjod kyi 'grel pa nā ro 'grel chen la sogs pa'i rgya bod kyi bshad srol mi 'dra du ma mkhyen cing / dgung lo nyi shu rtsa bdun nas lnga cu nga brgyad kyi bar la tshogs chos gsungs shing chab srid chos kyis bskyangs nas zhi bar gshegs so/ /kun mkhyen dbang po 'gro ba'i bla ma khyed/ /chos kyi rgyal por thog med nas gyur yang / /—89—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ pad+ma rdo rje'i gsung chos skor/shes rab thabs kyis gang la gang mos kyi/ /dpal ldan 'phrin las bzang po mnga' la 'dud/ /ces so/ /rgyas pa rnam thar las rtogs par bya'o/ /bla ma de nyid la gcung po gnyis kyi bstod pa gong gi sho lo ka gsum yod pa'i 'og ma gnyis las rnam thar gsal po med do/ /dpyal kun dga' nyi ma'i sras kun mkhyen chos rgyal shes rab dpal bzang po zhes yongs su grags pa de nyid ni skye ba nas skye ba du mar mkhas par brgyud pas thugs rab bsam las 'das shing / yab kyi drung du gsang sngags mang du gsan cing / khyad par lha bzhi'i thog drangs pa'i dpyal gyi chos skor ma lus pa bum pa gang byo'i tshul du dbang lung rjes gnang byin rlabs bcas pa'i rdzogs rim gyi 'khrid dang bcas pa gsan/ khyad par kyai rdo rje'i 'grel pa drug gi rjes su 'brangs/ bshad bka' nā ro pas mdzad pa'i 'grel pa'i bshad bka'/ rdzogs rim sgrom lde rtsa 'grel phur bu la sogs rnying ma'i skor chos ma lus pa dwags shangs gnyis kyi skor zab don ma lus pa dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan pa'i drung du sa lugs ma lus pa'i skor dang / bu lugs kyi skor la sogs pa mdo sngags kyi dgongs don mtha' dag thugs su chud cing rtogs nas thugs dam lha bzhi'i thog drangs/ dpyal lugs kyi chos skor ma lus pa la 'grel pa stong mthun sgrub thabs mdor na phyag len tsam la yang / go bde khyer sla ba'i yig cha ma mdzad pa gcig kyang med cing / mdor na bla ma de nyid kyi mkhyen pa dang mdzad pa mtha' yas pas/ mtshan yang kun mkhyen —90—

bla chen dbyal gyi gdung rabs rin po che'i za ra tshags/rin po che chos kyi rgyal po zhes grags la/ dbus su gong ma grags pa 'byung gnas zhes pa dang rdzong brjid rgyal mtshan bzang po la dbang dang byin rlabs mdzad pa'i tshe/ bdud rtsi yango yang 'khol nas mchod chog la chos 'byung dod pa da lta yang yad par grags sa/ /dpon chen rgyal ba bzang pos/ tshong 'dus su gdan drangs nas dbang chos mang po gsan/ zha lu pa sku zhang ye shes kun dga' pa la dbang khrid du ma gnang cing gzhan yang rgyal mkhar rtse ba chos rgyal rab brtan kun bzang 'phags sku mched la dbang dang chos mang po gsung / ta'i si tu bsod nams dpal ba yab sras la yang chos 'grel mang po mdzad/ gzhis kha rin chen spungs par nam mkha' rgyal po sku mched la yang dbang dang / chos 'grel mang po mdzad cing mkhas btsun bzang gsum 'dzoms pa'i snyan pa dang / grags pas phyogs thams cad du khyab pa dang / dbus gtsang gi dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang /sde dpon la sogs pa mdor na 'gro ba dpag tu med pa'i 'dren mchog tu gyur cing gdan sa 'di nyid du'ang / dgon pa'i phyi'i lcags ri chen mo dang bla brang 'og min rtse la sogs pa dag gdan sa'i phyi thes dang yab nyi ma'i mtshan can gyi nang rten sku 'dra sman 'byin las grub pa ngo mtshar can dang phyi rten thugs dam 'bum pa char khebs/ chos 'khor gser gyi tog dang bcas pa zla ba gcig la grub pa mdzad do/ /de ltar zhib tu rnam thar dang bka' 'bum gsan yig la sogs par rtogs par bya'o/ /bla ma de nyid gdul bya'i dbang gis bde bar gshegs pa'i tshul bstan yang / sku'i skye ba zha lu mkhan chen 'khrul zhig tshul —91—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ pad+ma rdo rje'i gsung chos skor/khrims rgyal mtshan du bzhes nas 'gro don rgyun chad med do/ /bla ma de nyid la slob ma'i mchog bla ma drug slob dpon bzhi/ sde dpon bdun rnams byung ba las/dang po dpyal ston zhabrul zhig chen po 'jam dbyangs thugs rje chos rgyal/ bla chen ar+ya shrī /chos rje don yod rdo rje/ 'jam dbyangs bkra shis dpal ldan/ bla chen 'od zer dbang phyug rnams so/ /gnyis pa/ dga' ldan pa slob dpon tshul khri+oms rgya mtsho/ bde rgyas pa slob dpon rino chen rgyal mtshan/ mthong smon po slab dpan bsam gtan/ mkhar lung pa slab dpan dad pa dpal bzang pa rnams so/ /gsum pa sku zhang ye shes kun dga' pa/ dpon chen rgyal ba bzang po/ gong ma grags pa 'byung gnas/ rdzong brjid rgyal mtshan bzang po/ chos rgyalo rab brtan kun bzango 'phags/ drung che+on dbang rgyal 'phags/ si tu bsad nams dpal/ nang sa nam mkha' rgyal pa rnams sa/ /chos rnams kun gyi gnas lugs thugs chud nas/ /rgyal ba'i bstan la rgyal sras mdzad pa can/ /kun mkhyen mkhyen rab dbang phyug rgyal gyur cig /ces pa bla ma de nyid kyi nang rten sman 'byin las grub pa'i sku 'dra sku tshad ma dang yar klung sne gdong pas thub pa sprul pa'i sku rkang gang pa shin tu mtshar ba thar par bzhugs shing / khyad par 'phags pa'i zhabs rdzongs gong ma rnams dang mthun pa'i steng du+o bla ma nyid rang gi sku gdung ring bsrel/ lha sku byon pa sku chos rnams bzhugs sa/ /dpyal gyi gdung rabs mtshan nyid lnga phrag lnga/ / —92—

bla chen dpyal gyi gdung rabs rin po che'i za ra tshags/zhal ngo che long bcu phrag lnga dang brgyad/ /mi yul srid tshan nyi shu tsam du gyes/ /tshan re rer yang zhal ngo dpag med dar/ /lha'i skad la sbyangs pa'i lo tsā bdun/ /dngos grub chen po brnyes pa lnga bcu'o/ /lo tsā ba 'byung gnas rgyal mtshan gyi sras gnyis las/ gcung mchog snying po ni yab chos gsang sngags rnying ma mchims phu'i phyag bzhes ma lus pa mkhyen cing /gsang ba 'dus pa rgyud drug la sogs pa la mkhas par sbyangs shing sgrub pa la brtson pas dngos grub brnyes shing / mtshan rtags kyang ci rigs su mnga' 'o /de'ang tshugs thub pas zha lu pa lce btsun gyi 'bangs se 'og dang gru skyi zhes pa rgya ma tsho bzhi yod pa nas gas shing kun 'khrugs nas mi bsad mang po byung ba la/dpyal ban nye ring med cing thugs snyoms pas zhi ba'i bsdums byas pas bde ba la 'god cing thams cad kyi spyi mchod mdzad do/ /de rjes srad pa'i sa cha rnams bla ma la phul lo/ /se rtsa mchog rab de la sras dpyal ston shes rab blo gros byung ba ni/ yab chos rnying ma'i skor ma lus pa mkhyen cing bzhugs gnas phal cher ra rtsa phyogs la mdzad do/ /'di la sras gnyis byung ba'i gcen po lo tsā ba shes rab 'od zer dang gcung sgom gyi pa'o/ /lo tsā bas rgya gar la byon pas paṇ+ḍi ta satu karti la sogs pa mang po'i zhabs la gtugs te/ sgra tshad dang /mdo sngags kyi chos mang po mkhyen cing / bod du phebs nas kyang 'gyur mang po mdzad/ lo tsā ba brgya rtsa brgyad kyi nang mtshan yin/ bzhugs gnas srad po la —93—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ pad+ma rdo rje'i gsung chos skor/mthil mdzad do/ /dpyal sgom gyi pa ni/ yab chos rnying ma la mkhas shing sgrub pa la brtson pas grub pa'i dbang phyug tu gyur to/ /sngags 'chang kun gyi gtsug rgyan mchog rab dang / /blo gros mtshungs med shes rab blo gros dang / /shes rab 'od zer bla ma sgom gyi pa/ /mtshungs med bla ma yab sras rgyal gyur gcig /ces bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /bla ma sgom gyi pa la sras gnyis byung ba'i che ba dpyal ston yon tan rgyal pos yab chos gsang sngags gsar rnying ma lus pa mkhyen/ khyad par du gyur pa gsang bdag seng ge'i drung du/ rtsa rgyud gsang ba snying po dang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dgongs pa 'dus pa dang lo chen be+e ro'i rgya 'gram bod 'gram la sogs pa dang ma shen rgyal gsum la sogs pa'i 'phrin las kyi rim pa ci rigs par gsan nas/ mkhyen rab kyi bdag po gyur pa de la/ sras gsum byung ba'i che ba grub pa shes rab/ bar pa grub pa dpal/ chung ba dpyal ston ye shes bsod nams so/ /bla ma ye shes bsod nams de ni dge slong rnam par dag pa yin zhing dpyal lugs kyi thugs dam lha bzhi la sogs pa'i chos ma lus pa mkhyen/ khyad par du kyai rdo rje'i la 'grel pa dang stong mthun yang mdzad/ skyo ra lung pa don yod dpal gyi gdan sa mdzad nas/ sgom sde rtsa 'grel gyi sgom grwa dang / brtag gnyis kyi bshad grwa btsugs so/ /yon tan kun la mkhas pa'i rgyal po dang / /—94—

bla chen dpyal gyi gdung rabs rin po che'i za ra tshags/grub pa shes rab grub pa dpal la dang / /ye shes bsod nams mkhas pa'i dbang po ste/ /bla ma'i rgyal tshab rnam bzhi rgyal gyur cig /ces bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /dpyal grub pa shes rab la sman lung nag tshang du sras gnyis 'khrungs pa las/ de la 'di skad du/shes rab mchog gyur snyan grags bzang po dang / /srid gsum kun dga'i 'byor pa bkra shis te/ /gcung rgyud dpyal dkar dri med gyur pa gang / /rin chen gter gyi tshul du bzhugs pa rgyal/ /ces pa che ba shes rab grags pa dang / kun pa jo sras kun dga' bkra shis te/bla ma shes rab grags pas yang dag me dmar dgu pa dang / rdo rje phur pa'i skor dang / dgyes phag la sogs pa gsar ma'i chos ci rigs pa mkhyen cing bzhugs gnas phal cher sman lung srad dper la mdzad do/ /chung ba jo sras kun dga' bkra shis ni ngang rgyud ring zhing byams brtser ldan pa sbas pa'i rnal 'byor tshul du bzhugs so/ /de'i sras mched gnyis kyi dang po ni slob dpon sangs rgyas chos rgyal te/ gzhon nu la kun mkhyen rin po che'i zhabs la gtugs nas rab tu byung nas thugs dam lha bzhi'i thog drangs dpyal pa rang gyi chos gser btso ma lta bu rnams ma lus par mkhyen nas dgyes rdor bshad pa stong mthun chen po dang bcas pa mang du bshad cing / sku mched kyi drung du dbang rjes gnang / lung byin rlabs rab gnas sbyin sreg la sogs pa ma lus pa thob —95—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ pad+ma rdo rje'i gsung chos skor/cing phyag len la yang shin tu mkhas par thugs gshis legs pas kun mkhyen rin po che'i thugs sras su gyur nas gdan sar sang bskos gnangs bskos bde bar gshegs te/ de la 'dir/sgrib gnyis sprin tshogs ma lus rab spangs shing / /sangs rgyas chos tshul kun la mkhyen pa rgyas/ /rgyal ba'i bstan la rgyal sras mdzad pa can/ /kun mkhyen bla ma'i thugs sras mchog de rgyal/ /ces pa'o/ /gnyis pa chos 'byor dpal bzang po ni/ /'gro ba du ma'i 'dren pa dam pa ste/ kun mkhyen rin po che sku gnas bgres pa/ dpyal ston 'khrul zhig chen po myang stod phyogs su gdul bya rgya che bas/ khu dbon gnyis bka' bgros nas/ dge bshes chos 'byor ni rang re'ang gdung rgyud rnam dag kyang yin/ mi gshis dang / yon tan gyis kyang chog par yod cing / rang res gnyis khams bzang thog la gdan sar bskos pa drags gsung pa bzhin thar pa gling gi tshogs chen por tsha ja zung 'brel gyi bsnyen bkur bzang po dang bcas pas gdan sar byon no/ /choso rje khu dbon 'jam dbyangs nyi ma bsod nams/ bla ma bsod nams bzang po/ 'phags pa kun mkhyen ye shes/ 'jam dbyangs chos dpal shes rab rnams dang rgya gar shar phyogs kyi paṇ+ḍi ta chen po shrī pu ṭa mahā pa mi la sogs pa bla ma du ma'i zhabs rdul spyi bos blangs nas/ spyir bka' mdo rgyud dang / sngags don spyi khyab dang / khyad par du thugasadam lha bzhi khyad par lha ba gtor chen dpyal lugs/ phyi yul gyi gdams ngag /phyag rgya chen po lhan —96—

bla chen dpyal gyi gdung rabs rin po che'i za ra tshags/cig skye sbyor/ rtsa rgyud brtag gnyis/ spyod 'jug sbyor ba yan lag drug pa la sogs pa'i khrid bka' dang dbang bka' mang po gsan/ thugs dam mthil phyag rgya chen po la mdzad/ yid dam kyai rdo rje dang phur pa/ gshed dmar/ phag mo rnams la mdzad/ 'phrin las kyang kha 'bar ma gdab pa tsam gyis dgra bgegs rdul du rlogs/ khyad par chos skyong la mnga' brnyes zhing zhal gzigs/ bka' nyan cing ci gsung gi 'phrin las sgrub par khas blangs shing srog snying phul/gzhan yang dga' ldan pa tshul khrims rgya mtsho rnams la chos ci rigs pa gsan/rgyas pa gsan yig chen mor lta bar bya'o/ /dbyar chos dgun chos la brtag gnyis dang / spyod 'jug la bshad chos res mos mdzad cing sku tshe mthar phyin pa'i bar du dpal thar pa gling chab srid bcas pa'i mgon skyabs dang 'gro ba du ma'i 'dren pa dam par gyur pa de la mchog gyur gyi bu chen du byung na/ mkhyen rab gyi dbang phyug hre'u chung ba/ sprul sku rdo rje seng ge /dman pa'i sa las ring du 'phags shing mkhyen rab nam mkha' dang mnyam pa dpyal ston 'phags pa kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ mdo sngags kyi gzhung lugs rab 'byams la mkhas shing / khyad par du tshangs spyod stan gcig pa'i brtul zhugs la gnas pa/ mkhan chen blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i rigs bdag rdo rje 'dzin pa dge slong bkra shis bzang po/ thugs dam lha bzhi'i bskyed rdzogs kyi gdams ngag zab don phyin ci ma log par rtogs pa bla ma chos rgyal bsod nams so/ /gzhan yang slob dpon shes rab/ slob dpon mkhyen rab/ slob dpon bde legs/ slob dpon dam chos la sogs pa gdul —97—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ pad+ma rdo rje'i gsung chos skor/bya phal mo che'i rnam dkar lo tog la phan bde'i 'bras bu smin par mdzad pa'i bla ma de la 'di skad du/chos rnams ji snyed ji bzhin mkhyen pa can/ /thugs rje'i 'byor pas dpag yas gdul bya skyong / /dpal ldan mngon mtho nges legs 'phrin las can/ /'dren mchog bzang po mchog khyod rgyal gyur cig /ces pa'am/shes rab mchog gyur grags pa'i mtshan can dang / /'gro ba'i ded dpon kun dga' bkra shis dang / /byang sems chen po sangs rgyas chos rgyal dang / /mkhas grub chen po chos 'byor dpal bzang ste/ /grub chen bla ma rnams bzhi rgyal gyur cig /ces bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /'og sngon chen po las/ yang dpyal ston chen po'i sras gcig gsol ba btab pa bzhag pa ni/ dpyal kun dga' chos rgyal te chos rje kun mkhyen rin po che'i zhal nas/ 'di la nged rang dpyal pa'i mi spyad rnams kyang tshang 'dug cing / drung gdan sa pa'i sras yin nges su 'dug pas/ chos rje rin po che de nyid dang bla ma ar+ya pa'i drung du chung ngu nas rab byung mdzad/ dgyes phag sogs yab chos sngags phyi nang dang mdo bstan bcos man ngag gsan sbyong mdzad/ dpyal chos 'byor dpal bzang pa'i drung du brnyen rdzogs mdzad nas dpal thar pa gling gi tshogs chen por bsnyen —98—

bla chen dpyal gyi gdung rabs rin po che'i za ra tshags/bkur bzang po dang bcas nas gdan sar byon nas tshogs chos gsung / thar pa gling dgon cha lag dang bcas pa skyong zhing myang stod smad du gdul bya du ma'i 'dren pa po la bzhugs so/ /de la 'di skad du/srid gsum kun dga' dpal la mnga' brnyes shing / /khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po srid skyong ba/ /bde legs rgya mtsho'i dpal la 'dren pa bzhin/ /kun spyod bzang pos 'gro ba 'dren la 'dud/ /ces pa'o/ /sgrib gnyis mun pa'i tshogs dong 'khor gyur pa'i/ /shes rab bzang po'i bka' srol mi mnyan na/ /thugs rjes bskyangs pa'i chos rgyal yid can gyis/ /dpyal dkar gdung rabs mngan par rab dad pas/ /mgo sngon chen mo kha bskong bgyis pa yis/ /dge ba rab bsngo nongs pa bzod par gsol/ /'di ni dpyal rgyud dri ma med rnams kyi rnam par thar pa mdo tsam mngon par bkod pas na/ mgo sngon zhes byar kun gyi rtogs par shog /ces pa 'di ni dge ba'i gshes gnyen maṅga lo bha dras bskul ba'i ngor/ 'jam dbyangs chos kyi mtshan can gyis sbyar ba'o/ /zhes gsung la/ gdung rabs ltar na bla ma chos 'byor dpal bzang po'i sras mched gnyis las gcen rin chen bzang dngagacung 'phags pa kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'o/ /'phags pa kun —99—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ pad+ma rdo rje'i gsung chos skor/dga' rgyal mtshan pa ni/ sku tshe snga ma la yi dam lha'i rjes su bzung ba'i stabs kyi thugs rab nam mkha' dang mnyam pas gsung rab la gzigs pa tsam gyis tshig don gnyis ka thugs su chud cing 'chad rtsod rtsom pa la thogs pa med pa'i spobs pa can des/ yab kyi drung du dpyal lugs kyi chos skor dri mas ma gos pa'i gzhud lugs rgya mtsho lta bu gsan nas nyams su bzhes/ zur chos pa bla ma 'od zer dbang phyug pa dang / slob dpon bkra shis bzang po rnams las nye bar mkho ba'i phyag len la sbyangs pa mdzad/ dbus su gong ma 'jam dbyangs kun dga' legs pa'i ti shri thob/ 'phyongs rgyas pa nang so sangs rgyas skyabs pa sku mched kyis bla ma'i zhabs spyi bor blangs/ chos rgyal rab brtan kun bzang 'phags yab sras dang / dus si rin chen 'phags pa sras kyi bla ma mdzad/byin rlabs dang mkhyen pa che ba'i tshad du byung ste/ dgung lo bco lnga la khri thog tu phebs te/ yab kyi sku 'dra sku tshad dang mnyam pa gtsang khang na bzhugs pa dang 'dra 'bag chung ba mchod dbyangs la gzhi byas bzhengs pa gzim khang na bzhugs/ bla brang chen po'i g.yab ring sgo khang dang bcas pa bzhengs te/ dgon pa'i phyi thes la dgongs shing gzhan don 'grub kyang dgung lo nyi shu rtsa lnga la 'brum pa'i rkyen gyis bde bar gshegs/ 'di nyid la sras thar pa rgyal mtshan pa byung ba ni sku gzhon nu la rab tu byung ba mdzad/ slob dpon bkra shis bzang po'i drung du/ bde mchog gshed dmar/ phag mo gzhung drug /khyad par bde mchog dkar po rus sbal zhabs/ seng ge sgra /gdugs dkar rnam rgyal/ rnam 'joms/ tshe dpag med la sogs pa chos mang du gsan cing bstan pa'i bdag —100—

bla chen dpyal gyi gdung rabs rin po che'i za ra tshags/po zhig yong ba yod pa de sku gzhon nu la bde bar gshegs/'phags pa'i sprul pa kun dga' rgyal mtshan dang / /bstan pa gsal byed thar pa'i rgyal mtshan dang / /'khrul zhig chen po rin chen bzang po ste/ /mtshungs med bla ma rnam gsum rgyal gyur cig /ces par skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /dpyal ston chos 'byor pa'i sras chen po rin chen bzang po sku gzhon dus slob gnyer mdzad rgyu ma byung na'ang sku bsod che zhing dpyal lugs kyi chos ci rigs su mkhyen yang gdan sa ni mdzad sku tshe mthar phyin pa'i bar du bzhugs so/ /de nyid la sras gsum 'khrungs pa'i che ba dpyal ston yon tan shes rab/ bar pa kun bzang pa/ chung ba dbyal ston 'od srung rgyal mtshan te/ bla ma yon tan shes rab pa ni slob dpon bkra shis bzang po'i drung du thugs dam lha bzhi'i thog drangs pa'i chos mang po gsan nas thugs nyams su bzhes shing phyag len la yang mkhas par mdzad/ khyad par chos skyong la mnga' mnyes pas drag po'i 'phrin las la thogs pa med cing thugs dam mthil phyag rgya chen po lhan cig skyes sbyor la mdzad do/ / bla ma 'phags pa ba'i sku 'dra khyad par can yang bzhengs shing / gdan sa lo bcu gcig mdzad nas bde bar gshegs so/ /bar pa kun bzang pa ni chos sde dpal 'khor sde chen du mkhan chen dkon mchog bzang po'i drung du rab tu byung zhing thugs dul ba byams snying brtser ldan pa byang sems rgyud la 'byongs pa de nyid chos sdings pa dang / thar pa ba rang —101—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ pad+ma rdo rje'i gsung chos skor/rtswa kha'i rtswa la 'brug zing byung ba la sems 'di lta bu'i nyon mongs pa'i dbang gis gnod 'tshe byas/ su la yang srog gi bar chad byung na mi rung dgongs/ nye ring spangs pa'i snying rjes kun nas blangs te/ rang gi sku srog la ma ltos par bar mi mdzad pa na/ bar mi gzhan zhig dang nor nas mtshon 'phangs pa phog ste bde bar gshegs so/ /dpyal ston 'od srung rgyal mtshan pa ni mkhan chen blo gros rgyal mtshan pa'i drung du phar phyin gsan nas chos sde dpal 'khor sde chen du bshad gsar gyi grwa bskor mdzad de 'jam dbyangs dkon mchog bzang po'i drung du sbyor ba yan lag drug pa gsan/ ri khrod dga' ldan du chos rje nam mkha' tshul khrims pa'i drung du bu lugs kyi chos ci rigs dang bde mchog dang / dpyal lugs kyi phag mo gzhung drug sbyin sreg dang bcas pa blo sbyong rgyal sras bka' 'bum la sogs pa gsan/ mkhan chen kun dga' 'od zer ba'i drung du/ kyai rdo rje/ 'khor lo chen po tshe dpag med kyi dbang blo sbyong zhen pa bzhi bral la sogs pa'i chos mang du gsan/ thar pa dang bya skyung la sogs par phur pa'i dbang mo che la sogs pa chos kyi char phabs pas/ gdul bya dpag tu med pa'i don mdzad de/ dgung lo drug cu rtsa bzhi'i bar du gdan sa mdzad nas sbrul lo dbo'i dkar phyogs kyi tshes bcu gcig la bde bar gshegs so/ /yon tan kun la mkhas pa'i shes rab dang / /kun mkhyen bzang po'i lam mchog sa lam 'phags/ /ma rig mun sel 'od srung rgyal mtshan pa/ /—102—

bla chen dpyal gyi gdung rabs rin po che'i za ra tshags/mtshan gsum dpyal rgyud mched gsum rgyal gyur cig /ces bar skabs gyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /bla ma 'od srung rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po de la sras po zhig sa mo glang la sku 'khrungs pa ni/ ji skad du/ gang gis mkhyen pa'i nam mkha' nor bu zer phrag dpag med rab rgyas pa/ /'phrin las stobs kyi 'char nub bgrod tshul phyogs bcu'i thub bstan rab gsal zhing / /rmongs pa'i rab rib gtan bcom gang zhig dad pa'i pad+mo kha che ba'i/ /mkhyen rab dbang phyug rab 'byams smra ba rig pa'i dbang por gus phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa'i bla ma rig pa'i dbang phyug pa de nyid sku gzhon nu la zha lu mkhan chen chos rje rig 'dzin rgyal po'i drung du rab tu byung ba mdzad nas bstan bcos phar phyin la grwa skor mdzad/ gsang 'dus kyi dbang dang sbyor ba yan lag drug pa gsan/gzhan yang gang gi mkhyen rab nyi ma'i 'od stong ldan/ /thub bstan gling bzhi khyon du legs shar bas/ /zheg mchog bstan pa'i pad tshal rgyas par mdzad/ /mchog tu mkhas pa'i mkhas pa de la 'dud/ /ces pa sku zhang chos rje mkhyen rab dbang phyug dpal bzang po zhes yongs su grags pa de nyid kyi drung du bsnyen rdzogs mdzad cing rnam sras kyi rjes gnang dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i zhal shes la sogs pa gsan/ de nas 'bras yul skyid mos tshal du phebs/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' chos bzang po'i drung du/ phar phyin/ tshad ma rnam 'grel/ 'dul ba la sogs pa'i po ti mang po gsan cing —103—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ pad+ma rdo rje'i gsung chos skor/thugs la chud cing / mi g.yo ba'i sgrub pa mdzad pas rtags dang mtshan ma brnyes nas mkhyen rab nam mkha' dang mnyam pa byung bas/ rtsod pa'i yul thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba'i yul dang / rtsom pa la spobs pa nye bar sgrub pa thob pas bsdus dpe la rtsom pa yang shin tu legs pa mdzad/ gzhan yang brgyad stong glegs bam la zhal 'don mdzad cing rtsed thang dang zha lu gnyis su rab 'byams kyi grwa skor yang mdzad pas/ tshig don bzung du 'brel ba'i 'bru bshad la mkhas pa rnams ngo mtshar skyes pas dbus gtsang du snyan pa'i grags pas khyab cing mkhas pa'i yang log smra'i rgol ba ngan pa ring nas zil gyis gnon pa chos grwa chen po gsang phu dang bkra shis lhun po/ snar thang dang / gser mdog can la sogs par rtsod pa'i 'gran pa'i zla med pa yongs su grags pa de nyid de nas thar par yab gshegs nas gdan sa chen por phebs dgos zhu ba'i zhu cha dang /khyad par zha lu mkhan chen gyi gsung nas da thar par yab kyi gdan sar phebs pa drag gsungs pa la/ bdag 'bras yul skyid mos tshal gyi mkhan po byed par khas blang yod lags pas/ thar par mi gsungs lags/ bla mas yang bka' lung nan can phebs te/ spyir yul kyi mkhan po yang 'chad rtsod rtsom pa la brtson pas bstan pa la phan na'ang da res thar pa ba gdung rus btsun zhing chos rgyud zab pa dang phyi mchod khungs btsan yin pa dang / las smon dang rkyen stobs la dgongs nas gdan sar phebs gsungs pa bzhin/ skad gnyis smra ba'i chos grwa dpal byang chub thar pa gling du dge 'dun skya ser yon bdag gi tshogs la tsha ja zung 'brel gyi bsnyen bkur bzang po'i khri ston dang bcas pas dgung lo sum —104—

bla dpyal gyi gdung rabs rin po che'i za ra tshags/cu pa me mo sbrul la khri thog tu phebs te/ chab log rtogs pa kun dge bcu'i spyod pa la zhugs su btsud cing rnam par dkar ba'i mdzad pa rgya che bas/ 'gro ba du ma'i mgon dang dpung gnyen du gyur pas dus rtag tu sbyin pa rnam pa bzhis 'gro ba kun gyi yid tshim par gyur la/ khri thog tu phebs nas yun mi ring ba'i skabs shig na/ lugs gnyis kyi 'dun pa chen po gzhi kha rin chen spungs nas/tshogs gnyis kyi lhun po mngon par mthong ba'i mdzad pa rlabs kyi spyod pa'i bdag nyid legs spyad rgya mtsho'i dpal gyis 'byor cing dad sogs don bcu'i spyan yangs dang ldan pa'i lung bstan pa'i skyes bu chen po chos kyi rgyal po chen po don yod rdo rje ba de nyid/ 'dod dgu'i dpal 'byor gtams pa'i pho brang gzhi chen der mjal ba la phebs/ yon mchod gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i 'brel zab la dgongs nas sde pa dang gsung gleng yang lugs gnyis la zhib tu byung bas thugs dgyes pa'i bka' lung dang spyi mchod kyi 'ja' sa rgyab skyor dang / byibs pa lha 'khor tshang ma dang bcas pa la sogs te gnang sbyin yang mang du byung / thugs 'phreng ba'i rnam 'gyur yang cung zad byung ngo / /gzhan yang rgyal rtse ba chos rgyal 'phags pa'i yab sras dang lhun grub rtse nas rgyal chen kun grags pa yab sras la sogs pa sde pa mi chen kun gyis bkur cing mchod la/ 'dir yang dbang dang / byin rlabs mang du gsan cing gang dang gang 'tshams pa'i thabs kyi 'gro ba'i don mdzad la khyad par ma 'ongs pa lung du ston pa thogs pa med pa/ bden tshig 'grub pa'i nus pa mnga' bas/ pha ma dbul po zhig gi bu btsun pa byed pa la byung bas khyod nor mi 'dug pas ming nor 'phel gyis gsungs pas/ phyis —105—
