mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ pad+ma rdo rje'i gsung chos skor/skyid cing 'byor pa byung ngo / /yang lan gcig gzim chung sgo skad byung bas khams phrug chung ngu zhig gis ltar phyin pa na phyag 'tshal gsung phyag phul bas da byin rlabs zhus gsung /byin rlabs sngon ltar zhus pas de'i 'og tu zhus gsung nas gsang gnas su mgo bo mnon pa mdzad zin pa dang nor 'ongs pa yod gsung pa la de la phyis zang zing gi nor bdag tu ma bzung yang / chos kyi nor lam sna zin nges kyi rnal 'byor chen po zhig byung ngo / /yang lan gcig grwa rkyang zhig la khyod la bu gsum 'ong ba 'dug gi gsung des bdag bud med byas pa mi byed zhus pas mi byed kyang 'ong gsung pas de la bu gsum yang byung ngo / /gzhan yang mi 'di la ma 'ongs na 'di 'dra yong gsungs pa rnams ji lta ba bzhin byung ngo / /bla ma de nyid ni mngags pa thugs dam lha bzhi dang / do ha skor gsum la mdzad thugs dam mthil phyag rgya chen po la mdzad/ gsung 'chad nyan rnams brgyad stong 'grel chen dang / do ha 'chad pas rin po che nas drung gdan sa pa dpon slob la sogs pa'i grwa pa bu slob kyang phyogs phyogs nas 'dus shing mi dang mi ma yin pa'i 'gro ba du ma'i bu slob kyi rnam dkar gyis sa gzhi la thugs rje'i bdud rtsi'i char babs pas rten 'brel gyis brlan drod la brten nas rgyud gnas kyi sa bon la dad brtson gyi myu gu 'khrungs te/ thos bsam gyis lo 'dab skyes sdong po skyes/ nyams rtogs kyi rtse mo la rnam grol gyis 'bras bu smin par mdzad/ bla ma de nyid sku snyung ba'i tshul bstan pa na/ chos rgyal rgyal ba'i dbang po de nyid phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i pho brang smon grub khyung rtse na bzhugs pa'i dus/—106—

bla chen dpyal gyi gdung rabs rin po che'i za ra tshags/tho rangs zhabs 'chag skor ba mdzad pa na/ thar pa'i sman lung mchod khang la 'ja' dkar po snam bu tsam zhig rkang btsugs pa ltar dus gtan du zug pa gzigs pas dpyal pa'i gdung rgyud 'di gzhan dang mi 'dra ba 'dug gsungs nas zhe sa dang mi chos sngar sde pa la 'bul dgos pa dus de nas bzung mi bzhes pa tshur mos pa chen po mdzad do/ /de ltar ngo mtshar ba'i ltas mang mod kyang yi ges 'jigs nas cha tsam du zad do/ /de nas dgung lo zhe drug pa shing pho khyi'i sgron zla ba'i dmar cha'i tshes bcu'i nub mo la babs pa'i dus/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa dang dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro mang po bsu ba la byung pa dang / rtag 'dzin can gyi skye bo skyo ba skyes pa dang / zhing 'di'i gdul bya rdzogs pa dang / shar phyogs mngon par dga' ba'i gdul bya dus la babs pa khyab che ba la dgongs te/ gzhan snang gzugs sku'i bkod pa chos kyi dbyings su thims so/ /der sku gdung las sngar tshor ma myong ba'i dri zhim po ngad ldan 'byung ba rgyun mi 'chad pa de mchod pa'i bye brag du ma dang bcas sku 'bum du bzhugs so/ /de nas dgongs rdzogs sku tshigs rnams kyi nyin/ nam mkha' sprin med du dag pa la 'ja' 'od kyi bkod pa 'dod khams kyi lha'i mchod rdzas kyi bkod pa bas kyang khyad par 'phags pa lta bu me tog 'dab ma gsum pa dang lnga pa dang brgyad pa la sogs ni kha dog phal cher dkar po dang sna tshogs dang dmar ser ljang khur 'dug pa dbyibs tshad phub tsam dang khu 'phangs tsam gyi nam mkha' gang ba ni mi kun gyi mthun snang du grub pa byung ngo / /der mchog gyur gyi bu chen ri bo che ba'i gdan sa pa'i —107—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ pad+ma rdo rje'i gsung chos skor/gzigs pas seng ge dkar mo zhig la chibs nas/ dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro du mas bsus te shar phyogs mngon par dga' ba'i zhing du nges par thegs pa'o/ /bla ma de nyid la sras gsum byung ba las/ che ba sku gzhon nu la bde bar gshegs te/ spur rus kyi mar me 'dzin cing mi ma yin kyi bskor ba byed pa byung ngo / /bar pa rdo rje rin chen pa de nyid shing mo glang la sku 'brungs te ji skad du/dam pa'i zhabs rten mi 'gyur rdo rje'i sku/ /dri med zab lam rin chen sgron ma'i gsung / /shes bya'i gnas kun rtogs pa'i mkhyen brtse'i thugs/ /sku gsum lhun grub chen po'i zhabs la 'dud/ /ces pa de nyid ngor pa mkhan chen sangs rgyas rin chen la rab tu byung snye/ dgung lo bcu gsum pa me mo glang la gdan sar phebs/ de nas zha lu mkhan chen lo tsā ba de'i zhabs kyi pad+mo la gtugs te/ sgra rig pa'i bstan bcos la mkhas shing lha ris dang / lder bzo la sogs pa bzo rig pa'i bstan bcos dang /snyan ngag dang / khyad par dpyal lugs kyi dbang man ngag ci rigs pa mkhyen cing thugs mkhyen par ldan pa de nyid lcags mo yos la sku gshegs/ chung ba dpyal ston kun dga' rdo rje ba de nyid lcags mo rta la sku 'khrungs te sku gzhon nu la/ mgon des rje bzung dam pa'i lam brnyes shing / /sdom pa gsum ldan rim gnyis rnal 'byor can/ /dpal ldan dus kyi 'khor lo gsal mdzad pa'i/ /—108—

bla chen dpyal gyi gdung rabs rin po che'i za ra tshags/'jig rten mi mchog rtsa ba'i bla mar 'dud/ /ces pa zha lu mkhan chen lo tsā chen po de nyid drung du rab tu byung nas dga' ba gdong du rab 'byams pa rin chen grub pa'i dgongs pa bstun/ rang nyid kyang thugs gnyer la mthun 'dun drag po skyes shing zhi zhing dul ba mkhyen pa yangs pa des dal 'byor la snying po med pa'i phyir thub bstan rnam rgyal la phebs nas phar phyin tshad ma rnam 'grel 'du ba la sogs pa'i po ti mang po yang thugs la tshud cing / dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje chen po dang ldan pas smon 'jug gnyis kyi sems bskyed 'byongs pa bstan pa'i bdag po zhig yong ba yod pa de 'brum pa'i rkyen gyis dgung lo nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa chu mo sbrul la dga' ba gdong du sku gshegs te/ nam mkha' 'ja' 'od kyis gang ba dang / me tog gi char la sogs pa ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma dang ldan pa byung ngo / /gzhung lugs rgya mtsho rtogs pa'i ri dbang pa/ /rnam spyod lung rigs ldan pa'i rdo rje dang / /byang chub sems bskyed 'byongs pa'i kun dga'i mtshan/ /bde gshegs yab sras gsum po rgyal gyur cig /ces bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /dpyal ston rin chen rdo rje ba de nyid la sras po zhig byung ba/ lcags pho stag la ྅/ 'oXgrangs pa ngag dbang grags pa lhun grub pa 'di nyid sku gzhon pa'i bar la dgon pa'i 'khur bsnams pa dang gdung rgyud la bslab sbyangs mdzad pa yon bdag kun gyi yon la bsngo ba smon lam gyi rgyas 'debs pa sogs kun la mkhas grub chen po nam mkha'i mtshan —109—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ pad+ma rdo rje'i gsung chos skor/can 'di nyid la gsol ba btab te bzhugs pa las nyams dag pa'i sems can dang bstan pa la dgongs te rjes su bzung ba ni/ ji skad du/ gang gi mkhyen pa'i dkyil 'khor mkha' ltar zab cing mu mtha' med pa la/ /thugs rje'i chu 'dzin 'phrin las 'od kyi tsha zer kun da 'phros pa las/ /mtha' yas 'gro ba skar tshogs gnyis 'dzin tsha grang blo mun kun nas sel/ /'gro ba'i bla ma mtshungs med nam mkha'i mtshan can spyi bos yang yang mchod/ /ces pa 'di nyid spyir bstan pa dang / gdan sa 'di nyid la bka' drin shin tu che bas rnam thar cha tsam zhig dran par byed na sku'i 'khrungs yul ni/ jo bo dī paṃ ka ra la sogs pas zhabs kyi pad+mos nye bar bcags pa'i myang zhabs gtsang gi dbus 'gyur rgyan mkhar du yab yum rigs rgyud can gyi sras su 'khrungs pa'i ltas khyad par can dang bcas par chu mo glang la/ sku zhabrungs shing sku skye ba nas skye ba du mar dal 'byor gyi rten rin po che 'di thob cing / chud ma zad par mkhas pa nas mkhas par brgyud de 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa ni/ byang chub sems dpa'i gdung 'dzin par gor ma chags/ khyad par ni bdag cag gi don du da lta gzugs sku'i bkod pa bstan pa 'di nyid dgung lo bcu bzhi pa chu pho stag la/tshul khrims dag pa dal ba'i sa thob cing /rmad byung bshes gnyen dam pas rjes bzung nas/ /phun tshogs dge legs brtson pa'i rin po che/ /rat+na shrī'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes pa de nyid kyi drung du rab tu byung nas sgo gsum tha mal las 'das/ de nas —110—

bla chen dpyal gyi gdung rabs ren po che'i za ra tshags/me pho rta la/ mkhan slob tshang ba'i dbus su bsnyen par rdzogs shing mkhas pa'i chos grwa bya rgod shong la bslab sbyangs phul du phyin pa mdzad pa la phebs/ paṇ+ḍi ta 'bum phrag gsum pa'i zhabs la gtugs te/ phyi mtshan nyid kyi rigs pa gtan la 'bebs shing nang gsang sngags kyi don phyin ci ma log par dgongs so/ /gzhan yang zha lu mkhan chen dkon mchog tshul khrims pa'i gsung gi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen po dad pa'i gdung shugs kyis bzhes te/ rgyud tshim par mdzad nas gzhan la rgya cher 'gyed pa'i brtse ba mnga' zhing rje de nyid kyi phyag phyi yun ring du mdzad cing gzim mal lha khang gis zhig po'i thugs 'gan chen po yang bzhes/de la sogs pa'i bslab sbyangs dang dka' spyad dpag tu med pa mdzad pas rab 'byams pa kun gyi gtsug gi rgyan lta bur gyur pa yin la/ thar par bka' rgyas pa la gsung sgrog mdzad pa la phebs pa dang / 'dir gdung rgyud yab sku gshegs/ sras sku gzhon pa'i bar skabs su nyam dag pa'i gdul bya phal mo che dang / sku gsung thugs kyi rten rnams kyi 'dzin skyong zhabs tog la dgongs nas/dgung lo drug cu re bzhi zhes pa chu pho 'brug gi lo khri thog tu mnga' gsol nas phebs te thams cad dad pa dang gus par byed cing mthun snang du grub pas lo phyugs kyang legs/ mi nad phyugs nad thams cad rgyun chad bskal ba dang po'i me bzhin du bde skyid dang ldan/ byams sems snying rje sgom pa sogs dang / gzhi bdag la sogs pa mi ma yin gyi tshogs rnams kyang gdug rtsub thams cad zhi ba la sogs pa byin rlabs kyang cher bar byung / gzhan yang gdul bya rang rang so sor dbang dang byin rlabs gang 'tsham par gnang ba dbang po rno rtul 'bring —111—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ pad+ma rdo rje'i gsung chosaskor/gsum gyi sgo nas bstun nas zab rgyas 'bring bsdus kyi sgo nas chos kyi char chen pos 'gro ba kun gyi nyon mongs pa'i me thams cad zhi ste yid tshims par mdzad pa'i mkhyen brtse mnga'o/ /zhib rgyas su gsung ngag las zhu bar bya'o/ /de ltar dgung lo lcags mo glang gi bar du thar pa gling dge 'khor dang bcas pa'i skyong dar dang khur chen po bsnams nas gdung rgyud rin po che khri thog tu mnga' gsol ba'i bka' lung dang / 'khur bzhes e waṃ chos ldan du mkhan chen dkon mchog lhun grub pa'i drung du dbu skra 'bul ba dang rab tu byung ba la phebs te/ mtshan yang bla ma'i mtshan gyi mtha' la brten/ dpal ngag gi dbang phyug grags pa lhun grub rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po zhes mtshan gsol te dgung lo bcu gsum pa chu pho stag gi zla'i dkar phyogs kyi gnyis pa stobs ldan gyi sbyor ba bzang po la/ skad gnyis smra ba'i gdan sa phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i gtsug lag khang du mtshungs med chos kyi rje nam mkha' rin chen dpal bzang pos thog drangs pa'i dge 'dun dang / yon bdag dang skya ser skye bo'i tshogs kyi skor ba'i dbus su khri thog tu phebs te/ tsha ja zung 'brel gyi khri ston yang rgyas par gnang / ji skad du/gsung rab rgya mtsho'i ngag la dbang 'byor zhing / /lung rtogs nor bu grags pa'i rgyal mtshan btsugs/ /'phrin las lhun grub 'gro ba'i gnyen gcig pu/ /snyigs dus 'gro la brtse bas gzigs su gsol/ /zhes so/ /de ltar bla ma yab gnyis 'gro ba'i don la sku tshe brtan par bzhugs so/ /—112—

bla chen dpyal gyi gdung rabs rin po che'i za ra tshags/thugs brtan mkha' klong chu 'dzin bral ba la/ /phun tshogs gdung rabs skar tshogs bkram pa'i dbyings/ /khyad par gyur pa'i lo tsā nyi shu ltar/ /khri thog phebs pa'i rgyud dkar 'phreng ba yis/ / 'phrin las stobs kyis 'char nub bgrod tshul ston/ /skye ba bzhi yis 'gro ba'i mun gsal nas/ /bshad sgrub bstan pa phyags bcur gsal ba dang / /dgra gcan mi mthun phyogs las rgyal gyur cig /de ltar gdung rabs rim par byon pa rnams ni/ phyi bka' mdo rgyud kyi rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu son cing / nang gnas lugs kyi rtogs pa ma/ngon du gyur cing dmigs med snying rje phyogs med du rdol bas 'gro ba'i rnam smin grol la 'god nus pa sha stag ste/ 'ga' zhig ni phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i sgo nas sems can gyi don mdzad/ 'ga' zhig rig pa brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa'i sgo nas u rgyan dang / sham bha la la sogs pa'i yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi dang / dur khrod chen po brgyad dang / gnas lnga bcu rtsa lnga dang / gzhan yang grong khyer dang / dur khrod dang gnyan khrod rnams nyul zhing phyi nang gi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i dbus na bzhugs shing 'gro ba'i don mdzad/ 'ga' zhig ni ku su lu dang / so thar nyan thos tshul gyi gangs khrod dang / g.ya' khrod dang / nags khrod dang / bas mtha' rnams na bzhugs shing skyo shas dang / nges 'byung gi sgo nas rang gzhan gyi don mdzad/ 'ga' zhig ni smyon pa dang / rdol pa dang / bu chung lta bu spyod pa skyong zhing —113—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ pad+ma rdo rje'i gsung chos skor/bzhi mdo dang / tshong 'dus dang / sgo srang dang / thang chen dbus dang / chu gling rnams na bzhugs shing spyod pa'i sgo nas sems can gyi don mdzad/ 'ga' zhig ni shin tu sbas pa'i tshul gyis skye bo phal mo che'i dbus na bzhugs shing rang gzhan gyi don mdzad/ 'ga' zhig ni spyir yang sems can bsod nams gsog pa'i rten dang gtsug lag khang rnying pa gso zhing gsar pa bzhengs pa dang sku gsung thugs kyi rten bla ma gong ma rnams kyi dgongs pa khyad par can rdzogs thabs dang / nye bar phyis kyang bstan pa rin po che yun du gnas shing bstan 'dzin rin po che rnams sku tshe ring thabs dang / 'phrin las dar zhing rgyas pa'i phyir du bzhengs shing sems can gyi don mdzad/ 'ga' zhig ni sku gsung thugs dngos kyi ni sku'i mdzad pa tha mal gyi lus las 'das pa/ sprul sku mtshan dang ldan dpe byad ldan pa dang / ngur smrig gos dang ldan zhing 'dul don gyi spyod pa la gnas pa las gdul bya'i dang ba 'dren pa dang / gsung gi sgo nas rigs drug rang rang so so'i dbang po'i sgo dang bstun nas zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos kyi char chen pos nam mkha'i khams mtha' klas pa'i sems can thams cad nyon mongs pa'i mes gdungs pa rnams/ bsil zhing yang dag pa'i don kho na nyid rtogs pa'i bdud rtsis tshim par mdzad pa'i sgo nas don mdzad pa dang / thugs mkhyen brtse'i nus pa bsam gyis mi khyab pas dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje chen pos 'gro ba kun bu bzhin du skyong ba 'phrin las bzhi rtsol med sgrub pa'i sgo nas sems can gyi don mdzad pa ste/ mdor na bshad sgrub kyi sgo nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang / sems can gyi don mdzad pa sogs rnam par dkar ba'i mdzad —114—

bla chen dpyal gyi gdung rabs rin po che'i za ra tshags/pa 'phrin las rgya che zhing rgyun mi chad pa'i mthu la brten nas/ yangs pa'i rgyal khams thams cad du nad dang / mtshon dang / mu ge dang / mu ge'i bskal ba ngan pa thams cad rgyun chad/ gdul bya phal mo che rnams gnas skabs kyi bde skyid dang ldan/ mthar thug gi bde ba bla na med pa'i byang chub chen po thob pa 'gyur ba'i dgongs pa phun sum tshogs pa sha stag go /dge legs yon tan 'byung ba'i gnas gcig pu/ /rnam dag lam bzang ston pa'i sa mkhan mchog /tshe gcig sangs rgyas ston pa'i dam chos de/ /ma nor gsal bar ston pa'i dpyal dkar rgyud/ /rim par rgyud pa'i rnam thar chu rgyun la/ /skur 'debs log lta'i skyon gyis ma gos shing / /mos gus dad pa'i me tog ldan pa yis/ /skye bu dam 'dod rnam par 'jug par rigs/ /bdag yid dad pa'i chu 'dzin bsrubs pa las /bla ma'i byin rlabs char rgyun babs pa'i mthus/ /gdung rabs ngo mtshar gtam mang spel legs 'di/ /blo ldan mkhas pa rnams kyi gzigs mor che/ /mdzad pa 'di la gnas gtsang lha yi bu/ /gzhon nu mdzes pa 'dzum pa bzhin ldan pa/ /glu len gar byed dung dang rgyal mtshan 'char/ /—115—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ pad+ma rdo rje'i gsung chos skor/me tog bsil ma 'thor dang shis brjod byed/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi 'phrin las mchog /gcig tu bsdus pa'i dpal ldan ye shes mgon/ /'gro drug sdug pa 'joms mdzad phyag drug pa/ /bstan pa'i dgra kun 'joms par mdzad du gsol/ /dpa' bo chen po tsan dan beng chen 'phyar/ /stag la chibs nas bstan pa'i ru dgra sgrol/ /lha mo dmar nag rngams shing khros pa'i tshul/ /drel rta bzhon nas dam nyams rtsad nas gcod/ /mon pa khro gtum 'jigs pa'i gar stabs bsgyur/ /dben pa'i bdag mo bar snang glo 'gyu bas/ /bka' sdod srung ma pho nyar bcas pa yis/ /bar chad srung zhing mthun rkyen sgrub par mdzod/ /'di sbyar dge ba grags pa bkra shis kyis/ /bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan phyogs bcur sgreng byed cing / /dpal 'byor bzang po'i dga' ston rab bkye nas/ /dpyal dkar gdung rgyud mngon par mtho gyur cig /bla ma rnams kyi byin rlabs bkra shis dang / /yi dam lha yi dngos grub bkra shis dang / /chos skyong srung ma'i nus mthu'i bkra shis dang / /—116—

bla chen dpyal gyi gdung rabs rin po che'i za ra tshags/dkar phyogs lha yi bden pa'i bkra shis kyis/ /nyin mtshan kun tu bkra shis bde legs shag /gdung rabs rgyun mi 'chad pa'i che ba'am/ bstan pa phyogs bcur gsal ba phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i che ba ste bcu pa'o// //gsum pa/ mjug gi don bshad pa/dpyal gyi gdung rabs mu tig 'phreng ba'i rnam thar mchog /bdag blos gzhal bar dka' ba yon tan rgya mtsho las/ /skal ldan dad pa'i gdung sel chu thigs tsam zhig 'dis/ /bdag sogs 'gro ba du ma'i phan bde'i gzhi 'gyur shog /e ma dpyal gyi mdzad pa ngo mtshar mtha' yas kyang / /rang nyid blo gros mi ldan rab rib rmongs pa'i blos/ /'gal 'khrul log pas bcom pa gang dang gang mchis pa/ /mkhas rnams chos dbyings klongs su bzod par bzhes su gsol//'di yis dge ba dri med gang thob des/ /mkha' mnyam sems can ma lus tshe gcig la/ /rgyal ba'i mdzad pa legs spyad don gnyis 'grub par shog /dpal ldan bla ma dam pa dpyal gyi gdung rabs rim par byon pa rnams kyi rnam par thar pa che ba bcu ldan zhes pa gdung rabs mgo sngon chen po 'di nyid sngon khams ston jo sras kyi mgo sngon tsam gyi bsdus pa zhig mdzad/ yang phyis su 'khon nam mkha' yangs pa'i shes rab kyi ral gris rang gi bla ma dpal rin chen pa'i bka' lung bzhin mgo sngon chen po'i rtsom pa mdzad/ de'i rjes su 'jam dbyangs kyi rgyal pos dpyal kun dga' chos rgyal yan gyi rnam thar kha —117—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ pad+ma rdo rje'i gsung chos skor/skong mdzad/ de'i rjes su ka pa bkra shis dpal bzang gis dpyal rdo rje rin chen pa yan gyi gdung rabs chen po rtsom pa mdzad pa rnams gzhir bzhag pa'i steng du/ khri thog zhal mnga' nas yab sras bzhugs pa'i dus thams cad glegs bam gcig tu dril ba 'di rang bzo dang / sgro skur med par gu ru gnyis pa bstan gnyis gling pa dang / gsang sngags gsar rnying gi dkyil 'khor ma lus pa mnga' ba rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po rig 'dzin tshul khrims rgyal mo dang / phyi nang gi chos thams cad la 'gran zla dang bral ba mkhas grub chen po nam mkha'i mtshan can de nyid thugs sras tshe bdag rgyal po zhes bya ba sgrub chen bka' brgyad kyis gtso byas/ u rgyan chos kyi dbang phyug de nyid dang / khyad par du gdung rgyud rin po che ngag dbang grags pa lhun grub rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la sogs pa'i mkhas grub du ma'i zhabs rdul spyi bos len cing / gsung las skyes pa'i dus mtha'i bya btang pad+ma rdo rje zhes bya ba'i gru rdzing la blo gsal sems dge dad brtson ldan pa'i rin chen ming can gyis bskul ba'i skya thang g.yab te/ dpal byang chub thar pa gling / skad gnyid smra ba'i chos grwa chen po phyogs las rnams par rgyal ba'i gtsug lag khang du/ me pho rta'i lo 'phrul chen zla ba'i dkar phyogs nas brtsams te nya'i bar la grub par sbyar ba'o// //dge legs dpal 'bar 'dzam gling rgyan du byon/ /maṅga lo// //—118—
